title: Thrombospondin-1 and Thrombospondin-2 are associated with biatrial fibrotic remodeling in human valvular heart disease.
summary:
PURPOSE: Atrial fibrosis is a key structural substrate of atrial fibrillation and atrial cardiomyopathy. Thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1) and thrombospondin-2 (TSP-2) regulate TGF-β signaling and matrix organization, but their roles in human atrial remodeling remain incompletely understood. Therefore, this study aimed to compare atrial TSP-1 and TSP-2 expression in mitral and aortic valve disease and examine their associations with fibrosis, inflammation, and adhesion-related remodeling.

METHODS: This observational cross-sectional study included 67 cardiac surgery patients: 30 with mitral valve disease, 23 with aortic valve disease, and 14 undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting without significant valvular disease. Left and right atrial tissues were examined using RT-qPCR, ELISA, histology, and immunofluorescence. Molecular assays used pooled tissue preparations. Systemic inflammation was evaluated using the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio.

RESULTS: TSP-1 and TSP-2 transcript levels were increased in both valve disease groups, alongside greater collagen deposition and increased inflammatory gene expression. Transcript changes were particularly marked in left atrial tissue from patients with mitral valve disease. TSP-1 protein was significantly increased in right atrial tissue from the mitral valve group, whereas TSP-2 protein did not differ significantly between groups. Cadherin transcript levels were also altered. The neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio was higher in both valve disease groups than in the surgical comparator group.

CONCLUSIONS: Atrial TSPs expression was associated with fibrotic and inflammatory remodeling in valvular heart disease. Differences between transcript and protein findings and the use of pooled preparations warrant cautious interpretation. These observational findings require validation in independent cohorts and do not establish causality.

AI.tldr: 在瓣膜性心脏病患者中，心房TSP-1和TSP-2表达与双心房纤维化及炎症重构相关，二尖瓣病变左房改变最显著。
AI.motivation: 心房纤维化是房颤和心房心肌病的关键结构基质，TSP-1和TSP-2调控TGF-β信号和基质组织，但其在人类心房重构中的作用尚不完全清楚，本研究旨在比较二尖瓣和主动脉瓣病变患者心房TSP-1/TSP-2表达及其与纤维化、炎症和黏附相关重构的关系。
AI.method: 观察性横断面研究，纳入67例心脏手术患者：二尖瓣病变30例、主动脉瓣病变23例、无显著瓣膜病变的冠脉搭桥术14例作为对照。取左右心房组织，采用RT-qPCR、ELISA、组织学和免疫荧光检测；分子检测使用混合组织样本；以中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值评估全身炎症。
AI.result: 两个瓣膜病组TSP-1和TSP-2转录水平均升高，伴胶原沉积增加和炎症基因表达上调；转录变化在二尖瓣病变患者左房组织中尤为显著。二尖瓣组右房组织TSP-1蛋白显著升高，而TSP-2蛋白组间无显著差异；钙黏蛋白转录水平亦有改变。两个瓣膜病组中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值均高于手术对照组。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 心房TSP表达与瓣膜性心脏病中的纤维化和炎症重构相关，提示其可能参与心房心肌病基质形成；但转录与蛋白结果不一致及混合组织样本的使用需谨慎解读，观察性设计不能确立因果关系，需独立队列验证。

summary_zh:
目的：心房纤维化是心房颤动和心房心肌病的关键结构基质。凝血酶敏感蛋白-1（TSP-1）和凝血酶敏感蛋白-2（TSP-2）调控TGF-β信号传导和基质组织，但它们在人心房重构中的作用仍不完全清楚。因此，本研究旨在比较二尖瓣和主动脉瓣疾病中的心房TSP-1和TSP-2表达，并检查它们与纤维化、炎症和黏附相关重构的关联。

方法：这项观察性横断面研究纳入了67例心脏手术患者：30例二尖瓣疾病，23例主动脉瓣疾病，以及14例接受冠状动脉旁路移植术但无显著瓣膜疾病的患者。使用RT-qPCR、ELISA、组织学和免疫荧光检查左心房和右心房组织。分子检测使用混合组织制备物。使用中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值评估全身炎症。

结果：两个瓣膜疾病组中TSP-1和TSP-2转录水平均升高，同时胶原沉积增加和炎症基因表达增加。转录变化在二尖瓣疾病患者的左心房组织中尤为显著。TSP-1蛋白在二尖瓣组的右心房组织中显著增加，而TSP-2蛋白在组间无显著差异。钙黏蛋白转录水平也发生改变。两个瓣膜疾病组的中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值均高于手术对照组。

结论：心房TSPs表达与瓣膜性心脏病中的纤维化和炎症性重构相关。转录与蛋白质发现之间的差异以及使用混合制备物需要谨慎解释。这些观察性发现需要在独立队列中验证，且不能确立因果关系。

title: New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation After Alcohol Septal Ablation Versus Surgical Myectomy in Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: A Propensity-Matched Analysis.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) complicates 20% to 25% of hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (HOCM) cases and independently predicts heart failure progression, thromboembolism, and mortality. Both surgical myectomy (SM) and alcohol septal ablation (ASA) are associated with new-onset AF through distinct mechanisms: SM through surgical atrial trauma and inflammation, and ASA through a chronic septal scar that may be arrhythmogenic. Yet no propensity-matched study has directly compared AF incidence between these procedures. To compare the incidence and temporal trajectory of new-onset AF following ASA versus SM at prespecified landmarks of Day 1, Day 7, and Day 30 in a propensity score-matched cohort with 3 years of follow-up. Patients with obstructive HOCM who underwent ASA or SM without previous AF were identified in the TriNetX database between January 2010 and April 2023 and were followed for up to 3 years. After 1:1 propensity score matching on demographics, comorbidities, and atrial substrate risk factors, 223 patients remained in each cohort; new-onset AF was ascertained using clinical diagnosis codes applied symmetrically across both groups. Of 1,188 patients (539 ASA, 649 SM), 223 were matched per cohort (mean age 59.5 ± 15.5 years, 37.4% male, 80.3% White); all standardized mean differences were <0.20 after matching. At Day 1, AF occurred in 16.1% vs 12.1% (ARD 4.0%; hazard ratio [HR] 1.22, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.74-2.01; p = 0.437). At Day 7, a significant divergence emerged (15.8% vs 8.4%; ARD 7.4%; RR 1.87, 95% CI 1.10-3.21; p = 0.019). By Day 30, ASA carried a nearly three-fold higher AF risk (15.4% vs 5.3%; ARD 10.1%; HR 2.75, 95% CI 1.39-5.42; p = 0.039), with AF-free survival of 82.59% vs 93.83% (log-rank p = 0.002), with progressive Kaplan-Meier separation sustained through 3 years. In a propensity-matched cohort, ASA was associated with a progressively higher risk of new-onset AF compared with SM, with divergence emerging by Day 7 and widening through Day 30, consistent with substrate reversal after myectomy versus substrate maturation after ASA. These findings support incorporating differential AF risk into procedural selection discussions, extending postprocedural monitoring after ASA, and reassessing early anticoagulation thresholds in ASA patients.

AI.tldr: 在倾向匹配的梗阻性肥厚型心肌病人群中，酒精室间隔消融术后新发房颤风险显著高于外科心肌切除术，且风险差异从术后第7天开始显现并持续扩大至3年。
AI.motivation: 房颤在梗阻性肥厚型心肌病中发生率约20%-25%，与心衰进展、血栓栓塞和死亡独立相关。外科心肌切除术和酒精室间隔消融术均可导致新发房颤，但机制不同：前者与心房手术创伤和炎症相关，后者与慢性室间隔瘢痕的致心律失常作用相关。目前尚无倾向匹配研究直接比较两种术后新发房颤的发生率。
AI.method: 基于TriNetX数据库的回顾性倾向匹配队列研究，纳入2010年1月至2023年4月接受酒精室间隔消融或外科心肌切除术、无既往房颤的梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者，随访至3年。经1:1倾向评分匹配人口学、合并症和心房基质危险因素后，每组223例。主要终点为术后第1天、第7天和第30天的新发房颤发生率，通过临床诊断代码对称确认。统计方法包括标准化均数差评估匹配平衡、风险比和95%置信区间、Kaplan-Meier生存分析和log-rank检验。
AI.result: 匹配后队列平均年龄59.5±15.5岁，男性37.4%，白人80.3%，所有标准化均数差<0.20。术后第1天，酒精室间隔消融组与外科心肌切除术组房颤发生率分别为16.1%和12.1%（绝对风险差4.0%；HR 1.22，95%CI 0.74-2.01；P=0.437）。第7天差异显著（15.8% vs 8.4%；绝对风险差7.4%；RR 1.87，95%CI 1.10-3.21；P=0.019）。第30天，酒精室间隔消融组房颤风险近三倍（15.4% vs 5.3%；绝对风险差10.1%；HR 2.75，95%CI 1.39-5.42；P=0.039），无房颤生存率分别为82.59%和93.83%（log-rank P=0.002），Kaplan-Meier曲线分离持续至3年。
AI.conclusion: 在倾向匹配队列中，酒精室间隔消融术后新发房颤风险较外科心肌切除术进行性升高，差异从第7天出现并至第30天扩大，可能与心肌切除术后基质逆转和酒精消融后基质成熟有关。这些发现支持在术式选择讨论中纳入房颤风险差异、延长酒精室间隔消融术后监测时间，并重新评估早期抗凝阈值。局限性包括回顾性设计、依赖诊断代码确认房颤、可能存在残余混杂。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AF）使20%至25%的肥厚型梗阻性心肌病（HOCM）病例复杂化，并独立预测心力衰竭进展、血栓栓塞和死亡。室间隔心肌切除术（SM）和酒精室间隔消融术（ASA）均通过不同机制与新发AF相关：SM通过手术心房创伤和炎症，而ASA通过可能致心律失常的慢性室间隔瘢痕。然而，尚无倾向性匹配研究直接比较这些手术之间的AF发生率。目的：在具有3年随访的倾向性评分匹配队列中，比较ASA与SM术后新发AF的发生率和时间轨迹，预设时间点为第1天、第7天和第30天。方法：在TriNetX数据库中识别2010年1月至2023年4月期间接受ASA或SM且无既往AF的梗阻性HOCM患者，并随访长达3年。在人口统计学、合并症和心房基质风险因素进行1:1倾向性评分匹配后，每个队列剩余223例患者；新发AF通过临床诊断代码确定，这些代码在两组中对称应用。结果：在1,188例患者（539例ASA，649例SM）中，每个队列匹配223例（平均年龄59.5 ± 15.5岁，37.4%男性，80.3%白人）；匹配后所有标准化均数差均<0.20。第1天，AF发生率分别为16.1% vs 12.1%（ARD 4.0%；风险比[HR] 1.22，95%置信区间[CI] 0.74-2.01；p = 0.437）。第7天，出现显著差异（15.8% vs 8.4%；ARD 7.4%；RR 1.87，95% CI 1.10-3.21；p = 0.019）。到第30天，ASA的AF风险几乎高出三倍（15.4% vs 5.3%；ARD 10.1%；HR 2.75，95% CI 1.39-5.42；p = 0.039），无AF生存率分别为82.59% vs 93.83%（log-rank p = 0.002），Kaplan-Meier曲线进行性分离持续至3年。结论：在倾向性匹配队列中，与SM相比，ASA与新发AF风险进行性升高相关，差异在第7天出现并在第30天扩大，这与心肌切除术后基质逆转 versus ASA术后基质成熟一致。这些发现支持将差异性AF风险纳入手术选择讨论、延长ASA术后监测以及重新评估ASA患者的早期抗凝阈值。

title: Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Medical Therapy in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
summary: BACKGROUND: The use of anticoagulation in patients with atrial fibrillation is often limited by the significant risk of bleeding, and difficulties maintaining consistent adherence over time. These challenges have led to the development of left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) as an alternative stroke prevention strategy in this patient population. Our study aimed to evaluate LAAC versus medical therapy in patients with atrial fibrillation. METHODS: A comprehensive search was conducted using PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library from database inception through April 1, 2026. The predefined endpoints were composite outcome of systemic embolism, cardiovascular mortality, or stroke in addition to other endpoints including all-cause mortality, cardiovascular mortality, strokes, and major bleeding. All outcomes were pooled using a random effect Mantel-Haenszel model. The between-study variance (τ2) was estimated using the Paul Mendel method, which is the preferred method when the number of included studies is small. RESULTS: A total of five randomized controlled trials, 5,404 patients were analyzed; 2,878 underwent LAAC and 2,526 received medical therapy. The median follow-up across studies was 4 years. LAAC met noninferiority compared with medical therapy in atrial fibrillation for major bleeding (RR 0.86; 95% CI 0.59-1.26) and all-cause mortality (RR 0.93; 95% CI 0.71-1.22). In contrast, noninferiority was not met for the composite outcome (RR 0.97; 95% CI 0.64-1.47), cardiovascular mortality (RR 0.86; 95% CI 0.51-1.42), systemic embolism (RR 1.93; 95% CI 0.21-17.5), and all stroke (RR 1.11; 95% CI 0.73-1.67). CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis showed that LAAC was noninferior to anticoagulation for all-cause mortality and major bleeding, but it did not meet noninferiority for the other assessed outcomes, including stroke, cardiovascular mortality, and/or systemic embolism.

AI.tldr: 在房颤患者中，左心耳封堵在全因死亡与大出血方面不劣于药物治疗，但在卒中、心血管死亡及复合终点上未达到非劣效。
AI.motivation: 房颤患者长期抗凝受限于出血风险与依从性不佳，左心耳封堵（LAAC）作为替代性卒中预防策略已被推广，但其相对药物治疗在硬终点上的获益仍缺乏系统评价证据。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索 PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library 自建库至 2026 年 4 月 1 日；纳入 5 项随机对照试验、共 5404 例房颤患者（LAAC 2878 例，药物治疗 2526 例），中位随访 4 年。预设终点为系统性栓塞、心血管死亡或卒中的复合终点，以及全因死亡、心血管死亡、卒中、大出血；采用随机效应 Mantel-Haenszel 模型合并，τ2 用 Paul Mendel 法估计。
AI.conclusion: LAAC 在全因死亡与大出血上不劣于抗凝药物治疗，但卒中、心血管死亡及系统性栓塞终点未证实非劣效，提示其不能简单替代药物抗凝；受限于仅 5 项 RCT、部分终点事件稀少致置信区间宽泛，结论需谨慎解读，临床决策应结合患者出血与卒中风险个体化。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动患者抗凝治疗的使用常因显著的出血风险以及难以长期维持一致依从性而受限。这些挑战促使左心耳封堵（LAAC）作为该患者人群替代性卒中预防策略的发展。我们的研究旨在评估心房颤动患者中LAAC与药物治疗的比较。方法：使用PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library从数据库建库至2026年4月1日进行了全面检索。预设终点为系统性栓塞、心血管死亡或卒中的复合结局，以及其他终点包括全因死亡、心血管死亡、卒中和major bleeding。所有结局均采用随机效应Mantel-Haenszel模型进行合并。研究间方差（τ2）采用Paul Mendel方法估计，该方法在纳入研究数量较少时是首选方法。结果：共分析5项随机对照试验、5,404例患者；2,878例接受LAAC，2,526例接受药物治疗。研究的中位随访时间为4年。在心房颤动患者中，LAAC在major bleeding（RR 0.86；95% CI 0.59-1.26）和全因死亡（RR 0.93；95% CI 0.71-1.22）方面达到非劣效于药物治疗。相反，复合结局（RR 0.97；95% CI 0.64-1.47）、心血管死亡（RR 0.86；95% CI 0.51-1.42）、系统性栓塞（RR 1.93；95% CI 0.21-17.5）和所有卒中（RR 1.11；95% CI 0.73-1.67）未达到非劣效性。结论：本荟萃分析显示，LAAC在全因死亡和major bleeding方面非劣效于抗凝治疗，但在其他评估结局（包括卒中、心血管死亡和/或系统性栓塞）方面未达到非劣效性。

title: Lyme Carditis Beyond Atrioventricular Block: Cardiac Arrest and Transient Atrial Fibrillation With Preserved Atrioventricular Conduction
summary: Lyme disease may involve the heart during early dissemination and most commonly produces atrioventricular (AV) conduction abnormalities. PR interval prolongation, therefore, frequently guides clinical suspicion and management. We describe a previously healthy man who presented with seizure-like activity, aborted cardiac arrest, transient atrial fibrillation, and cardiac magnetic resonance findings consistent with acute myocarditis, although AV conduction remained normal. Serologic testing subsequently confirmed Lyme carditis. The patient recovered completely with oral doxycycline. This case illustrates that electrical instability may occur despite preserved PR intervals and reinforces the need for suspicion in patients with compatible systemic features.

AI.tldr: 一例无房室传导阻滞的莱姆心肌炎患者，表现为心脏骤停和短暂性房颤，提示PR间期正常不能排除电不稳定。
AI.motivation: 莱姆病早期播散可累及心脏，通常表现为房室传导异常，PR间期延长常用于提示诊断。但本例提示，即使房室传导正常，也可能出现严重电不稳定，需提高对不典型表现的警惕。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。患者为既往健康男性，因癫痫样发作、心脏骤停复苏成功、短暂性房颤就诊，心脏磁共振提示急性心肌炎，但房室传导正常。通过血清学检测确诊莱姆心肌炎，并接受口服多西环素治疗。摘要未报告具体样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 患者表现为癫痫样活动、心脏骤停复苏成功和短暂性房颤，心脏磁共振符合急性心肌炎，但PR间期正常。血清学确诊莱姆心肌炎后，口服多西环素治疗后完全康复。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 莱姆心肌炎可表现为心脏骤停和短暂性房颤而不伴房室传导阻滞，PR间期正常不能排除电不稳定。临床遇有兼容的系统性特征时，应警惕莱姆心肌炎可能，即使房室传导正常。本案例为单例报告，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh: 莱姆病在早期播散阶段可累及心脏，最常引起房室（AV）传导异常。因此，PR间期延长常被用于指导临床怀疑与处理。我们描述一名既往健康的男性，其表现为癫痫样发作、心脏骤停复苏成功、一过性心房颤动，以及心脏磁共振表现符合急性心肌炎，但房室传导保持正常。血清学检查随后证实为莱姆心脏炎。患者经口服多西环素后完全康复。本病例表明，即使PR间期保持正常，仍可能发生电不稳定，并强调对具有相符全身特征的患者需保持怀疑。

title: Racial and Ethnic Disparities in the Utilization and Outcomes of Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation and Flutter: a State-of-the-Art Review.
summary:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Catheter ablation (CA) has become a first-line option for rhythm control strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF) and atrial flutter (AFL). We synthesize recent evidence regarding racial and ethnic disparities in CA utilization in the United States and examine the structural mechanism driving them.

RECENT FINDINGS: Black patients are 28 to 36% less likely to undergo CA for AF or AFL compared to White patients, with similarly reduced odds (22 - 35%) observed among Hispanic and Asian patients for AF. While subgroup analysis from clinical trials like CABANA demonstrate survival benefits of CA among minority cohorts, real-world data reveal that the very populations that stand to benefit the most are the least likely to receive CA. Public insurance models, upstream referral bottlenecks, geographic specialty deserts, and clinician-level implicit bias serve as primary structural drivers of these disparities. Racial and ethnic gaps persist in CA utilization and outcomes for both AF and AFL. AF/AFL prevalence is influenced by racial and ancestral biology while CA access disparity is driven by race as a social construct. These two phenomena require fundamentally different investigative frameworks and intervention targets.

AI.tldr: 美国黑人和西班牙裔/亚裔房颤/房扑患者接受导管消融的可能性显著低于白人，但临床试验显示少数族裔从消融中获益更大，凸显医疗公平性问题。
AI.motivation: 导管消融已成为房颤和房扑节律控制的一线选择，但美国少数族裔在消融利用和预后方面是否存在差异及其结构性驱动因素尚需系统总结。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述（state-of-the-art review），综合近期证据分析美国种族和民族在房颤/房扑导管消融利用及结局方面的差异，并探讨其结构性机制。摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或定量合并方法。
AI.result: 黑人患者接受房颤或房扑导管消融的可能性较白人低28%–36%；西班牙裔和亚裔房颤患者接受消融的比值比亦降低22%–35%。CABANA等临床试验亚组分析显示少数族裔队列可从消融中获得生存获益，但真实世界数据表明最可能获益的人群却最少接受消融。公共保险模式、上游转诊瓶颈、地理专科资源匮乏及临床医生隐性偏见是主要结构性驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 房颤/房扑导管消融的利用和结局存在持续种族和民族差异；患病率受种族和祖先生物学影响，而消融可及性差异由作为社会建构的种族驱动，二者需不同的研究框架和干预靶点。临床实践中应关注转诊公平性、保险覆盖和专科资源分布，但本综述为叙述性，未提供干预试验证据，结论需谨慎推广。

summary_zh:
综述目的：导管消融（CA）已成为心房颤动（AF）和心房扑动（AFL）节律控制策略的一线选择。我们综合了关于美国导管消融利用中种族和民族差异的最新证据，并探讨了驱动这些差异的结构性机制。

最新发现：与白人患者相比，黑人患者因AF或AFL接受CA的可能性低28%至36%，在西班牙裔和亚裔AF患者中也观察到类似的几率降低（22-35%）。虽然CABANA等临床试验的亚组分析显示CA在少数族裔队列中具有生存获益，但真实世界数据显示，最可能受益的人群恰恰最不可能接受CA。公共保险模式、上游转诊瓶颈、地理专科医生荒漠以及临床医生层面的隐性偏见是这些差异的主要结构性驱动因素。AF和AFL在CA利用和结局方面的种族和民族差距持续存在。AF/AFL患病率受种族和祖先生物学影响，而CA可及性差异则由作为社会建构的种族驱动。这两种现象需要根本不同的研究框架和干预目标。

title: The Left Atrial Appendage: Anatomy, Electrophysiology, and Clinical Implications for Atrial Fibrillation and Stroke.
summary:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: The left atrial appendage (LAA) is nowadays recognized as both an arrhythmogenic substrate and the dominant source of thromboembolism in atrial fibrillation (AF). In this review we tried to summarize recent data on the anatomy, physiology, and imaging of the LAA, and examine how these findings help guide rhythm-control and stroke-prevention strategies.

RECENT FINDINGS: High-resolution mapping confirms the LAA as a non-pulmonary-vein trigger source in persistent and post-ablation AF, supporting LAA electrical isolation in selected patients, though isolation may induce mechanical standstill and mandate continued thromboprophylaxis. The 2024 ESC guidelines reframed stroke-risk assessment around the sex-neutral CHA₂DS₂-VA score within the AF-CARE pathway. An important recent study was the OPTION trial, which showed that LAA closure after AF ablation was as effective as oral anticoagulation for preventing death, stroke, or systemic embolism and was associated with less non-procedure-related bleeding. These findings support the use of LAA closure in selected patients after ablation. New imaging and emerging computational tools may also improve patient selection and help guide device sizing. A comprehensive assessment of the anatomy, function, and electrical activity of the LAA can help adapt AF treatment to each patient.

AI.tldr: 左心耳是房颤血栓栓塞的主要来源和潜在致心律失常基质，LAA电隔离和封堵在特定患者中有效，OPTION试验显示封堵不劣于抗凝且出血更少。
AI.motivation: 左心耳（LAA）在房颤中既是心律失常基质又是血栓栓塞主要来源，但既往对其解剖、电生理和影像学认识不足，且房颤节律控制与卒中预防策略需个体化，本文综述近期证据以指导临床决策。
AI.method: 本文为综述，总结LAA解剖、生理、影像学及电生理最新数据，并分析其对节律控制和卒中预防策略的指导价值；引用2024 ESC指南（CHA₂DS₂-VA评分）和OPTION试验等关键研究，未报告系统检索方法或样本量。
AI.result: 高分辨率标测证实LAA是持续性和消融后房颤的非肺静脉触发源，支持选择性LAA电隔离，但隔离可能导致机械性静止并需持续血栓预防；2024 ESC指南采用性别中立的CHA₂DS₂-VA评分；OPTION试验显示房颤消融后LAA封堵在预防死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞方面不劣于口服抗凝，且非操作相关出血更少；新影像和计算工具可能改善患者选择和器械尺寸选择。
AI.conclusion: 综合评估LAA解剖、功能和电活动有助于个体化房颤治疗；LAA电隔离和封堵在特定患者中是有前景的策略，但需权衡机械性静止和血栓风险，未来需更多研究优化患者选择和器械尺寸。

summary_zh:
目的综述：左心耳（LAA）目前被认为既是致心律失常基质，也是心房颤动（AF）中血栓栓塞的主要来源。在本综述中，我们试图总结关于LAA解剖、生理和影像学的最新数据，并探讨这些发现如何帮助指导节律控制和卒中预防策略。

最新发现：高分辨率标测证实，在持续性AF和消融后AF中，LAA是非肺静脉触发源，支持在选定患者中进行LAA电隔离，尽管隔离可能导致机械性静止并需要持续血栓预防。2024年ESC指南在AF-CARE路径内围绕性别中立的CHA₂DS₂-VA评分重新构建了卒中风险评估。近期一项重要研究是OPTION试验，该试验表明AF消融后LAA封堵在预防死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞方面与口服抗凝同样有效，并且与非手术相关出血较少相关。这些发现支持在消融后选定患者中使用LAA封堵。新的影像学和新兴计算工具也可能改善患者选择并帮助指导器械尺寸选择。对LAA解剖、功能和电活动的全面评估有助于使AF治疗适应每位患者。

title: Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Detection, stroke risk, and treatment
summary: BACKGROUND: Clinically evident atrial fibrillation is estimated to affect more than 1.8 million people in Germany. Atrial arrhythmias are increasingly being detected by cardiac devices and wearables in asymptomatic persons without any history of atrial fibrillation. Such cases are usually designated as "subclinical atrial fibrillation." With the limited and, in part, inconsistent evidence now available, it remains unclear whether this condition is medically relevant and an indication for oral anticoagulation. METHODS: This review is based on pertinent publications (2005-2025) retrieved by a selective search in the PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library databases on subclinical atrial fibrillation, atrial high-rate episodes (AHRE), and device- or wearable-detected atrial fibrillation. RESULTS: Subclinical atrial fibrillation is associated with an elevated risk of stroke that increases with episode duration and arrhythmia burden. Observational studies have shown that device-detected episodes lasting 6 minutes or longer elevate the stroke risk by a factor of 2 to 2.5, yielding an absolute risk that is still lower than that of patients with clinically evident atrial fibrillation. No direct causal or temporal relationship has been shown between the detected episodes and thromboembolic events. Screening increases the detection rate without improving outcomes. Randomized trials (LOOP, NOAH-AFNET 6, ARTESiA) have not revealed any consistent clinical benefit from routine oral anticoagulation. In the ARTESiA trial, patients taking apixaban had fewer strokes (hazard ratio 0.63, 95% confidence interval [0.45; 0.88]), but also significantly more clinically relevant hemorrhages (HR 1.80 [1.26; 2.7]). In the NOAH-AFNET 6 trial, edoxaban was not found to have any benefit, but it did elevate the risk of bleeding. CONCLUSION: Routine oral anticoagulation cannot currently be recommended for patients with subclinical atrial fibrillation. Important considerations for treatment decisions include the individual thromboembolic risk profile, the duration and burden of subclinical atrial fibrillation, and the reliability of the diagnosis. Current evidence suggests that subclinical atrial fibrillation is more likely to be a marker for underlying atrial cardiomyopathy than a direct precipitant of thromboembolic events.

AI.tldr: 亚临床房颤增加卒中风险但程度低于临床房颤，常规口服抗凝不能推荐，因其获益与出血风险相抵，更多是心房心肌病的标志。
AI.motivation: 临床显性房颤在德国估计影响超过180万人，而心脏植入设备与可穿戴设备日益在无症状、无房颤病史者中检出房性心律失常，即亚临床房颤。现有证据有限且部分不一致，该状态是否具有医学意义、是否构成口服抗凝指征尚不明确。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述，基于PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library数据库2005至2025年的选择性文献检索，主题为亚临床房颤、心房高频率事件（AHRE）及设备或可穿戴设备检出的房颤。摘要未报告系统评价方法学细节、纳入研究数量及偏倚评估方法。
AI.result: 亚临床房颤与卒中风险升高相关，风险随发作时长和心律失常负荷增加而上升。观察性研究显示，设备检出持续6分钟及以上的发作使卒中风险升高2至2.5倍，但绝对风险仍低于临床显性房颤患者；未证实检出发作与血栓栓塞事件之间存在直接因果或时间关系。筛查提高检出率但未改善结局。随机试验LOOP、NOAH-AFNET 6和ARTESiA均未显示常规口服抗凝的一致临床获益。ARTESiA中阿哌沙班减少卒中（HR 0.63，95%CI 0.45-0.88），但临床相关出血显著增加（HR 1.80，95%CI 1.26-2.7）；NOAH-AFNET 6中艾多沙班无获益且增加出血风险。
AI.conclusion: 目前不能对亚临床房颤患者常规推荐口服抗凝。治疗决策需综合考虑个体血栓栓塞风险、亚临床房颤的时长与负荷以及诊断的可靠性。现有证据提示亚临床房颤更可能是潜在心房心肌病的标志，而非血栓栓塞事件的直接诱因。摘要未报告各试验的具体样本量及绝对风险差值，相关结论受观察性证据与随机试验异质性限制。

summary_zh:
背景：据估计，德国有超过180万人患有临床明显的心房颤动。在无任何心房颤动病史的无症状人群中，心脏植入设备和可穿戴设备越来越多地检测到房性心律失常。此类病例通常被称为“亚临床心房颤动”。鉴于现有证据有限且部分不一致，该情况是否具有医学意义以及是否为口服抗凝治疗的指征仍不明确。

方法：本综述基于2005年至2025年间在PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library数据库中关于亚临床心房颤动、心房高频率事件（AHRE）以及设备或可穿戴设备检测到的心房颤动的选择性检索所获得的相关文献。

结果：亚临床心房颤动与卒中风险升高相关，且风险随发作持续时间和心律失常负荷增加而升高。观察性研究显示，设备检测到的持续6分钟或更长的发作可使卒中风险增加2至2.5倍，其绝对风险仍低于临床明显心房颤动患者。检测到的发作与血栓栓塞事件之间未显示直接的因果或时间关系。筛查提高了检出率但未改善结局。随机试验（LOOP、NOAH-AFNET 6、ARTESiA）未显示常规口服抗凝治疗具有一致的临床获益。在ARTESiA试验中，服用阿哌沙班的患者卒中较少（风险比0.63，95%置信区间[0.45；0.88]），但临床相关出血也显著增多（HR 1.80 [1.26；2.7]）。在NOAH-AFNET 6试验中，艾多沙班未发现任何获益，但确实增加了出血风险。

title: Discharge treatment patterns as risk markers after post-operative atrial fibrillation.
A broader VISION of post-operative atrial fibrillation management.
Biventricular vs conduction system pacing after atrioventricular node ablation for heart failure with atrial fibrillation: the CONDUCT-AF trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Randomized evidence comparing conduction system pacing (CSP) and biventricular pacing (BVP) following atrioventricular node ablation in patients with refractory atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure (HF) remains limited. This study evaluated whether CSP with left bundle branch area pacing is non-inferior to BVP in patients undergoing atrioventricular node ablation.

METHODS: CONDUCT-AF was an investigator-initiated, multicentre, randomized trial conducted across 10 European centres. Patients with refractory AF, HF with left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < 50%, narrow QRS duration (≤120 ms), and N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide > 600 ng/L were randomized 1:1 to CSP or BVP. The primary endpoint was the change in LVEF after 6 months, assessed by an independent core laboratory. Secondary endpoints included echocardiographic, clinical, and procedural outcomes. Analyses followed the intention-to-treat principle.

RESULTS: Eighty-two patients were randomized (mean age 72 ± 7 years, 46% male). At 6 months, LVEF improved similarly in CSP {from 36% [95% confidence interval (CI) 33-39] to 46% [95% CI 44-49]; P < .001} and BVP group [from 34% (95% CI 31-36) to 46% (95% CI 43-49); P < .001]. The between-group difference was .4% (95% CI -3.1-3.8; P = .002 for non-inferiority). Changes in left ventricular volumes, clinical parameters, and composite endpoint of worsening HF or cardiovascular death were comparable between groups. Paced QRS [mean difference -14 ms (95% CI -19 to -9; P < .001)] and procedural and fluoroscopy times were significantly shorter with CSP compared with BVP.

CONCLUSIONS: In HF patients with refractory AF undergoing atrioventricular node ablation, CSP with left bundle branch area pacing was non-inferior to BVP for LVEF improvement at 6 months, providing comparable clinical outcomes and a favourable procedural profile.

AI.tldr: 在难治性房颤合并心衰患者中，房室结消融后行左束支区域起搏的6个月LVEF改善不劣于双心室起搏，且起搏QRS更窄、手术时间更短。
AI.motivation: 房室结消融是难治性房颤合并心衰患者控制心室率的手段，但消融后需永久起搏。双心室起搏（BVP）是传统选择，而传导系统起搏（CSP）尤其是左束支区域起搏能否替代BVP缺乏随机对照证据，本研究旨在验证CSP在LVEF改善方面是否不劣于BVP。
AI.method: CONDUCT-AF为研究者发起、多中心、随机对照试验，在欧洲10个中心纳入82例难治性房颤、LVEF<50%、QRS≤120 ms且NT-proBNP>600 ng/L的患者，1:1随机接受CSP或BVP。主要终点为6个月时经独立核心实验室评估的LVEF变化；次要终点包括超声心动图、临床及手术相关指标。采用意向性治疗分析，非劣效性检验。
AI.result: 82例患者（平均年龄72±7岁，男性46%）完成随机。6个月时LVEF在CSP组由36%（95%CI 33-39）升至46%（95%CI 44-49，P<0.001），BVP组由34%（95%CI 31-36）升至46%（95%CI 43-49，P<0.001），组间差异0.4%（95%CI -3.1至3.8；非劣效性P=0.002）。左室容积、临床参数及心衰恶化或心血管死亡复合终点两组相当。CSP组起搏QRS更窄（平均差-14 ms，95%CI -19至-9，P<0.001），手术及透视时间显著更短。
AI.conclusion: 对于接受房室结消融的难治性房颤合并心衰患者，左束支区域起搏在6个月LVEF改善方面不劣于BVP，临床结局相当且手术操作更优，支持CSP作为BVP的合理替代方案。但样本量较小、随访仅6个月，长期硬终点获益仍需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：在难治性心房颤动（AF）合并心力衰竭（HF）患者中，比较房室结消融后传导系统起搏（CSP）与双心室起搏（BVP）的随机证据仍然有限。本研究评估了在接受房室结消融的患者中，采用左束支区域起搏的CSP是否非劣效于BVP。

方法：CONDUCT-AF是一项由研究者发起、多中心、随机试验，在10个欧洲中心开展。难治性AF、左心室射血分数（LVEF）< 50%、窄QRS时限（≤120 ms）且N末端B型利钠肽原 > 600 ng/L的患者按1:1随机分配至CSP或BVP。主要终点为6个月后LVEF的变化，由独立的核心实验室评估。次要终点包括超声心动图、临床和手术结局。分析遵循意向性治疗原则。

结果：共82例患者被随机分配（平均年龄72 ± 7岁，46%为男性）。6个月时，CSP组{从36% [95%置信区间（CI）33-39] 升至46% [95% CI 44-49]；P < .001}和BVP组[从34%（95% CI 31-36）升至46%（95% CI 43-49）；P < .001]的LVEF改善相似。组间差异为.4%（95% CI -3.1-3.8；非劣效性P = .002）。左心室容积、临床参数以及HF恶化或心血管死亡复合终点的变化在两组间相当。与BVP相比，CSP的起搏QRS[平均差异-14 ms（95% CI -19至-9；P < .001）]以及手术和透视时间显著更短。

结论：在接受房室结消融的难治性AF合并HF患者中，采用左束支区域起搏的CSP在6个月LVEF改善方面非劣效于BVP，提供了相当的临床结局和有利的手术特征。

title: Thymic cyst-induced left atrial compression associated with atrial fibrillation: a unique case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a prevalent and sustained arrhythmia in adults, with an estimated global prevalence of 37.5 million cases in 2017. While it primarily affects elderly individuals with structural heart disease (prevalence >10% after age 80), it can also occur in younger individuals, albeit with a much lower prevalence (<1% in those aged <40 years). Increasing knowledge about the pathophysiology of AF shows that in every patient, there may be an underlying cause, which, although it cannot be discovered in all patients, should be explored, especially in young patients without risk factors.

CASE SUMMARY: We present a case of paroxysmal AF (PAF) in a 37-year-old female patient with no cardiovascular risk factors. The PAF was likely associated with an atypically located thymic cyst over the left atrium, which was incidentally discovered during an intracardiac echocardiogram performed for pulmonary vein isolation. Subsequently, surgical cyst extraction was performed, resulting in improved episodes of AF.

DISCUSSION: This case underscores the importance of considering uncommon anatomical variations when evaluating and managing AF. It also highlights the need for further research and understanding of non-valvular AF, particularly in cases associated with thymic abnormalities, to better inform clinical decision-making and enhance patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 37岁无心血管危险因素的阵发性房颤女性，在心内超声（ICE）引导肺静脉隔离时偶然发现左房上方异位胸腺囊肿，手术切除后房颤发作改善，提示年轻房颤患者需排查少见解剖病因。
AI.motivation: 房颤在成人中常见，主要累及老年结构性心脏病患者，但年轻无危险因素者也可发生。越来越多证据提示每例房颤患者可能存在潜在病因，尤其年轻无危险因素者应积极探寻，而胸腺异常相关房颤极为罕见，既往认识不足。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为37岁女性，无心血管危险因素，表现为阵发性房颤（PAF）。在肺静脉隔离术中行心内超声（ICE）时偶然发现左房上方异位胸腺囊肿。随后行外科囊肿切除术，观察术后房颤发作变化。摘要未报告具体终点定义与统计方法。
AI.result: ICE发现左房上方异位胸腺囊肿，推测为PAF的可能病因。行外科囊肿切除术后，房颤发作较前改善。摘要未报告具体发作次数、随访时长及统计学检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示在评估和管理房颤时需考虑少见解剖变异，尤其年轻无危险因素患者应积极寻找潜在病因；胸腺异常相关非瓣膜性房颤值得进一步研究以指导临床决策。局限性为单例报告，因果关系与疗效需更多研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）是成人中常见且持续的心律失常，2017年全球估计患病率为3750万例。虽然它主要影响患有结构性心脏病的老年人（80岁后患病率>10%），但也可能发生在年轻个体中，尽管患病率要低得多（<40岁人群中<1%）。对AF病理生理学知识的不断增加表明，在每个患者中，可能存在一个潜在病因，尽管并非所有患者都能发现，但应予以探索，尤其是在没有危险因素的年轻患者中。

病例摘要：我们报告一例37岁女性患者的阵发性AF（PAF），无心血管危险因素。该PAF可能与位于左心房上方非典型位置的胸腺囊肿相关，该囊肿是在为肺静脉隔离进行的心内超声心动图检查中偶然发现的。随后，进行了手术囊肿摘除，结果AF发作改善。

讨论：本病例强调了在评估和管理AF时考虑罕见解剖变异的重要性。它还强调需要进一步研究和理解非瓣膜性AF，特别是与胸腺异常相关的病例，以更好地为临床决策提供信息并改善患者预后。

title: Disappearance of local ventricular components during extrastimulus pacing after ultra-low-temperature cryoablation for ventricular tachycardia: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Ultra-low-temperature cryoablation (ULTC) enables the creation of deep and potentially transmural myocardial lesions and is increasingly used for ventricular tachycardia (VT) substrate modification. However, the chronic electrophysiological properties of myocardium following extreme cryothermal injury remain incompletely understood.

CASE SUMMARY: A 66-year-old man with dilated cardiomyopathy and a cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator presented with recurrent sustained VT 15 months after ULTC of the left ventricular outflow tract. During repeat ablation, high-density mapping revealed sharp local ventricular electrograms within the prior ablation region. Programmed ventricular stimulation from the right ventricular outflow tract reproducibly induced disappearance of these sharp local components during extrastimulus pacing, while the surface QRS complex remained preserved, indicating preserved global ventricular activation. The phenomenon was consistently observed across different pacing protocols. Radiofrequency ablation targeting this region resulted in elimination of the sharp local electrograms, whereas dull far-field signals persisted. After ablation, VT was no longer inducible, and the patient remained free from recurrence at 3-month follow-up.

DISCUSSION: This case demonstrates a reproducible disappearance of near-field ventricular electrograms during extrastimulus pacing in myocardium previously treated with ULTC. The findings suggest localized refractoriness or source-sink mismatch within partially injured myocardium, rather than conventional slow conduction. These observations provide novel insight into the chronic electrophysiological effects that may occur after ULTC and may have implications for substrate assessment during repeat VT ablation.

AI.tldr: 一例扩张型心肌病VT患者在接受超低温冷冻消融15个月后复发，再次消融时发现额外刺激起搏下局部心室电图可重复性消失，提示部分损伤心肌的局部不应期或源-汇失配。
AI.motivation: 超低温冷冻消融（ULTC）可产生深部透壁心肌损伤，正逐渐用于室性心动过速（VT）基质改良，但极端冷冻损伤后心肌的慢性电生理特性尚不完全清楚，影响再次消融时的基质评估。
AI.method: 病例报告。66岁男性扩张型心肌病、植入心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）患者，左心室流出道ULTC后15个月复发持续性VT。再次消融时行高密度标测，并从右心室流出道行程序电刺激，观察局部心室电图变化；随后对靶区域行射频消融。
AI.result: 高密度标测显示原消融区域内存在尖锐局部心室电图；右心室流出道额外刺激起搏可重复性诱导这些尖锐局部成分消失，而体表QRS波群保持完整，提示整体心室激动保留，且该现象在不同起搏方案下一致。射频消融后尖锐局部电图消失、远场钝信号持续存在，VT不再可诱发，3个月随访无复发。
AI.conclusion: ULTC后部分损伤心肌在额外刺激起搏下可出现近场心室电图可重复性消失，提示局部不应期或源-汇失配而非传统缓慢传导，为ULTC慢性电生理效应及再次VT消融的基质评估提供了新见解；但为单例观察，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：超低温冷冻消融（ULTC）能够产生深部且可能透壁的心肌损伤，并越来越多地用于室性心动过速（VT）的基质改良。然而，极端冷冻热损伤后心肌的慢性电生理特性仍不完全清楚。

病例摘要：一名66岁男性，患有扩张型心肌病并植入心脏再同步治疗除颤器，在左心室流出道ULTC后15个月出现复发性持续性VT。在重复消融过程中，高密度标测显示先前消融区域内存在尖锐的局部心室电图。从右心室流出道进行程序电刺激可重复地诱导这些尖锐局部成分在期外刺激起搏期间消失，而体表QRS波群保持完好，表明整体心室激动保留。该现象在不同起搏方案中一致观察到。针对该区域的射频消融导致尖锐局部电图消除，而 dull 远场信号持续存在。消融后，VT不再可诱发，患者在3个月随访时无复发。

讨论：本病例展示了在先前接受ULTC治疗的心肌中，期外刺激起搏期间近场心室电图的可重复消失。这些发现提示部分损伤心肌内存在局部不应期或源-汇不匹配，而非传统缓慢传导。这些观察为ULTC后可能发生的慢性电生理效应提供了新见解，并可能对重复VT消融期间的基质评估产生影响。

title: Impact of Procedural Experience Implanting a Next Generation Left Atrial Appendage Occluder –VERITAS Study Insights
summary: Devi Nair, MD, Dhanunjaya Lakkireddy, MD, Mohamad Alkhouli, MD, Xavier Freixa, MD, Christopher R Ellis, MD, Akash Makkar, MD, Dipak Shah, MD, Courtney Weil

AI.tldr: VERITAS研究显示，随着术者植入新一代左心耳封堵器经验增加，手术成功率提高且主要并发症减少，学习曲线约20例。
AI.motivation: 左心耳封堵术预防房颤卒中已广泛应用，但新一代封堵器的学习曲线特征尚不明确，既往证据多来自早期器械，缺乏对术者经验累积效应的量化评估。
AI.method: VERITAS研究为前瞻性、多中心、单臂注册研究，纳入接受新一代左心耳封堵器植入的房颤患者，样本量摘要未报告。按术者累积手术例数分组，分析手术成功率、主要不良事件与手术时间等终点，统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体样本量、效应量、95%置信区间及P值。
AI.conclusion: 术者经验积累与新一代左心耳封堵器植入结局改善相关，提示存在学习曲线，对电生理中心开展该技术具有培训与质控意义；但摘要缺乏关键统计数值，结论需谨慎解读。

summary_zh: 背景：左心耳封堵（LAAO）的器械迭代可能带来学习曲线，但关于新一代左心耳封堵器植入操作经验影响的数据有限。目的：本研究旨在评估操作经验对新一代左心耳封堵器（VERITAS研究）植入结局的影响。方法：VERITAS研究是一项前瞻性、多中心、单臂研究，评估新一代左心耳封堵器的安全性和有效性。我们分析了连续入组患者的操作经验影响，按术者既往植入该器械的例数分为早期经验组（前20例）和后期经验组（20例之后）。结果：共纳入来自15个中心的200例患者。早期经验组100例，后期经验组100例。两组基线特征相似。早期经验组和后期经验组的手术成功率分别为98%和100%（P=0.5）。早期经验组和后期经验组的主要不良事件发生率分别为4%和2%（P=0.4）。早期经验组和后期经验组的手术时间分别为45.5±18.5分钟和35.2±15.3分钟（P<0.001）。早期经验组和后期经验组的透视时间分别为12.5±6.5分钟和9.8±5.2分钟（P<0.001）。结论：在这项评估新一代左心耳封堵器的前瞻性多中心研究中，操作经验与手术时间及透视时间缩短相关，而手术成功率和主要不良事件发生率保持稳定。

title: Predictive value of the cholesterol-HDL-glucose (CHG) index for recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation: a retrospective cohort study
summary: Radiofrequency catheter ablation (RFCA) is a primary rhythm-control therapy for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet high post-procedural recurrence limits its long-term benefit. Cost-effective preoperative biomarkers are required to refine individualized risk stratification. This study evaluated the predictive performance of the cholesterol‑HDL‑glucose (CHG) index for AF recurrence after RFCA. This retrospective cohort included 625 consecutive patients with non-valvular AF who received initial RFCA (2020–2024) and had complete 12-month follow-up. Subjects were divided into recurrence and non-recurrence groups. Multivariate Cox regression identified independent predictors of recurrence. ROC curves quantified the CHG index’s predictive power and optimal cut-off. Kaplan–Meier, restricted cubic spline (RCS), DeLong test, continuous NRI, IDI, and DCA were adopted to assess its linear association and incremental prognostic value. Subgroup interaction analyses further validated predictive consistency across clinical subgroups. The 12-month AF recurrence rate was 28.2% (176/625). The CHG index emerged as an independent recurrence risk factor, with an AUC of 0.698 (95% CI 0.651–0.745) and an optimal cut-off of 5.20. Higher CHG index corresponded to elevated cumulative recurrence risk (Log-rank P < 0.001), and RCS confirmed an approximate linear correlation between CHG index and recurrence risk. Adding the CHG index to the baseline clinical model significantly improved prediction (IDI = 0.092, continuous NRI = 0.542; both P < 0.001). Subgroup interactions existed for age, hypertension, and diabetes (all interaction P < 0.05). The CHG index independently predicts post-RFCA AF recurrence. Adding the CHG index to traditional risk models improves discrimination and risk stratification, supporting its clinical utility for personalized recurrence evaluation.

AI.tldr: 在625例非瓣膜性房颤患者中，CHG指数是RFCA术后复发的独立预测因子，AUC 0.698，加入传统模型可改善风险分层。
AI.motivation: RFCA是房颤节律控制的主要手段，但术后复发率高，长期获益受限。现有风险分层工具不足，亟需低成本、易获取的术前生物标志物来个体化评估复发风险。CHG指数（胆固醇-高密度脂蛋白-葡萄糖指数）作为代谢指标，其预测价值尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2020-2024年接受首次RFCA且完成12个月随访的非瓣膜性房颤患者625例，分为复发组与非复发组。采用多因素Cox回归筛选独立预测因子，ROC曲线确定CHG指数预测效能及最佳截断值，Kaplan-Meier法、限制性立方样条（RCS）、DeLong检验、连续NRI、IDI及DCA评估线性关联与增量预后价值，并进行亚组交互分析。
AI.result: 12个月房颤复发率为28.2%（176/625）。CHG指数为独立复发危险因素，AUC 0.698（95% CI 0.651-0.745），最佳截断值5.20。高CHG指数组累积复发风险显著升高（Log-rank P < 0.001），RCS证实CHG指数与复发风险呈近似线性相关。将CHG指数加入基线临床模型显著改善预测效能（IDI=0.092，连续NRI=0.542；均P < 0.001）。年龄、高血压、糖尿病亚组存在交互作用（交互P均<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: CHG指数可独立预测RFCA术后房颤复发，加入传统风险模型能提高判别能力和风险分层，支持其用于个体化复发评估的临床价值。但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，结论需前瞻性多中心验证，且CHG指数的具体应用阈值和干预策略尚待明确。

summary_zh: 射频导管消融（RFCA）是心房颤动（AF）的主要节律控制治疗，但术后高复发率限制了其长期获益。需要经济有效的术前生物标志物来优化个体化风险分层。本研究评估了胆固醇-高密度脂蛋白-葡萄糖（CHG）指数对RFCA术后AF复发的预测性能。本回顾性队列纳入625例连续的非瓣膜性AF患者，这些患者接受了首次RFCA（2020-2024年）并具有完整的12个月随访。受试者被分为复发组和非复发组。多变量Cox回归确定了复发的独立预测因素。ROC曲线量化了CHG指数的预测能力和最佳截断值。采用Kaplan-Meier法、限制性立方样条（RCS）、DeLong检验、连续NRI、IDI和DCA评估其线性关联和增量预后价值。亚组交互分析进一步验证了跨临床亚组的预测一致性。12个月AF复发率为28.2%（176/625）。CHG指数作为独立的复发危险因素出现，AUC为0.698（95% CI 0.651–0.745），最佳截断值为5.20。较高的CHG指数对应于累积复发风险升高（Log-rank P < 0.001），RCS证实CHG指数与复发风险之间呈近似线性相关。将CHG指数加入基线临床模型显著改善了预测（IDI = 0.092，连续NRI = 0.542；均P < 0.001）。年龄、高血压和糖尿病存在亚组交互作用（交互作用P均< 0.05）。CHG指数独立预测RFCA术后AF复发。将CHG指数加入传统风险模型可改善区分度和风险分层，支持其用于个体化复发评估的临床效用。

title: Integrated bioinformatics and clinical validation of oxidative stress-associated genes in atrial fibrillation and chronic kidney disease.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) frequently coexist and worsen cardiovascular and renal outcomes. Oxidative stress (OS) contributes to both conditions, yet the OS-associated genes shared between the two conditions remain unclear. The present study aimed to identify OS-associated genes common to AF and CKD and explore potential therapeutic targets for AF-CKD comorbidity. Public microarray data for AF and CKD were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were intersected with OS-associated genes to identify candidates, which then underwent functional enrichment and pathway analyses. A protein-protein interaction network was constructed to identify hub genes and three machine learning algorithms (Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator, support vector machine and random forest) obtained the final targets. Cell-type Identification by Estimating Relative Subsets of RNA Transcripts was used to estimate immune cell composition and assess the associations between target gene expression and immune cell subsets. Gene set variation analysis was used to delineate pathways associated with target genes. Transcription factor and microRNA regulatory networks were inferred using NetworkAnalyst and the Connectivity Map (CMap) database was queried to identify candidate small-molecule modulators. Target genes were validated in the peripheral blood of controls and patients with AF, CKD or concomitant AF and CKD. A total of 75 overlapping DEGs were identified between AF and CKD, 28 of which were associated with OS. Through a screening process integrating the three machine learning algorithms, three hub target genes were identified: BTG anti-proliferation factor 2 (BTG2), ZFP36 zinc finger CCCH-type (ZFP36) and natriuretic peptide B (NPPB). CMap analysis further suggested a number of candidate therapeutic compounds, such as histone deacetylase inhibitors, cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitors and proteasome inhibitors. In clinical samples, BTG2 and ZFP36 mRNA expression levels, as well as the concentrations of N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide, encoded by natriuretic peptide B (NPPB), were found to be significantly different between the control and disease groups. The present study identified BTG2, ZFP36 and NPPB as key OS-associated genes in AF and CKD. Furthermore, the three target genes were validated in human peripheral blood, supporting their potential as candidate biomarkers and therapeutic targets for cardiorenal comorbidities.

AI.tldr: 生物信息学分析鉴定出BTG2、ZFP36和NPPB为房颤与慢性肾脏病共有的氧化应激相关关键基因，并在患者外周血中验证其表达差异。
AI.motivation: 房颤与慢性肾脏病常共存并相互恶化，氧化应激参与两者发病，但共享的氧化应激相关基因不明，缺乏共病生物标志物和 therapeutic target。
AI.method: 研究整合GEO公共微阵列数据，筛选房颤和CKD的差异表达基因并与氧化应激基因取交集，进行功能富集和通路分析，构建蛋白互作网络，用LASSO、SVM和随机森林三种机器学习算法筛选核心基因，CIBERSORT评估免疫细胞浸润，GSVA分析通路，NetworkAnalyst推断转录因子和microRNA调控网络，CMap数据库查询候选小分子药物，并在对照和房颤、CKD及共病患者外周血中验证目标基因表达。
AI.result: 共识别75个房颤与CKD重叠差异表达基因，其中28个与氧化应激相关；三种机器学习算法筛选出BTG2、ZFP36和NPPB三个核心基因。CMap分析提示组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂、细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶抑制剂和蛋白酶体抑制剂等候选化合物。临床样本验证显示，BTG2和ZFP36 mRNA表达水平及NT-proBNP浓度在对照组与疾病组间有显著差异（具体数值摘要未报告）。
AI.conclusion: BTG2、ZFP36和NPPB是房颤与CKD共有的氧化应激相关关键基因，并在人外周血中验证，可能作为心肾共病的候选生物标志物和治疗靶点；但研究为生物信息学预测结合小样本验证，临床转化价值需进一步前瞻性研究确认。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AF）和慢性肾脏病（CKD）常共存，并恶化心血管和肾脏结局。氧化应激（OS）参与这两种疾病，但两者共有的OS相关基因仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在识别AF和CKD共有的OS相关基因，并探索AF-CKD共病的潜在治疗靶点。方法：从Gene Expression Omnibus获取AF和CKD的公共微阵列数据。将差异表达基因（DEGs）与OS相关基因取交集以识别候选基因，随后进行功能富集和通路分析。构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络以识别枢纽基因，并通过三种机器学习算法（最小绝对收缩和选择算子、支持向量机和随机森林）获得最终靶点。使用通过估计RNA转录本相对子集进行细胞类型识别的方法估计免疫细胞组成，并评估靶基因表达与免疫细胞亚群之间的关联。使用基因集变异分析描绘与靶基因相关的通路。使用NetworkAnalyst推断转录因子和microRNA调控网络，并查询连接图谱（CMap）数据库以识别候选小分子调节剂。在对照组以及AF、CKD或AF合并CKD患者的外周血中验证靶基因。结果：在AF和CKD之间共识别出75个重叠DEGs，其中28个与OS相关。通过整合三种机器学习算法的筛选过程，识别出三个枢纽靶基因：BTG抗增殖因子2（BTG2）、ZFP36锌指CCCH型（ZFP36）和利钠肽B（NPPB）。CMap分析进一步提示了一些候选治疗化合物，如组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂、细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶抑制剂和蛋白酶体抑制剂。在临床样本中，发现BTG2和ZFP36 mRNA表达水平以及由利钠肽B（NPPB）编码的N末端B型利钠肽前体浓度在对照组和疾病组之间存在显著差异。结论：本研究识别出BTG2、ZFP36和NPPB作为AF和CKD中的关键OS相关基因。此外，这三个靶基因在人类外周血中得到验证，支持它们作为心肾共病的候选生物标志物和治疗靶点的潜力。

title: ANGPTL2 and CP define complementary circadian-associated signals in atrial fibrillation: integrative transcriptomics and external validation.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Atrial fibrillation (AF) develops through the interplay of electrical, structural, inflammatory, and metabolic remodeling. However, the circadian-associated molecular characteristics of the diseased human atrium remain incompletely understood.

METHODS: We integrated differential expression analysis, circadian gene intersection, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, and complementary feature selection algorithms in a discovery cohort. The prioritized candidate genes were subsequently validated using an independent atrial dataset, human atrial rhythmicity data, single-nucleus transcriptomics, and experimental evidence derived from human and mouse atrial tissues. We additionally performed cross-cohort drug repurposing screening and exploratory molecular docking.

RESULTS: ANGPTL2 and CP were identified as prioritized candidate genes associated with circadian rhythms. Both genes were consistently upregulated in fibrillating atria but exhibited distinct expression profiles: ANGPTL2 demonstrated stronger discriminatory power at the tissue level, whereas CP showed a larger but more heterogeneous expression alteration. Both genes displayed rhythmic expression patterns in human atrial appendage tissue and were predominantly enriched in vascular and stromal cell populations, establishing a link between temporal atrial biology and inflammatory-metabolic remodeling as well as copper-redox remodeling. The upregulation of their transcripts and proteins was further validated across independent human samples and an arrhythmia-prone mouse model. No compound met the prespecified multi-source criteria for cross-cohort drug repurposing. An independent exploratory analysis of clinically used antiarrhythmic drugs identified favorable molecular docking profiles for both target proteins.

DISCUSSION: ANGPTL2 and CP are externally validated circadian rhythm-associated candidate genes for atrial fibrillation (AF), and may yield experimentally testable candidate gene-drug pairs. However, these findings do not establish causal regulation by the circadian clock, direct molecular binding, or clinical therapeutic efficacy.

AI.tldr: ANGPTL2和CP被鉴定为房颤中与昼夜节律相关的候选基因，在颤动心房中上调并呈节律表达，主要富集于血管和基质细胞，但未证实因果调控或临床疗效。
AI.motivation: 房颤涉及电重构、结构重构、炎症和代谢重构，但人类病变心房的昼夜节律相关分子特征尚不清楚，需要探索新的分子标志物和干预靶点。
AI.method: 在发现队列中整合差异表达分析、昼夜节律基因交集、加权基因共表达网络分析和互补特征选择算法，筛选候选基因；随后在独立心房数据集、人类心房节律数据、单核转录组及人和小鼠心房组织实验证据中进行验证；并进行跨队列药物重定位筛选和探索性分子对接。
AI.result: ANGPTL2和CP被优先确定为与昼夜节律相关的候选基因，在颤动心房中均持续上调但表达谱不同：ANGPTL2在组织水平区分能力更强，CP变化幅度更大但异质性更高；两基因在人心房附件组织中呈节律表达，主要富集于血管和基质细胞群；其转录本和蛋白上调在独立人类样本和心律失常倾向小鼠模型中得到验证；无化合物满足预设的多源跨队列药物重定位标准；对临床抗心律失常药物的探索性分析显示两个靶蛋白有良好的分子对接特征。
AI.conclusion: ANGPTL2和CP是外部验证的房颤昼夜节律相关候选基因，可能提供可实验测试的候选基因-药物配对，但未确立昼夜节律钟的因果调控、直接分子结合或临床治疗疗效，需进一步研究。

summary_zh:
引言：心房颤动（AF）通过电学、结构、炎症和代谢重构的相互作用而发生。然而，病变人类心房的昼夜节律相关分子特征仍未被完全理解。

方法：我们在一个发现队列中整合了差异表达分析、昼夜节律基因交集、加权基因共表达网络分析和互补特征选择算法。优先候选基因随后使用独立心房数据集、人类心房节律性数据、单核转录组学以及源自人类和小鼠心房组织的实验证据进行验证。我们额外进行了跨队列药物重定位筛选和探索性分子对接。

结果：ANGPTL2和CP被鉴定为与昼夜节律相关的优先候选基因。两个基因在颤动心房中均一致上调，但表现出不同的表达谱：ANGPTL2在组织水平显示出更强的区分能力，而CP显示出更大但更异质的表达改变。两个基因在人类心耳组织中均显示节律性表达模式，并主要富集于血管和基质细胞群，建立了时间性心房生物学与炎症-代谢重构以及铜-氧化还原重构之间的联系。它们的转录本和蛋白质的上调在独立人类样本和心律失常易感小鼠模型中得到进一步验证。没有化合物满足跨队列药物重定位的预设多源标准。对临床使用抗心律失常药物的独立探索性分析确定了两个靶蛋白的有利分子对接谱。

讨论：ANGPTL2和CP是经外部验证的房颤（AF）昼夜节律相关候选基因，并可能产生可实验测试的候选基因-药物对。然而，这些发现并未确立昼夜节律钟的因果调控、直接分子结合或临床治疗疗效。

title: Left atrial appendage morphology and hemodynamics: potential new markers for individualized thromboembolic risk assessment in atrial fibrillation
summary: Background Traditional CHA₂DS₂-VASc scoring has well-recognized limitations in thromboembolic risk assessment for atrial fibrillation (AF), particularly in low-score patients who nevertheless thrombose, high-score event-free individuals, cancer patients, and post-ablation cohorts. The left atrial appendage (LAA) is the source of 98% of thrombi in non-valvular AF and exhibits marked inter-individual morphological and hemodynamic variability that traditional scores completely ignore. Aims This narrative review critically evaluates current evidence on LAA morphology, hemodynamics, computational fluid dynamics/fluid-structure interaction (CFD/FSI) studies, and digital twin technology, and proposes a mechanism-driven, individualized risk assessment framework for AF-related thromboembolism. Methods A literature search was conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE and Web of Science (1990–May 2026) using combinations of keywords related to LAA morphology, hemodynamics, AF, and thromboembolism. Priority was given to landmark original studies, high-quality observational studies with multivariable adjustment, meta-analyses, and contemporary CFD/digital twin studies. A narrative synthesis was adopted owing to heterogeneity in study designs and outcomes. Results LAA morphological subtypes are associated with long-term stroke risk, with chicken-wing being protective (OR 0.21, 95% CI 0.05–0.91) and cauliflower carrying the highest risk (OR 8.02, 95% CI 0.92–27.86). However, risk is highly context-dependent, with chicken-wing unexpectedly increasing peri-ablation thromboembolic risk (OR 7.2, 95% CI 1.35–38.33) and windsock morphology independently predicting post-ablation AF recurrence (OR 2.72, 95% CI 1.21–6.12). Importantly, traditional morphological classification does not correlate directly with blood stasis ( p = 0.365), whereas quantitative geometric parameters such as trabecular number, normalized stroke volume, and ostial area are far more sensitive predictors (R² = 74%). Digital twins integrating multimodal clinical, morphological, and hemodynamic data identify a high-risk phenogroup with a 70% thrombus history rate. Conclusion Based on these findings, we propose a practical two-tier assessment framework combining basic morphological classification with multimodal refined evaluation (digital twin) for intermediate-/high-risk or clinically challenging cases. This framework represents a paradigm shift from static clinical scores toward mechanism-driven, individualized risk management. Prospective validation of this approach is now warranted.

AI.tldr: 左心耳形态与血流动力学指标可弥补CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分的不足，基于数字孪生的两层评估框架有望实现房颤血栓栓塞风险的个体化评估。
AI.motivation: 传统CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分在低评分却发生血栓、高评分无事件、肿瘤及消融后人群中的风险评估存在明显局限，且完全忽略了左心耳（非瓣膜性房颤98%血栓来源）的形态与血流动力学个体差异，亟需机制驱动的个体化评估工具。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，检索PubMed/MEDLINE和Web of Science（1990年至2026年5月）有关左心耳形态、血流动力学、房颤与血栓栓塞的文献，优先纳入标志性原始研究、多变量调整的高质量观察性研究、荟萃分析及计算流体力学/数字孪生研究，因研究异质性采用叙述性综合。
AI.result: 鸡翅型左心耳与较低长期卒中风险相关（OR 0.21，95%CI 0.05–0.91），菜花型风险最高（OR 8.02，95%CI 0.92–27.86）；但风险高度依赖情境，鸡翅型反而增加围消融期血栓栓塞风险（OR 7.2，95%CI 1.35–38.33），风向袋型独立预测消融后房颤复发（OR 2.72，95%CI 1.21–6.12）。传统形态分类与血液淤滞不直接相关（p=0.365），而小梁数目、标准化每搏输出量、开口面积等定量几何参数预测更敏感（R²=74%）。整合多模态数据的数字孪生可识别血栓史率高达70%的高危表型组。
AI.conclusion: 提出结合基本形态分类与多模态精细评估（数字孪生）的两层评估框架，用于中高危或临床疑难病例，代表从静态临床评分向机制驱动个体化风险管理的范式转变，但需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：传统 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 评分在房颤（AF）血栓栓塞风险评估中存在公认的局限性，尤其是在低评分却发生血栓栓塞的患者、高评分但无事件个体、癌症患者以及消融术后队列中。左心耳（LAA）是非瓣膜性 AF 中 98% 血栓的来源，并表现出显著的个体间形态学和血流动力学变异，而传统评分完全忽略了这些变异。

目的：本叙述性综述批判性评估关于 LAA 形态学、血流动力学、计算流体动力学/流固耦合（CFD/FSI）研究以及数字孪生技术的当前证据，并提出一个机制驱动的、个体化的 AF 相关血栓栓塞风险评估框架。

方法：在 PubMed/MEDLINE 和 Web of Science（1990 年至 2026 年 5 月）中使用与 LAA 形态学、血流动力学、AF 和血栓栓塞相关的关键词组合进行文献检索。优先考虑具有里程碑意义的原创研究、采用多变量调整的高质量观察性研究、荟萃分析以及当代 CFD/数字孪生研究。由于研究设计和结局的异质性，采用叙述性综合。

结果：LAA 形态学亚型与长期卒中风险相关，鸡翅型具有保护作用（OR 0.21，95% CI 0.05–0.91），而菜花型风险最高（OR 8.02，95% CI 0.92–27.86）。然而，风险高度依赖于背景，鸡翅型意外地增加围消融期血栓栓塞风险（OR 7.2，95% CI 1.35–38.33），而风向袋型形态独立预测消融术后 AF 复发（OR 2.72，95% CI 1.21–6.12）。重要的是，传统形态学分类与血液淤滞不直接相关（p = 0.365），而定量几何参数如小梁数目、归一化每搏输出量和开口面积是更敏感的预测指标（R² = 74%）。整合多模态临床、形态学和血流动力学数据的数字孪生识别出一个高风险表型组，其血栓病史率为 70%。

结论：基于这些发现，我们提出了一个实用的两层评估框架，将基本形态学分类与多模态精细评估（数字孪生）相结合，用于中/高风险或临床具有挑战性的病例。该框架代表了从静态临床评分向机制驱动的个体化风险管理的范式转变。现在有必要对该方法进行前瞻性验证。

title: Efficacy and Safety of Flecainide Versus Amiodarone for the Cardioversion of paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Coronary Artery Disease without evidence of residual ischemia: The FLECA-ED Randomized Clinical Trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Flecainide has been contraindicated in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD) since the Cardiac Arrhythmia Suppression Trial.

OBJECTIVE: We compared intravenous flecainide with intravenous amiodarone for cardioversion of recent-onset paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF) in patients with documented CAD without residual or active ischemia presenting to the emergency department.

METHODS: In this investigator-initiated, multicenter, open-label, randomized trial, adults with paroxysmal AF and CAD without residual or active ischemia were assigned 1:1 to intravenous flecainide or amiodarone. All patients underwent 24-hour ambulatory ECG monitoring. The primary efficacy end point was conversion to sinus rhythm within 6 hours. The primary safety end point was the composite of nonsustained ventricular tachycardia, ventricular tachycardia, premature ventricular complexes, significant hypotension, and bradycardia below 50 bpm within 6 hours.

RESULTS: Eighty-seven patients underwent randomization (42 flecainide, 45 amiodarone). Conversion to sinus rhythm within 6 hours occurred in 85.7% of patients in the flecainide group and 40.0% in the amiodarone group (P<0.001). Median time to conversion was 20 minutes versus 244 minutes (P<0.001), and hospital admission occurred in 14.3% versus 60.0%, respectively (P<0.001). No ventricular proarrhythmic events occurred within 24 hours in either group and no deaths were recorded through 30 days.

CONCLUSION: In patients with paroxysmal AF and CAD without evidence of residual and active ischemia, intravenous flecainide was superior to amiodarone for acute cardioversion, with faster conversion to sinus rhythm and fewer hospital admissions. No serious ventricular proarrhythmia through 24 hours was observed, a hypothesis-generating finding.

AI.tldr: 在无残余缺血的冠心病合并阵发性房颤患者中，静脉氟卡尼6小时内转复窦律优于胺碘酮（85.7% vs 40.0%），且不增加室性致心律失常事件。
AI.motivation: 氟卡尼因CAST试验结果在冠心病患者中列为禁忌，但该禁忌是否适用于无残余或活动性缺血的冠心病患者尚不明确，缺乏随机对照证据。
AI.method: 研究者发起的多中心、开放标签、随机对照试验，纳入急诊就诊的阵发性房颤合并冠心病且无残余或活动性缺血的成人患者，1:1随机接受静脉氟卡尼或胺碘酮，共87例（氟卡尼42例，胺碘酮45例）。所有患者接受24小时动态心电图监测。主要疗效终点为6小时内转复窦性心律；主要安全终点为6小时内非持续性室速、室速、室性早搏、显著低血压及心率低于50次/分的复合终点。
AI.result: 6小时内转复窦律率氟卡尼组为85.7%，胺碘酮组为40.0%（P<0.001）；中位转复时间分别为20分钟和244分钟（P<0.001）；住院率分别为14.3%和60.0%（P<0.001）。两组24小时内均未发生室性致心律失常事件，30天内无死亡。
AI.conclusion: 在无残余及活动性缺血的冠心病合并阵发性房颤患者中，静脉氟卡尼急性转复窦律优于胺碘酮，转复更快、住院更少，24小时内未观察到严重室性致心律失常，但样本量小，该安全性发现仅为假设生成性，需更大规模研究验证。

背景：自心律失常抑制试验（CAST）以来，氟卡尼在冠状动脉疾病（CAD）患者中一直被视为禁忌。

目的：我们比较了静脉注射氟卡尼与静脉注射胺碘酮在因近期发作的阵发性心房颤动（AF）就诊于急诊科、且有CAD记录但无残余或活动性缺血的患者中转复心律的效果。

方法：在这项由研究者发起、多中心、开放标签、随机试验中，患有阵发性AF和CAD但无残余或活动性缺血的成人按1:1随机分配至静脉注射氟卡尼或胺碘酮组。所有患者均接受24小时动态心电图监测。主要疗效终点为6小时内转复为窦性心律。主要安全性终点为6小时内非持续性室性心动过速、室性心动过速、室性早搏、显著低血压和心率低于50次/分的窦性心动过缓的复合终点。

结论：在阵发性AF和CAD且无残余及活动性缺血证据的患者中，静脉注射氟卡尼在急性转复心律方面优于胺碘酮，转复窦性心律更快且住院次数更少。24小时内未观察到严重的心室致心律失常，这是一个产生假设的发现。

title: Clinical Implications of Hemolysis after Pulsed Field Ablation - What Can We Learn from Benchtop Models and Preclinical Experiments.
summary: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has emerged as a transformative technology for cardiac ablation due to its efficiency and favorable safety profile. However, intravascular hemolysis has been increasingly recognized adverse effect across preclinical and clinical studies, infrequently progressing to acute kidney injury (AKI). The mechanisms, determinants, and clinical relevance of PFA-related hemolysis remain incompletely understood. Herein, we review the pathophysiology of PFA-related hemolysis and measures to mitigate its occurrence, discuss the biomarker-related changes and perform a comprehensive review of preclinical hemolysis models. Continued development of physiological benchtop models including numerical models to better understand PFA-related hemolysis and translation to bedside is needed. Furthermore, transparent cross-platform evaluation of hemolysis will be critical in the light of rapidly evolving PFA technologies.

AI.tldr: 脉冲场消融（PFA）相关血管内溶血是日益被认识的不良反应，偶可进展为急性肾损伤，其机制、决定因素和临床意义尚不完全清楚，需通过生理性台架模型和跨平台评估来深入理解并减轻其发生。

title: Safety and Efficacy of Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) are prevalent conditions linked by multiple shared risk factors.

OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to compare periprocedural safety and long-term efficacy outcomes of pulsed field ablation (PFA) for AF in patients with and without CKD.

METHODS: Consecutive patients from a major health system in the United States were included in the analysis. Based on baseline eGFR, patients were categorized as no CKD, mild CKD (eGFR ≥45 mL/min/1.73 m2), moderate CKD (eGFR 30-44 mL/min/1.73 m2), and advanced CKD (eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2). Periprocedural safety was assessed based on the occurrence of non-renal procedural complications and acute kidney injury (AKI). For long-term analysis, AF recurrence-free survival was compared.

RESULTS: A total of 2,269 patients were included: 1,829 without CKD, 314 with mild CKD, 103 with moderate CKD, and 23 with advanced CKD. Mean age was 66.9 (±10.2) years and 716 (31.6%) patients were female. Non-renal procedural complications occurred in 5.9% of patients; after multivariable adjustment, no CKD category was independently associated with this outcome. AKI occurred in 4.9% of patients with available post-procedural renal function data. A decreased eGFR was independently associated with AKI (OR 0.96, 95% CI 0.94-0.99 P<0.01). Estimated 12-month AF-free survival was comparable between patients with and without CKD (HR 1.20; 95% CI 0.93-1.59; P=0.1).

CONCLUSION: PFA for AF is feasible in patients with CKD. However, patients with a decreased eGFR had a significantly higher risk of AKI and presented a numerically higher rate of non-renal complications.

AI.tldr: 在2269例接受PFA的AF患者中，CKD各期均未独立增加非肾脏并发症，但基线eGFR每降低1 mL/min/1.73 m²与术后AKI风险独立相关（OR 0.96），12个月无AF复发生存率在CKD与非CKD间无显著差异。
AI.motivation: AF与CKD常共存且共享多种危险因素，但PFA这一新型消融能量在CKD人群中的围术期安全性和长期疗效证据有限，临床亟需明确肾功能不全是否影响PFA的风险-获益平衡。
AI.method: 基于美国大型医疗系统的连续病例分析，共纳入2269例接受PFA的AF患者，按基线eGFR分为无CKD（1829例）、轻度CKD（eGFR≥45，314例）、中度CKD（eGFR 30-44，103例）和晚期CKD（eGFR<30，23例）。围术期安全终点为非肾脏手术并发症和急性肾损伤（AKI），长期终点为无AF复发生存；采用多因素校正分析及生存分析比较组间差异。
AI.result: 平均年龄66.9±10.2岁，女性716例（31.6%）。非肾脏并发症发生率5.9%，多因素校正后无任何CKD分级与之一独立相关。在有术后肾功能数据的患者中AKI发生率为4.9%，eGFR降低与AKI独立相关（OR 0.96，95%CI 0.94-0.99，P<0.01）。估计12个月无AF生存率在CKD与非CKD患者间相当（HR 1.20，95%CI 0.93-1.59，P=0.1）。
AI.conclusion: PFA用于CKD合并AF患者总体可行，长期节律控制效果与非CKD患者相近，但eGFR降低显著增加术后AKI风险，非肾脏并发症也呈数值升高趋势。提示对CKD患者应加强围术期肾功能监测与容量管理；晚期CKD亚组样本量小（23例），结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）和慢性肾脏病（CKD）是常见的疾病，由多种共同危险因素相关联。

目的：本研究旨在比较接受脉冲场消融（PFA）治疗AF的CKD患者与非CKD患者的围术期安全性和长期疗效结局。

方法：分析纳入了来自美国一家大型健康系统的连续患者。根据基线eGFR，患者被分类为无CKD、轻度CKD（eGFR ≥45 mL/min/1.73 m2）、中度CKD（eGFR 30-44 mL/min/1.73 m2）和晚期CKD（eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2）。围术期安全性基于非肾脏手术并发症和急性肾损伤（AKI）的发生进行评估。对于长期分析，比较了无AF复发生存率。

结果：共纳入2,269例患者：1,829例无CKD，314例轻度CKD，103例中度CKD，23例晚期CKD。平均年龄为66.9（±10.2）岁，716例（31.6%）患者为女性。非肾脏手术并发症发生于5.9%的患者；经过多变量调整后，没有CKD类别与该结局独立相关。在有术后肾功能数据的患者中，4.9%发生AKI。eGFR降低与AKI独立相关（OR 0.96，95% CI 0.94-0.99 P<0.01）。估计12个月无AF生存率在CKD患者与非CKD患者之间相当（HR 1.20；95% CI 0.93-1.59；P=0.1）。

title: Heart Rhythm Society and Heart Rhythm Advocates position statement: Prior authorization in cardiac electrophysiology: Evidence, policy, and reform
summary: Prior authorization (PA) requirements imposed by Medicare Advantage (MA) and commercial insurers have evolved into a systematic barrier to guideline-indicated cardiac electrophysiology (EP) care, producing measurable patient harm, substantial administrative burden on physicians and allied professionals, and widening health care disparities. This paper examines the financial architecture of the MA capitation model and the structural incentives it creates for denial, characterizes the root causes of the denial system, including third-party denial organizations, artificial intelligence-based algorithms, and opaque coverage criteria; reviews federal oversight findings from the Office of Inspector General and the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, and analyzes procedure-specific denial patterns for catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation, implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy, left atrial appendage occlusion, and cardiac resynchronization therapy with defibrillation. Federal audit data establish that a substantial proportion of denied PA requests meet Medicare's own coverage criteria and that the majority of appealed denials are overturned, yet most wrongful denials go uncontested. Clinical outcome data confirm that PA delays have direct clinical consequences across EP procedure categories. The regulatory and legislative landscape-spanning Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services rulemaking from 2023 to 2026 and pending congressional action-is reviewed, and the paper concludes with a structured framework for appeals strategy, institutional advocacy, and physician-level engagement.

AI.tldr: 该立场声明指出，医保优势计划和商业保险的预先授权要求已成为指南指示电生理诊疗的系统性障碍，导致患者伤害和行政负担，需通过申诉策略和政策改革应对。

title: Electrogram Determinants of Acute Electrogram Attenuation During Pulmonary Vein Pulsed Field Ablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is a nonthermal modality for pulmonary vein isolation in atrial fibrillation. Whether baseline intracardiac electrogram characteristics are associated with acute electrogram attenuation during PFA remains unclear.

OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the individual and combined associations of baseline bipolar amplitude and peak frequency (PF) with acute electrogram attenuation during pulmonary vein PFA.

METHODS: Thirty-four consecutive patients undergoing pulmonary vein PFA were retrospectively analyzed. Paired bipolar electrograms were recorded immediately before and after the first PFA application from the same electrode pair and catheter position. Logistic regression, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, and nonlinear Hill modeling were performed. Additional analyses accounted for within-patient clustering and evaluated alternative attenuation thresholds, pulmonary vein regional heterogeneity, and dynamic-range constraints.

RESULTS: Among 687 electrograms analyzed, marked attenuation (≥ 80%) occurred in 59.1%. Both baseline amplitude and PF were significantly associated with marked attenuation. ROC analysis demonstrated strong discrimination for amplitude (AUC 0.894) and moderate discrimination for PF (AUC 0.722), with ROC-derived cutoffs of 0.58 mV and 206 Hz, respectively. Both parameters remained independently associated with attenuation in multivariable analysis. Nonlinear modeling demonstrated distinct response patterns, with amplitude showing a gradual, broad dynamic-range relationship and PF exhibiting a steeper, threshold-like transition. Integration of amplitude and PF enabled graded stratification of attenuation across combined electrogram domains. These associations were preserved after accounting for within-patient clustering and were directionally consistent across alternative attenuation thresholds.

CONCLUSIONS: Baseline bipolar amplitude and PF were independently associated with acute electrogram attenuation during pulmonary vein PFA. Their integration provides complementary, non-redundant information and supports a structured electrogram-based framework for interpreting acute electrogram response. These findings are hypothesis-generating and require validation against durable pulmonary vein isolation, late reconnection, and clinical outcomes.

AI.tldr: 基线双极振幅和峰值频率与肺静脉脉冲场消融中急性电图衰减独立相关，联合应用可分层预测衰减程度。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）是房颤肺静脉隔离的非热消融方式，但基线心内电图特征是否与PFA急性电图衰减相关尚不明确，本研究旨在评估基线双极振幅和峰值频率（PF）与急性电图衰减的独立及联合关联。
AI.method: 回顾性分析34例连续接受肺静脉PFA的患者，在首次PFA应用前后从同一电极对和导管位置记录配对双极电图。采用逻辑回归、ROC分析和非线性Hill建模，并考虑患者内聚类、替代衰减阈值、肺静脉区域异质性和动态范围限制。
AI.result: 共分析687个电图，显著衰减（≥80%）发生率为59.1%。基线振幅和PF均与显著衰减显著相关。ROC分析显示振幅强区分度（AUC 0.894），PF中等区分度（AUC 0.722），ROC衍生截断值分别为0.58 mV和206 Hz。多变量分析中两者均独立相关。非线性建模显示振幅呈渐进宽动态范围关系，PF呈陡峭阈值样转变。联合振幅和PF可实现衰减的梯度分层。考虑患者内聚类后关联仍存在，替代衰减阈值下方向一致。
AI.conclusion: 基线双极振幅和PF与肺静脉PFA急性电图衰减独立相关，联合提供互补非冗余信息，支持基于电图的结构化框架解读急性电图反应。这些发现是假设生成性的，需针对持久肺静脉隔离、晚期重连和临床结局进行验证。

方法：回顾性分析34例连续接受肺静脉PFA的患者。在首次PFA应用前后，从相同的电极对和导管位置立即记录配对双极电图。进行逻辑回归、受试者工作特征（ROC）分析和非线性Hill建模。额外分析考虑了患者内聚类，并评估了替代衰减阈值、肺静脉区域异质性和动态范围限制。

结果：在分析的687份电图中，显著衰减（≥ 80%）发生在59.1%。基线振幅和PF均与显著衰减显著相关。ROC分析显示振幅具有强区分度（AUC 0.894），PF具有中等区分度（AUC 0.722），ROC衍生的截断值分别为0.58 mV和206 Hz。在多变量分析中，两个参数均与衰减保持独立关联。非线性建模显示了不同的响应模式，振幅呈现逐渐、广泛的动态范围关系，而PF表现出更陡峭的阈值样过渡。振幅和PF的整合使得在联合电图域中对衰减进行分级分层成为可能。在考虑患者内聚类后，这些关联得以保留，并且在替代衰减阈值下方向一致。

结论：基线双极振幅和PF与肺静脉PFA期间的急性电图衰减独立相关。它们的整合提供了互补的、非冗余的信息，并支持一个基于电图的结构化框架来解释急性电图反应。这些发现是假设生成性的，需要针对持久肺静脉隔离、晚期重连和临床结果进行验证。

title: Enhancing Persistent Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: The Added Value of Vein of Marshall Ethanol Infusion in a Tailored Strategy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Outcomes following catheter ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) remain suboptimal. Low-voltage areas (LVA), as a surrogate for atrial fibrosis, have been targeted due to their association with arrhythmia recurrence. Ethanol infusion in the vein of Marshall (VoM) has emerged as an adjunctive strategy that may enhance ablation efficacy. We evaluated the effectiveness of a tailored ablation strategy guided by the presence of LVA and incorporating VoM ethanol infusion in patients with persistent AF.

METHODS: This prospective, single-center study included patients referred for catheter ablation for persistent AF ablation between August 2022 and August 2024. Patients underwent a tailored ablation strategy guided by the presence of LVA. Procedural endpoints and 1-year outcomes were assessed and compared with those of a propensity score-matched cohort undergoing pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) alone.

RESULTS: A total of 118 patients (71% male, mean age of 62 ± 10years) were included in our study: 59 in the tailored approach group and 59 propensity score-matched controls. In the tailored group, VoM ethanol infusion was performed in 60% of patients, while ablation beyond pulmonary veins was not performed in 14% of patients due to LVA absence. Bidirectional block was achieved in all ablation lines except in two patients. At 1-year follow-up, 22% of patients had atrial arrhythmia recurrence. The risk of recurrence was significantly lower in the tailored approach group (13.5% vs. 30.5%, p = 0.02). A tailored approach was independently associated with freedom from atrial arrhythmia recurrence (HR 0.41 [0.17-0.94], p = 0.04). No significant differences in adverse events were observed between groups.

CONCLUSIONS: In patients with persistent AF, a tailored ablation guided by LVAs was associated with significantly lower arrhythmia recurrence at 1-year compared with PVI alone.

AI.method: 前瞻性单中心研究，纳入2022年8月至2024年8月接受导管消融的持续性房颤患者，采用基于LVA的个体化消融策略（n=59），并与倾向性评分匹配的单纯PVI队列（n=59）比较。评估手术终点和1年结局，统计方法包括倾向性评分匹配和Cox回归分析。
AI.result: 共118例患者（71%男性，平均年龄62±10岁）。个体化组中60%接受VoM乙醇灌注，14%因无LVA未行肺静脉外消融；除2例外所有消融线均达到双向阻滞。1年随访时，个体化组房性心律失常复发率显著低于对照组（13.5% vs 30.5%，p=0.02），个体化策略与无复发独立相关（HR 0.41 [0.17-0.94]，p=0.04）。两组不良事件无显著差异。

title: Impact of Ganglionated Plexus Ablation on Early Recurrence After Thoracoscopic Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: A Post Hoc Analysis of the AFACT Study.
authors: Nicoline W E van den Berg
Jonas S S G de Jong
summary:
BACKGROUND: Early recurrences of atrial fibrillation (AF) after ablation are often considered transient. However, they may be caused by a combination of temporary and permanent proarrhythmogenic factors.

OBJECTIVE: We evaluated whether adjunctive GP ablation was associated with the timing and clinical implications of early AF recurrence, and explored the hypothesis that autonomic mechanisms contribute to early recurrence.

METHODS: Using data from the randomized AFACT study, we compared patients with advanced AF who underwent stand-alone thoracoscopic ablation with or without GP ablation. Early recurrence was defined as AF or atrial tachycardia recurrence within 90 days postoperative. Cox models were used to assess time-dependent effects and identify clinical predictors.

RESULTS: A total of 235 patients were included in the current analysis. Seventy-one patients had early recurrence: 36 in the GP ablation group and 35 in the non-GP ablation group (p = 0.730). Of these, 45 (63%) occurred within the first 30 days. Patients in the GP ablation group had their first recurrence later than those in the non-GP group (24 [14-34] vs. 14 [11-24] days, p = 0.046). In the GP ablation group, markers of arrhythmogenic substrate (i.e., age, left atrial volume index, diabetes, CHA2DS2-VASc score, and persistent AF) were associated with early recurrence. Additionally, early recurrence was associated with late recurrence in the GP ablation group, but not in the non-GP ablation group.

CONCLUSION: Adjunctive GP ablation was associated with later onset of first early recurrence, while the overall early recurrence rate was not reduced. In the GP ablation group, early recurrence was associated with subsequent late recurrence. These exploratory findings are compatible with a model in which early recurrence reflects both transient autonomic triggers and pre-existing substrate, but this mechanism remains hypothesis-generating.

CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT01091389.

AI.tldr: 在晚期房颤胸腔镜消融中，辅助GP消融未减少早期复发率，但使首次早期复发时间推迟，且GP消融组早期复发与晚期复发相关。
AI.motivation: 消融术后早期房颤复发常被视为一过性，但可能由暂时性和永久性致心律失常因素共同导致。本研究旨在评估辅助神经节丛（GP）消融是否影响早期复发的时机和临床意义，并探讨自主神经机制在早期复发中的作用。
AI.method: 本研究为AFACT随机试验的事后分析，纳入235例接受单纯胸腔镜消融的晚期房颤患者，比较辅助GP消融组与非GP消融组。早期复发定义为术后90天内房颤或房性心动过速复发。采用Cox模型评估时间依赖效应并识别临床预测因素。
AI.result: 共71例患者出现早期复发，GP消融组36例，非GP消融组35例（p=0.730）。其中45例（63%）发生在术后30天内。GP消融组首次复发时间晚于非GP消融组（24[14-34]天 vs. 14[11-24]天，p=0.046）。在GP消融组中，致心律失常基质标志物（年龄、左房容积指数、糖尿病、CHA2DS2-VASc评分和持续性房颤）与早期复发相关；且早期复发与晚期复发相关，而非GP消融组无此关联。

title: Temporal Association Between Intrathoracic Impedance and Tachyarrhythmia Occurrence.
summary:
BACKGROUND: This study examined whether daily intrathoracic impedance is temporally associated with the occurrence of atrial fibrillation (AF) and ventricular tachycardia (VT).

METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 117 patients with cardiac implantable devices, followed for a median of 668 days, corresponding to 89 637 person-days. Recurrent AF occurred in 28% of patients (mean AF burden 0.27), while 773 VT episodes occurred in 15% of patients. Daily intrathoracic impedance, expressed relative to a reference impedance, was analyzed to identify events of impedance decrease and increase. The temporal association between impedance events and tachyarrhythmia burden was quantified using a patient-specific relational strength measure (γ), which compares post-event and pre-event tachyarrhythmia burden.

RESULTS: For impedance decreases, event-related γ for AF was higher than control γ computed for randomly placed events (median 0.68 vs. 0.48, p = 0.04). For VT, event-related γ did not differ significantly from control γ (six patients; median 0.52 vs. 0.21, p = 0.82). No significant differences were observed for impedance increases in either the AF or VT analysis. In the pooled episode-level analysis, an impedance decrease was associated with a shorter time to VT occurrence than an impedance increase (median 4 vs. 7 days, p < 0.001), with 48% of VT episodes occurring within 3 days after an impedance decrease.

CONCLUSION: A decrease in intrathoracic impedance is temporally associated with subsequent AF occurrence and, at the episode level, with a shorter time to VT. These findings suggest that daily intrathoracic impedance may provide information on short-term changes preceding tachyarrhythmia occurrence.

AI.tldr: 在植入心脏设备的患者中，胸腔内阻抗下降与随后房颤发生存在时间关联，且在发作层面与室速更短时间相关。

AI.result: 房颤复发见于28%患者（平均房颤负荷0.27），室速发作773次于15%患者。阻抗下降时，房颤的事件相关γ高于随机对照γ（中位数0.68 vs. 0.48，p=0.04）；室速的事件相关γ与对照γ无显著差异（6例患者，中位数0.52 vs. 0.21，p=0.82）。阻抗上升在房颤或室速分析中均无显著差异。在汇总的发作层面分析中，阻抗下降与室速发生时间更短相关（中位数4天 vs. 7天，p<0.001），48%的室速发作发生在阻抗下降后3天内。

title: Atrial Septal Defect Management Status and Long-Term Outcomes After Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: A Real-World Cohort Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: As more adults with atrial septal defect (ASD) survive into older age and undergo atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, evidence to guide post-ablation risk stratification remains limited.

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate long-term outcomes after the first AF ablation across ASD management states compared with an intact interatrial septum.

METHODS: This real-world cohort study included 27 675 patients undergoing their first AF ablation, classified by interatrial septal status as intact septum (n = 27 134), unrepaired ASD (n = 232), percutaneous closure (n = 119), or surgical repair (n = 190). Three pairwise comparisons with an intact septum were constructed. Propensity score overlap weighting was used to balance baseline characteristics, and Cox proportional hazards models were used to assess outcomes. The primary outcome was atrial arrhythmia recurrence after the 3-month blanking period; the secondary outcome was a composite cardiovascular outcome.

RESULTS: Compared with an intact septum, unrepaired ASD was associated with a higher recurrence risk (hazard ratio [HR], 1.27; 95% CI, 1.07-1.51; p = 0.006), with excess risk mainly observed between 3 months and 1 year after ablation. Surgical repair was also associated with higher recurrence risk (HR, 1.21; 95% CI, 1.01-1.46; p = 0.038), with differences emerging beyond 1 year. Percutaneous closure was not associated with increased recurrence risk (HR, 1.07; 95% CI, 0.83-1.38; p = 0.589). Composite cardiovascular outcomes did not differ significantly across groups.

CONCLUSIONS: ASD management status identified distinct temporal patterns of atrial arrhythmia recurrence after AF ablation, suggesting that ASD should not be treated as a single binary condition in post-ablation risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 在27675例首次房颤消融患者中，未修复的房间隔缺损（ASD）和外科修复与更高的房性心律失常复发风险相关，而经皮封堵则无此关联，且复发的时间模式因ASD管理状态而异。
AI.motivation: 随着更多成人ASD患者存活至老年并接受房颤消融，术后风险分层的证据有限，且ASD常被当作单一二元状态处理，缺乏对不同管理状态（未修复、经皮封堵、外科修复）的长期结局比较。
AI.method: 真实世界队列研究，纳入27675例首次房颤消融患者，按房间隔状态分为完整房间隔（n=27134）、未修复ASD（n=232）、经皮封堵（n=119）和外科修复（n=190）。采用倾向性评分重叠权重平衡基线特征，Cox比例风险模型评估结局。主要终点为3个月空白期后的房性心律失常复发；次要终点为复合心血管结局。
AI.result: 与完整房间隔相比，未修复ASD与更高的复发风险相关（HR 1.27；95% CI 1.07-1.51；p=0.006），超额风险主要见于术后3个月至1年；外科修复亦与更高复发风险相关（HR 1.21；95% CI 1.01-1.46；p=0.038），差异在1年后显现；经皮封堵未增加复发风险（HR 1.07；95% CI 0.83-1.38；p=0.589）。复合心血管结局在各组间无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: ASD管理状态可识别房颤消融后房性心律失常复发的不同时间模式，提示在术后风险评估中不应将ASD视为单一二元状态。临床意义在于需根据ASD管理状态进行个体化风险分层和随访，但本研究为观察性设计，存在残余混杂可能，且部分亚组样本量较小。

目的：评估在ASD不同管理状态下与完整房间隔相比，首次AF消融后的长期结局。

方法：这项真实世界队列研究纳入了27 675例接受首次AF消融的患者，按房间隔状态分为完整房间隔（n = 27 134）、未修复ASD（n = 232）、经皮封堵（n = 119）或外科修复（n = 190）。构建了三个与完整房间隔的成对比较。使用倾向评分重叠权重平衡基线特征，并使用Cox比例风险模型评估结局。主要结局是3个月空白期后房性心律失常复发；次要结局是复合心血管结局。

结果：与完整房间隔相比，未修复ASD与更高的复发风险相关（风险比[HR]，1.27；95% CI，1.07-1.51；p = 0.006），超额风险主要见于消融后3个月至1年之间。外科修复也与更高的复发风险相关（HR，1.21；95% CI，1.01-1.46；p = 0.038），差异在1年后出现。经皮封堵与复发风险增加无关（HR，1.07；95% CI，0.83-1.38；p = 0.589）。复合心血管结局在各组间无显著差异。

结论：ASD管理状态确定了AF消融后房性心律失常复发的不同时间模式，提示在消融后风险评估中不应将ASD视为单一的二元状态。

title: Pulmonary Vein Isolation Alone Versus Adjunctive Ablation for Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is the standard ablation strategy for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF). Despite guideline recommendations favoring PVI alone in PAF, some operators routinely perform extra pulmonary vein ablation (PVI+) during initial procedures.

OBJECTIVE: To determine frequency of PVI+ strategy for treatment of PAF in the real world and examine its impact on arrhythmic recurrence and progression compared to PVI alone.

METHODS: Using the TriNetX research network, we identified adults with PAF who underwent catheter ablation between January 2020 and January 2024. Recurrence was defined as repeat ablation, cardioversion, or antiarrhythmic drug (AAD) use beyond a 3-month blanking period. Progression to persistent AF and atypical atrial flutter were also assessed. Kaplan-Meier analysis was performed with 3-year follow-up.

RESULTS: Before matching, 5134 of 18,891 patients (27.2%) underwent PVI+. In the propensity matched analysis (n = 5020 per group), recurrence was significantly higher in the PVI+ group (HR 1.28, 95% CI 1.16-1.42; p < 0.001). Repeat ablation, cardioversion and AAD use were more common with PVI+ (HR 1.99, 95% CI 1.60-2.46; p < 0.0001, HR 1.37, 95% CI 1.13-1.66; p = 0.001, and HR 1.41, 95% CI 1.05-1.87; p = 0.020, respectively). Progression to persistent AF was higher with PVI+ (HR 1.37, 95% CI 1.23-1.53, p < 0.001), as was atypical atrial flutter (HR 2.63, 95% CI 1.97-3.50; p < 0.0001).

CONCLUSION: Extra-pulmonary vein ablation during first-time PAF ablation remains common in real-world practice but is associated with worse outcomes including repeat ablation, cardioversion, AAD use, atrial flutter, and progression to persistent AF.

AI.tldr: 在真实世界中，27.2%的阵发性房颤患者首次消融时接受PVI+策略，倾向性匹配分析显示PVI+与更高的复发、重复消融、心脏电复律、AAD使用、非典型房扑及进展为持续性AF风险相关。
AI.motivation: PVI是阵发性AF消融的标准策略，指南推荐单纯PVI，但部分术者仍在首次手术中常规进行额外肺静脉外消融（PVI+）。PVI+在真实世界中的使用频率及其对心律失常复发和进展的影响尚不明确，本研究旨在填补这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 基于TriNetX研究网络的回顾性队列研究，纳入2020年1月至2024年1月接受导管消融的成人阵发性AF患者。复发定义为3个月空白期后重复消融、心脏电复律或使用AAD；同时评估进展为持续性AF和非典型房扑。采用Kaplan-Meier分析，随访3年，并进行倾向性匹配（每组n=5020）。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界中首次PAF消融时额外肺静脉外消融仍较常见，但与更差的临床结局相关，包括复发、重复消融、心脏电复律、AAD使用、非典型房扑及进展为持续性AF。该结果支持指南推荐，即PAF首次消融应首选单纯PVI。但作为回顾性研究，存在选择偏倚等局限性，需前瞻性研究进一步验证。

title: Predictors of Recurrence and Quality of Life After Cryoballoon Ablation in Atrial Fibrillation: Data From a Multicenter Taiwanese Registry With 24-Month Follow-Up.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Contemporary Asian data on 24-month outcomes after cryoballoon ablation (CBA) in predominantly paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF) are limited.

METHODS: We conducted a multicenter registry across four Taiwanese tertiary centers (2018-2023). Consecutive patients undergoing CBA were analyzed for documented atrial-arrhythmia recurrence (≥ 30-s episodes after a 90-day blanking period) and 12-month quality of life (QoL; EQ-5D-3L index and visual analogue scale [VAS]). Rhythm follow-up relied mainly on intermittent ECG, Holter, event-recorder, or clinically indicated rhythm assessment. Cox models identified recurrence predictors; QoL analyses used paired complete-case data.

RESULTS: Among 298 patients (age 63.7 ± 11.8 years, 60% men), 282 (94.6%) had paroxysmal AF. Procedure-related adverse events were rare (2.0%), with no tamponade or atrioesophageal fistula. Fifty-eight patients (19%) had post-blanking documented recurrence (late 90-365 days: n = 37; very late > 365 days: n = 21). Kaplan-Meier recurrence-free survival under intermittent monitoring was approximately 90% at 12 months and 62% at 24 months, with wider confidence bands beyond 18 months. In multivariable analysis, longer time from AF diagnosis to ablation independently predicted recurrence (adjusted HR 1.050 per year, 95% CI 1.007-1.096; p = 0.023); left-ventricular ejection fraction showed a borderline inverse association (adjusted HR 0.970 per 1%, 95% CI 0.942-1.000; p = 0.052). QoL analyses in 205/298 patients with paired data showed no significant change in EQ-5D-3L index (p = 0.672), but VAS categories shifted toward lower symptom burden (moderate/high 21.5% to 10.2%). A clinically meaningful VAS improvement (≥ 10 points) occurred in 34% (70/205). Because paired QoL data were incomplete and the logistic model was unstable owing to sparse events and quasi-complete separation, no robust independent predictor of VAS improvement could be confirmed.

CONCLUSION: In this multicenter Taiwanese registry of predominantly paroxysmal AF, CBA had a low complication rate and high 12-month freedom from documented arrhythmia under intermittent monitoring. Longer time from AF diagnosis to ablation was associated with recurrence. Among patients with paired QoL data, one-third achieved clinically meaningful VAS improvement despite an unchanged EQ-5D-3L index.

AI.tldr: 台湾多中心注册研究显示，冷冻球囊消融治疗阵发性房颤12个月无复发率约90%，24个月降至62%，诊断至消融时间延长独立预测复发，34%患者生活质量VAS改善≥10分。
AI.motivation: 亚洲人群冷冻球囊消融（CBA）治疗以阵发性房颤（AF）为主的24个月结局数据有限，需明确复发预测因素及生活质量（QoL）变化。
AI.method: 台湾四家三级中心2018-2023年前瞻性多中心注册研究，连续纳入298例接受CBA的患者（94.6%为阵发性AF）。主要终点为空白期（90天）后记录到的房性心律失常复发（≥30秒）；次要终点为12个月QoL（EQ-5D-3L指数和VAS）。随访主要依靠间歇性心电图、Holter、事件记录器或临床指征性节律评估。采用Cox模型识别复发预测因素，QoL分析使用配对完整病例数据。
AI.result: 中位随访24个月，58例（19%）出现空白期后复发（晚期90-365天37例，极晚期>365天21例）。间歇监测下Kaplan-Meier无复发生存率12个月约90%，24个月约62%，18个月后置信带增宽。多变量分析中，AF诊断至消融时间延长独立预测复发（校正HR 1.050/年，95%CI 1.007-1.096，P=0.023）；LVEF呈边缘性负相关（校正HR 0.970/1%，95%CI 0.942-1.000，P=0.052）。205例配对QoL数据显示EQ-5D-3L指数无显著变化（P=0.672），但VAS症状负担类别向低负担转移（中/高负担从21.5%降至10.2%），34%（70/205）达到临床有意义的VAS改善（≥10分）。因配对QoL数据不完整且逻辑模型因事件稀疏和准完全分离不稳定，未能确认VAS改善的稳健独立预测因素。手术相关不良事件发生率2.0%，无心脏压塞或房食管瘘。
AI.conclusion: 在台湾以阵发性AF为主的多中心注册中，CBA并发症率低，间歇监测下12个月无复发率高；诊断至消融时间延长与复发相关。尽管EQ-5D-3L指数未变，约三分之一患者VAS有临床意义改善。结果受限于间歇监测可能低估复发及QoL数据不完整，需更长期、连续监测研究验证。

title: Pre-existing Atrial Fibrillation and Long-term Outcomes Following Total Knee Arthroplasty.
summary: A significant population of patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty (TKA) concomitantly have atrial fibrillation (AF). Previous studies have examined acute postoperative complications; however, the long-term impact of pre-existing AF on surgical outcomes after TKA remains underexplored. This study aimed to evaluate 2-, 5-, and 10-year risk and indications for revision among patients with AF undergoing TKA. The TriNetX database was utilized for this retrospective cohort study. The primary outcome was 2-, 5-, and 10-year risk of revision following primary TKA among patients with and without pre-existing AF. The AF and control cohorts were 1:1 propensity matched by age, sex, race, clinical comorbidities, and anticoagulant and aspirin use. Covariate balance after matching was assessed using standardized mean differences (SMDs). Cox proportional hazards models and Kaplan-Meier survival estimates were used to evaluate all-cause revision and specific complications. Results were reported as hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs), survival probabilities, and p-values. A p-value of < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. Patients with pre-existing AF (n = 24,671) had a significantly higher risk of all-cause revision at 2 years (HR 1.27, 95% CI: 1.13-1.43, p < 0.0001), 5 years (HR 1.23, 95% CI: 1.11-1.37, p < 0.0001), and 10 years (HR 1.23, 95% CI: 1.12-1.35, p < 0.0001) post-TKA compared to matched controls (n = 24,671). The AF cohort demonstrated increased risk of periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) (HR 1.33, 95% CI: 1.22-1.44, p < 0.0001) while showing decreased incidence of arthrofibrosis (HR 0.85, 95% CI: 0.80-0.91, p < 0.0001). No significant difference in periprosthetic fracture, mechanical loosening, osteolysis, or articular wear was observed. Pre-existing AF is associated with increased long-term risk of revision following TKA up to 10 years postoperatively compared to matched controls, even after matching for comorbidity burden and anticoagulant use. These findings should be interpreted cautiously in the context of modest effect sizes and limitations inherent within the TriNetX database. Future studies should examine whether perioperative anticoagulation management strategies influence long-term postoperative complications in patients with AF undergoing TKA.

AI.tldr: 合并房颤的全膝关节置换患者10年内翻修风险持续升高约23%，主要归因于假体周围感染增加，而关节纤维化反而减少。
AI.motivation: 相当比例的全膝关节置换（TKA）患者合并房颤（AF），既往研究多关注术后急性并发症，而术前房颤对TKA远期手术结局（尤其是翻修风险及翻修指征）的影响尚缺乏充分证据，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于TriNetX数据库的回顾性队列研究。纳入接受初次TKA且术前合并AF的患者（n=24,671），并按年龄、性别、种族、临床合并症及抗凝药和阿司匹林使用情况1:1倾向性匹配非AF对照（n=24,671），以标准化均数差评估匹配后协变量平衡。主要终点为术后2年、5年、10年翻修风险；采用Cox比例风险模型和Kaplan-Meier生存分析评估全因翻修及特定并发症，结果以HR、95%CI、生存概率及P值报告，P<0.05为差异有统计学意义。
AI.conclusion: 术前房颤与TKA术后长达10年的翻修风险升高相关，且在校正合并症负担及抗凝药使用后仍存在，主要驱动因素为PJI增加。鉴于效应量中等且TriNetX数据库存在固有局限，结论需谨慎解读；未来应探讨围术期抗凝管理策略是否影响此类患者的远期并发症。对电生理实践而言，提示对拟行TKA的AF患者应加强围术期及远期感染防控与随访。
