title: The modified APPLE score for predicting atrial fibrillation recurrence in patients with hypertension undergoing radiofrequency ablation
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia, with hypertension representing a significant risk factor. It is necessary to predict the recurrence of AF through models in clinical practice for patients with hypertension and AF. Methods: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 380 patients who underwent their first ablation procedure. Results: The traditional APPLE score was enhanced by incorporating additional indicators: the Systemic Immune-Inflammation Index (SII), left ventricular mass index (LVMI), body mass index (BMI), age, and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR). The Modified APPLE Score model, achieved superior predictive performance with an AUC of 0.889, significantly outperforming the traditional APPLE score (AUC = 0.856), P = 0.006. Analysis revealed U-shaped relationships between recurrence risk and both SII and age. LVMI, BMI, and systolic blood pressure were positively correlated with recurrence risk, while eGFR was negatively correlated. Both SII and age showed U-shaped relationships with AF recurrence risk (SII critical values: 400 × 10 5 /L and 750 × 10 9 /L; age critical values: 50 and 70 years), while LVMI, BMI, and systolic blood pressure were positively correlated with recurrence risk, eGFR was negatively correlated. Among inflammatory markers, SII demonstrated the highest predictive value. Conclusions: The Modified APPLE score model, which integrates inflammatory and cardiac structural indicators, significantly enhances the prediction accuracy of AF recurrence. Its core mechanism lies in simultaneously capturing the synergistic effects of systemic inflammatory activation and ventricular remodeling. This model provides a practical tool for identifying high-risk patients and developing individualized intervention strategies, offering potential for advancing precision secondary prevention in patients with hypertension and AF.

AI.tldr: 在380例合并高血压的房颤射频消融患者中，整合炎症与心脏结构指标的改良APPLE评分预测复发AUC达0.889，显著优于传统APPLE评分。
AI.motivation: 房颤是最常见的持续性心律失常，高血压是其重要危险因素。临床需要预测合并高血压的房颤患者消融术后复发风险，但传统APPLE评分预测效能有限，亟需整合炎症与心脏结构指标以提升预测准确性。
AI.method: 回顾性分析380例首次接受射频消融的房颤合并高血压患者。在传统APPLE评分基础上纳入系统性免疫炎症指数（SII）、左心室质量指数（LVMI）、体重指数（BMI）、年龄和估算肾小球滤过率（eGFR），构建改良APPLE评分模型。主要终点为房颤复发，采用AUC比较模型预测效能，并分析各指标与复发风险的关系。

title: Patterns of heart rate variability in patients with atrial fibrillation and arterial hypertension according to the presence of type 2 diabetes mellitus
summary: Aim. To assess the patterns and circadian characteristics of heart rate variability (HRV) as a marker of autonomic dysfunction in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and arterial hypertension (AH) depending on the presence of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), and to determine their clinical associations. Materials and methods. A total of 42 patients with AF were examined: Group 1 (main group) included 21 patients with AF, AH, and T2DM; Group 2 (comparison group) comprised 21 patients with AF and AH without T2DM. All patients underwent comprehensive clinical examination including 24-hour ECG monitoring with the assessment of HRV parameters separately for daytime and nighttime periods. Results. In Group 1, persistent AF was observed more frequently than in Group 2 as was higher symptom burden and greater thromboembolic risk. Compared with Group 2, patients in Group 1 demonstrated significantly lower time-domain HRV indices (SDNNi, RMSSD, pNN50), lower HRV TI and TP, higher regulatory stress indices (SI, IVR, VPR), and an elevated LF/HF ratio, collectively indicating a shift in autonomic balance toward sympathetic predominance. The most pronounced inter-group differences were observed during the nighttime period and were characterized by attenuation of day-to-night variation in HRV indices and reduced nocturnal parasympathetic activity. Correlation analysis in Group 1 revealed significant inverse associations between glycemic control and time-domain, spectral and geometric HRV parameters, as well as direct associations with stress regulatory indices. Conclusions. In patients with AF and AH, comorbid T2DM is associated with more pronounced suppression of overall HRV, elevated regulatory stress indices, sympathetic predominance, and reduced parasympathetic activity. These changes exhibit distinct circadian features, being most marked during the nighttime period. Poorer glycemic control is associated with adverse changes in HRV parameters, suggesting the importance of comprehensive assessment of autonomic dysfunction in patients with metabolic comorbidity.

title: Post-Diagnosis Complications in Adults with Major Arrhythmia: Impact of Ambulatory Cardiac Monitoring
authors: Russo P., MD*; Nathan R., PhD*; Boyle K., DC*; Hendrickson E., PhD**; Wright B., RN, Dr PH*
summary: Ambulatory cardiac monitoring (ACM) is recommended for the evaluation of unexplained symptoms, and its value has traditionally been assessed primarily by diagnostic yield. Far less attention has been paid to whether monitoring before the diagnosis of a major arrhythmia, such as atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, supraventricular tachycardia, or ventricular tachycardia, influences subsequent patient outcomes. Our real-world claims analyses across commercially insured populations, Medicare beneficiaries, and disease-specific cohorts have consistently shown associations between ACM, particularly longer-duration continuous monitoring, and fewer subsequent hospitalizations, readmissions, and emergency department visits, as well as lower health care costs after arrhythmia is diagnosed. These studies evaluated health care utilization rather than clinical complications, and in one large Medicare comparison, differences in diagnostic yield did not translate into differences in subsequent outcomes. This editorial place these findings in the context of guideline-based indications for ACM and trials of atrial fibrillation screening, while examining the potential biases that could account for the observed associations. We further quantify the robustness of these associations to unmeasured confounding using E-values. The definitive question, however, remains unresolved: does earlier diagnosis of major arrhythmias, particularly atrial fibrillation, reduce the risk of heart failure, myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiac death? Answering this question will require additional evidence from rigorous target-trial emulation and pragmatic randomized trials.

title: Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With Pectus Excavatum: Clinical Characteristics, Management, and Outcomes.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pectus excavatum (PE), the most common congenital chest wall deformity, has known associations with connective tissue disorders and may lead to cardiopulmonary impairment; however, its relationship with atrial fibrillation (AF) remains underexplored.

OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to describe the frequency, clinical characteristics, and management of AF within an institutional cohort of patients with PE, and to determine whether the outcomes observed in clinically distinct subgroups persisted after adjustment for baseline risk.

METHODS: This was a retrospective cohort study design. Patients with both PE and documented AF between January 1, 1990, and November 10, 2024, were included. Clinical, echocardiographic, and therapeutic data were collected. Bleeding and thromboembolic outcomes were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression adjusted for age, sex, CHA2DS2-VASc score, and anticoagulant class, and the surgically treated subgroup was additionally compared using propensity score matching.

RESULTS: Among 11,578 patients with PE, 1309 (11.3%) had AF. Of those who had AF, mean age was 66.9 years; 54% were female, and 83% had paroxysmal AF. The mean CHA2DS2-VASc and HAS-BLED scores were 2.8 and 1.9, respectively. Thromboembolic events occurred in 196 (15%) patients, most commonly stroke (11%), followed by pulmonary embolism (4%) and deep venous thrombosis (4%). Bleeding events occurred in 313 patients (24%), most commonly hematuria (12%), gastrointestinal bleed (11%), epistaxis (5%), and intracranial hemorrhage (1%). Seventy-two patients (6%) underwent the Nuss procedure and were younger (45.3 vs. 68.2 years, p < 0.001), predominantly male (65%), and had lower risk scores compared to the non-Nuss cohort. Patients who underwent the Nuss procedure had significantly fewer bleeding events (5.6% vs. 25%, p < 0.001) with similar thromboembolic rates. The pectus severity index, available in the 370 patients who underwent dedicated radiologic review, was not associated with bleeding (adjusted OR 0.89, 95% CI 0.75-1.05). The difference in bleeding by surgical status persisted after multivariable adjustment (adjusted OR 0.28, 95% CI 0.10-0.79) and after propensity score matching (5.6% vs. 16.7%, p = 0.030).

CONCLUSIONS: AF was identified in approximately one in nine patients within this single-institution cohort of adults with PE, with paroxysmal AF representing the predominant subtype. Patients who had undergone surgical repair demonstrated a lower incidence of bleeding events than anticipated based on their baseline risk profile; however, given the limited number of events observed, this finding should be interpreted with caution and requires validation in larger studies. In the absence of a non-PE comparator group, these data are insufficient to determine whether PE independently confers an elevated risk of AF, and prospective, controlled investigations are necessary to elucidate this relationship.

summary_zh:
背景：漏斗胸（PE）是最常见的先天性胸壁畸形，已知与结缔组织疾病相关，并可能导致心肺功能损害；然而，其与心房颤动（AF）的关系仍未得到充分探讨。

目的：本研究旨在描述一个机构性PE患者队列中AF的发生频率、临床特征和管理，并确定在临床特征不同的亚组中观察到的结果在调整基线风险后是否仍然存在。

方法：本研究为回顾性队列研究设计。纳入1990年1月1日至2024年11月10日期间同时患有PE和记录在案的AF的患者。收集临床、超声心动图和治疗数据。使用多变量逻辑回归评估出血和血栓栓塞结局，调整年龄、性别、CHA2DS2-VASc评分和抗凝药物类别，并对手术治疗亚组额外使用倾向性评分匹配进行比较。

结果：在11,578例PE患者中，1309例（11.3%）患有AF。在AF患者中，平均年龄为66.9岁；54%为女性，83%为阵发性AF。平均CHA2DS2-VASc和HAS-BLED评分分别为2.8和1.9。血栓栓塞事件发生在196例（15%）患者中，最常见的是卒中（11%），其次是肺栓塞（4%）和深静脉血栓形成（4%）。出血事件发生在313例（24%）患者中，最常见的是血尿（12%）、胃肠道出血（11%）、鼻出血（5%）和颅内出血（1%）。72例（6%）患者接受了Nuss手术，他们更年轻（45.3 vs. 68.2岁，p < 0.001），主要为男性（65%），与非Nuss队列相比风险评分更低。接受Nuss手术的患者出血事件显著更少（5.6% vs. 25%，p < 0.001），血栓栓塞率相似。在370例接受专门放射学审查的患者中可获得的漏斗胸严重指数与出血无关（调整OR 0.89，95% CI 0.75-1.05）。手术状态导致的出血差异在多变量调整后（调整OR 0.28，95% CI 0.10-0.79）和倾向性评分匹配后（5.6% vs. 16.7%，p = 0.030）仍然存在。

结论：在这个单机构成人PE队列中，约九分之一的患者发现AF，阵发性AF是主要亚型。接受手术修复的患者出血事件发生率低于基于其基线风险特征的预期；然而，鉴于观察到的事件数量有限，这一发现应谨慎解读，并需要在更大规模的研究中验证。由于缺乏非PE对照组，这些数据不足以确定PE是否独立增加AF风险，需要前瞻性对照研究来阐明这一关系。

title: Outcomes of Mitral Valve Intervention for Patients With Bileaflet Mitral Valve Prolapse and Preoperative Ventricular Arrhythmias.
summary: Bileaflet mitral valve (MV) prolapse may be associated with ventricular arrhythmias and cardiac arrest. Given the paucity of data analyzing the role of MV interventions, we analyzed outcomes of MV surgery in patients with bileaflet MV prolapse and preoperative ventricular arrhythmias. Between 1994 and 2018, 30 adult patients with bileaflet MV prolapse, severe MV regurgitation, and documented preoperative ventricular arrhythmias underwent MV operation at our institution. Ventricular arrhythmia was defined as ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, cardiac arrest, or bigeminy. Pre- and postoperative ventricular arrhythmias and mortality were identified from medical record review. Median age was 51 years (IQR: 41.2, 59.5), and 20 (66.7%) patients were female. The most common preoperative arrhythmia was ventricular tachycardia (73%), followed by ventricular fibrillation and cardiac arrest. Most patients (N = 28, 93.3%) underwent bileaflet MV repair, and 2 (6.7%) underwent MV replacement. There was no 30-day mortality. Ventricular arrhythmias did not recur postoperatively in 19 patients, and 3 patients with preoperative cardiac arrest improved without further cardiac arrest episodes but had ventricular tachycardia. The 1-year estimate of freedom from ventricular arrhythmia recurrence was 70%. Patients with recurrence were older and had longer delays between arrhythmia diagnosis and surgical referral. Higher body mass index and lower preoperative ejection fraction were associated with increased recurrence risk. In conclusion, surgical correction of bileaflet MV prolapse for severe MV regurgitation with preoperative ventricular arrhythmias can be performed safely. Although the majority of patients experienced a sustained reduction in arrhythmia burden postoperatively, recurrence was observed in a subset. Therefore, patients should be counseled regarding ongoing medical management and the possibility of recurrence despite correction of MV regurgitation.

AI.tldr: 双叶二尖瓣脱垂合并室性心律失常患者接受二尖瓣手术安全，1年无室性心律失常复发率70%，复发与年龄、延迟手术及BMI、LVEF相关。
AI.motivation: 双叶二尖瓣脱垂可能与室性心律失常和心脏骤停相关，但关于二尖瓣干预对这类患者心律失常结局影响的数据匮乏，临床决策缺乏依据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入1994-2018年30例成人双叶二尖瓣脱垂、重度二尖瓣反流且有术前室性心律失常（室速、室颤、心脏骤停或二联律）并接受二尖瓣手术的患者。主要终点为术后室性心律失常复发和死亡率，通过病历回顾识别，采用生存分析估计1年无复发率。
AI.result: 中位年龄51岁，女性66.7%。术前最常见心律失常为室速（73%）。93.3%行二尖瓣修复，6.7%行置换。30天死亡率为0。术后19例无心律失常复发，3例术前心脏骤停者未再发心脏骤停但仍有室速。1年无室性心律失常复发率为70%。复发者年龄更大、从心律失常诊断到手术转诊延迟更长；较高BMI和较低术前LVEF与复发风险增加相关。
AI.conclusion: 对双叶二尖瓣脱垂合并重度反流和术前室性心律失常患者，二尖瓣手术可安全实施，多数患者术后心律失常负荷持续降低，但部分仍复发。应告知患者术后仍需持续药物治疗并警惕复发可能。研究为回顾性小样本，结论需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh: 二叶式二尖瓣（MV）脱垂可能与室性心律失常和心脏骤停相关。鉴于分析MV干预作用的数据匮乏，我们分析了二叶式MV脱垂合并术前室性心律失常患者接受MV手术的结局。1994年至2018年间，30例成人二叶式MV脱垂、重度MV反流并有术前室性心律失常记录的惠者在本机构接受了MV手术。室性心律失常定义为室性心动过速、心室颤动、心脏骤停或二联律。术前和术后室性心律失常及死亡率通过病历回顾确定。中位年龄为51岁（IQR：41.2，59.5），20例（66.7%）患者为女性。最常见的术前心律失常是室性心动过速（73%），其次是心室颤动和心脏骤停。大多数患者（N=28，93.3%）接受了二叶式MV修复，2例（6.7%）接受了MV置换。无30天死亡率。19例患者术后室性心律失常未复发，3例术前心脏骤停患者改善，无进一步心脏骤停发作但有室性心动过速。1年无室性心律失常复发估计为70%。复发患者年龄较大，且从心律失常诊断到手术转诊的延迟较长。较高的体重指数和较低的术前射血分数与复发风险增加相关。总之，对于二叶式MV脱垂导致重度MV反流合并术前室性心律失常，手术矫正可以安全进行。尽管大多数患者术后心律失常负荷持续减轻，但部分患者观察到复发。因此，应告知患者尽管MV反流已矫正，仍需持续药物治疗以及复发的可能性。

title: Multidimensional evaluation of generative AI chatbots for public consultation on sudden cardiac death: safety, accuracy, empathy, reliability, quality, and readability across six models
summary: Generative AI chatbots are increasingly used for health information, but their performance in safety-sensitive sudden cardiac death (SCD) consultation remains insufficiently characterized. This study evaluated six publicly accessible chatbots on SCD-related public questions involving symptom triage, emergency response, CPR/AED use, inherited risk, myocarditis-related concerns, return to exercise, screening, and ICD decision-making. This cross-sectional, comparative, text-level study evaluated ChatGPT Plus 5.5 thinking, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Microsoft Copilot smart, DeepSeek-V4-pro, Doubao, and Perplexity. A standardized set of 56 SCD-related public consultation questions was developed from Google Trends, online forums, public question-answer platforms, clinical guidelines, expert consensus statements, systematic reviews, and qualitative interviews. Each question was submitted once to each chatbot between May 10 and May 16, 2026, yielding 336 model-response items. Five blinded senior cardiology raters assessed safety, accuracy, empathy, DISCERN, EQIP, JAMA benchmark criteria, and GQS. Readability was calculated using six formula-based indices. Between-model comparisons were performed using Cochran’s Q test and Friedman tests, with Kendall’s W reported as the effect size. Responses containing potential safety concerns were additionally examined qualitatively. Inter-rater agreement was high across all manually assessed metrics, with Fleiss’ kappa of 0.856 for Safety and ICC values ranging from 0.801 to 0.887 for other domains. Safe responses predominated across all models, although responses containing potential safety concerns occurred in every chatbot. ChatGPT Plus 5.5 thinking and Perplexity had the highest observed safety proportions during this query window, whereas Doubao had the lowest. Qualitative analysis identified recurrent concerns involving delayed emergency activation for chest pain, syncope, or post-viral symptoms; over-reassurance about prevention; fixed return-to-exercise timelines after infection or COVID-19; pulse-check instructions that could delay CPR; and oversimplified screening, electrolyte, or ICD-related advice. Most flagged responses contained a single potential safety concern. The qualitative severity distribution was concentrated in low and low-to-moderate concerns, whereas higher-severity concerns were less frequent. Accuracy differed significantly across models ( P < 0.001; Kendall’s W = 0.864), with ChatGPT Plus 5.5 thinking, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Microsoft Copilot smart, DeepSeek-V4-pro, and Perplexity achieving similar median scores and Doubao performing lower. Empathy also differed significantly ( P < 0.001; Kendall’s W = 0.531), with DeepSeek-V4-pro having the highest observed score. Significant differences were observed for DISCERN, EQIP, JAMA, GQS, and all readability indices (all P < 0.001). Within this dataset, DeepSeek-V4-pro had the highest DISCERN and EQIP scores and the most favorable readability profile, Gemini 3.5 Flash showed comparable EQIP performance, and Microsoft Copilot smart had the highest JAMA score. However, transparency remained limited overall, and all models produced responses with relatively high reading-grade requirements. In this multidimensional evaluation of six generative AI chatbots for SCD-related public consultation, most responses were safe and clinically relevant, but potential safety concerns occurred across all models. Important limitations involved emergency escalation, CPR/AED guidance, return-to-exercise advice, individualized risk interpretation, transparency, and readability. These tools may support general SCD education, but they should not replace emergency medical services or clinician assessment. Because each question was sampled once during a defined week and all prompts were submitted in English through public interfaces accessed in China, the findings should be interpreted as a time-, language-, and access-specific snapshot rather than a stable ranking of the underlying models. Future development should prioritize evidence-linked content, clear red-flag escalation, plain-language communication, and ongoing expert review.

AI.tldr: 六款生成式AI聊天机器人对56个心脏性猝死相关公共咨询问题的回答总体安全且临床相关，但所有模型均存在潜在安全隐患，尤其在紧急升级、CPR/AED指导和恢复运动建议方面。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI聊天机器人越来越多用于获取健康信息，但其在安全敏感的心脏性猝死（SCD）咨询中的表现尚未充分表征，临床需要了解这些工具在症状分诊、应急响应、CPR/AED使用、遗传风险、心肌炎相关问题、恢复运动、筛查和ICD决策等场景下的安全性、准确性、共情性、可靠性、质量和可读性。
AI.method: 横断面、比较性、文本层面研究，评估六款公开可用的聊天机器人（ChatGPT Plus 5.5 thinking、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Microsoft Copilot smart、DeepSeek-V4-pro、Doubao、Perplexity）。基于Google Trends、在线论坛、公共问答平台、临床指南、专家共识、系统综述和定性访谈开发56个标准化SCD相关公共咨询问题，于2026年5月10日至16日每个问题向每个聊天机器人提交一次，共获得336个模型回答条目。五名盲法资深心脏病学评分者评估安全性、准确性、共情性、DISCERN、EQIP、JAMA基准标准和GQS。使用六种基于公式的指数计算可读性。采用Cochran's Q检验和Friedman检验进行模型间比较，Kendall's W作为效应量。对包含潜在安全问题的回答进行定性分析。
AI.result: 评分者间一致性高：安全性Fleiss' kappa为0.856，其他领域ICC为0.801-0.887。所有模型均以安全回答为主，但每个聊天机器人均出现潜在安全问题。ChatGPT Plus 5.5 thinking和Perplexity安全性比例最高，Doubao最低。定性分析发现反复出现的问题包括：胸痛、晕厥或病毒感染后症状的紧急激活延迟；对预防的过度保证；感染或COVID-19后固定的恢复运动时间表；可能延迟CPR的脉搏检查指令；过于简化的筛查、电解质或ICD相关建议。大多数标记回答包含单一潜在安全问题，严重程度分布集中于低和低至中度关注，较高严重程度较少见。准确性模型间差异显著（P<0.001；Kendall's W=0.864），ChatGPT Plus 5.5 thinking、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Microsoft Copilot smart、DeepSeek-V4-pro和Perplexity中位评分相似，Doubao较低。共情性差异显著（P<0.001；Kendall's W=0.531），DeepSeek-V4-pro观察评分最高。DISCERN、EQIP、JAMA、GQS及所有可读性指数均差异显著（均P<0.001）。DeepSeek-V4-pro的DISCERN和EQIP评分最高且可读性最有利，Gemini 3.5 Flash的EQIP表现相当，Microsoft Copilot smart的JAMA评分最高。然而，透明度总体有限，所有模型回答的阅读年级要求相对较高。
AI.conclusion: 在这项对六款生成式AI聊天机器人用于SCD相关公共咨询的多维评估中，大多数回答安全且临床相关，但所有模型均存在潜在安全问题，重要局限涉及紧急升级、CPR/AED指导、恢复运动建议、个体化风险解读、透明度和可读性。这些工具可支持一般SCD教育，但不应替代紧急医疗服务或临床医生评估。由于每个问题仅在特定一周采样一次且所有提示均通过在中国访问的公共界面以英文提交， findings应解释为时间、语言和访问特定的快照，而非底层模型的稳定排名。未来发展应优先考虑证据关联内容、明确红旗升级、通俗语言沟通和持续专家审查。

title: Prognostic Impact of Left Ventricular Apical Aneurysm Identified by Echocardiography in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy　- A Multicenter Retrospective Study in Japan
summary: Background This study evaluated the prognostic impact of left ventricular (LV) apical aneurysm identified by transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) in a Japanese cohort with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM).Methods and results We retrospectively enrolled 369 consecutive HCM patients from 2 centers (2016-2023). LV apical aneurysm was defined on TTE as a discrete, thin-walled dyskinetic/akinetic apical outpouching with a wide neck. Primary outcomes were all-cause death and cardiovascular (CV) death. Secondary outcomes were hospitalization for worsening heart failure, systemic embolism, sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT), and sudden cardiac death (SCD)-equivalent events (resuscitated cardiac arrest or appropriate implantable cardioverter defibrillator therapy). LV apical aneurysm was present in 47 of 369 patients (12.7%). There were no significant between-group differences in all-cause death (log-rank P=0.162) or CV death (P=0.103). Patients with LV apical aneurysm more frequently had baseline sustained VT and SCD-equivalent events; however, Kaplan-Meier analyses indicated no significant differences between groups in incident sustained VT and SCD-equivalent events after enrollment. In multivariable Cox models, age, B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP), and SCD-equivalent events were independently associated with all-cause death; BNP and SCD-equivalent events were independently associated with CV death.Conclusions In this cohort, echocardiography-identified LV apical aneurysm was associated with a greater burden of baseline arrhythmic events, but not higher mortality. TTE provides a practical means of identifying this phenotype. BNP and SCD-equivalent events were more closely associated with mortality.

AI.tldr: 日本多中心回顾性队列显示，超声心动图识别的左室心尖部室壁瘤在肥厚型心肌病患者中占12.7%，与基线室性心律失常事件负担更高相关，但未增加全因或心血管死亡。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）患者中左室心尖部室壁瘤被认为是高危表型，但既往证据多来自小样本或特定人群，其在日本HCM队列中的预后意义尚不明确，临床是否需要据此强化管理缺乏依据。
AI.method: 多中心回顾性研究，纳入2个中心2016—2023年连续369例HCM患者。经胸超声心动图（TTE）定义左室心尖部室壁瘤为宽颈、薄壁、运动障碍或无运动的局限性心尖部外凸。主要终点为全因死亡和心血管死亡；次要终点为心衰恶化住院、系统性栓塞、持续性室速（VT）及SCD等危事件（复苏成功的心脏骤停或ICD恰当治疗）。采用Kaplan-Meier分析和多变量Cox模型。
AI.result: 47例（12.7%）存在左室心尖部室壁瘤。两组全因死亡（log-rank P=0.162）和心血管死亡（P=0.103）均无显著差异。室壁瘤组基线持续性VT和SCD等危事件更常见，但入组后新发持续性VT及SCD等危事件在Kaplan-Meier分析中无显著差异。多变量Cox模型中，年龄、BNP和SCD等危事件与全因死亡独立相关；BNP和SCD等危事件与心血管死亡独立相关。摘要未报告具体效应量和95%CI。
AI.conclusion: TTE识别的左室心尖部室壁瘤与HCM患者更高的基线心律失常事件负担相关，但未显示更高的全因或心血管死亡风险；BNP和SCD等危事件与死亡关系更密切。TTE是识别该表型的实用手段，但本研究为回顾性、样本量有限，室壁瘤对ICD决策和长期节律管理的独立价值仍需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：本研究在日本肥厚型心肌病（HCM）队列中评估了经胸超声心动图（TTE）检出的左心室（LV）心尖部室壁瘤的预后影响。

方法与结果：我们回顾性纳入了来自2个中心的369例连续HCM患者（2016-2023年）。LV心尖部室壁瘤在TTE上定义为离散、薄壁、运动障碍/无运动的宽颈心尖部膨出。主要结局为全因死亡和心血管（CV）死亡。次要结局为心力衰竭恶化住院、系统性栓塞、持续性室性心动过速（VT）和心脏性猝死（SCD）等效事件（复苏成功的心脏骤停或适当的植入式心律转复除颤器治疗）。369例患者中47例（12.7%）存在LV心尖部室壁瘤。两组间全因死亡（log-rank P=0.162）或CV死亡（P=0.103）无显著差异。LV心尖部室壁瘤患者基线持续性VT和SCD等效事件更常见；然而，Kaplan-Meier分析表明入组后两组间新发持续性VT和SCD等效事件无显著差异。在多变量Cox模型中，年龄、B型利钠肽（BNP）和SCD等效事件与全因死亡独立相关；BNP和SCD等效事件与CV死亡独立相关。

结论：在该队列中，超声心动图检出的LV心尖部室壁瘤与更高的基线心律失常事件负担相关，但不增加死亡率。TTE为识别该表型提供了实用手段。BNP和SCD等效事件与死亡率的相关性更密切。

title: Trends in Hyperkalemia-Related Sudden Cardiac Death Among Older Adults in the United States, 1999-2020.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Hyperkalemia is a potentially life-threatening electrolyte disturbance, particularly in older adults with comorbidities. Hyperkalemia can trigger fatal arrhythmias and contribute to sudden cardiac death (SCD). However, national trends in hyperkalemia-related SCD remain poorly defined, especially in the aging US population.

METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional analysis using CDC WONDER mortality data from 1999 to 2020. Deaths were identified using ICD-10 codes for SCD (I46.1, I46.9) as the underlying cause and hyperkalemia (E87.5) as a contributing cause. Age-adjusted mortality rates (AAMRs) were calculated using the 2000 US standard population. Joinpoint regression was used to assess temporal trends and estimate annual percentage changes (APCs). Analyses were stratified by sex, age, race/ethnicity, region, urbanization, and state.

RESULTS: Between 1999 and 2020, 36 607 hyperkalemia-related SCD deaths were recorded. The national AAMR more than doubled, from 0.65 to 1.32 per 100 000. Mortality was stable from 1999 to 2009 (APC -1.09%, p = 0.0566) but rose significantly from 2010 to 2020 (APC +5.02%, p < 0.0001). Males, Black individuals, and residents of the South and Midwest had the highest AAMRs and steepest increases. Rural areas consistently showed higher mortality than urban ones. Though most deaths occurred in older adults, significant increases were observed in younger adults (25-44 years) in the last decade. Nevada, Rhode Island, and California had the highest state-level rates.

CONCLUSION: Hyperkalemia-related SCD mortality has risen substantially, with marked disparities by sex, race, geography, and age. These trends underscore the need for improved potassium monitoring, risk stratification, and equitable healthcare access to reduce preventable deaths.

AI.tldr: 1999-2020年美国高钾血症相关心脏性猝死年龄调整死亡率翻倍，2010年后显著上升，男性、黑人及南部中西部居民负担最重。
AI.motivation: 高钾血症可诱发致命性心律失常并导致心脏性猝死（SCD），但美国老年人群中高钾血症相关SCD的国家趋势尚不明确，尤其是老龄化背景下缺乏全国性数据。
AI.method: 基于CDC WONDER数据库的横断面分析，纳入1999-2020年ICD-10编码中SCD（I46.1、I46.9）为根本死因且高钾血症（E87.5）为贡献死因的死亡记录，共36 607例。计算年龄调整死亡率（AAMR，2000年美国标准人口），采用Joinpoint回归评估时间趋势并估算年度百分比变化（APC），按性别、年龄、种族/民族、地区、城市化程度和州分层分析。
AI.result: 全国AAMR从0.65/10万升至1.32/10万，翻倍以上。1999-2009年死亡率稳定（APC -1.09%，p=0.0566），2010-2020年显著上升（APC +5.02%，p<0.0001）。男性、黑人、南部和中西部居民AAMR最高且上升最陡；农村地区死亡率持续高于城市；尽管多数死亡发生在老年人中，但近十年25-44岁年轻成人也显著增加。州层面内华达、罗德岛和加利福尼亚死亡率最高。
AI.conclusion: 高钾血症相关SCD死亡率大幅上升，存在显著的性别、种族、地理和年龄差异。这些趋势提示需加强血钾监测、风险分层和公平的医疗可及性以减少可预防死亡。研究为观察性设计，无法确立因果关系，且依赖死亡证明编码可能低估或错分。

summary_zh:
背景：高钾血症是一种可能危及生命的电解质紊乱，尤其在患有合并症的老年人中。高钾血症可触发致命性心律失常并导致心脏性猝死（SCD）。然而，高钾血症相关SCD的全国趋势仍不明确，尤其是在美国老龄化人口中。

方法：我们使用1999年至2020年的CDC WONDER死亡率数据进行了一项横断面分析。通过ICD-10编码识别死亡，其中SCD（I46.1，I46.9）作为根本原因，高钾血症（E87.5）作为 contributing cause。使用2000年美国标准人口计算年龄调整死亡率（AAMR）。采用Joinpoint回归评估时间趋势并估计年度百分比变化（APC）。分析按性别、年龄、种族/民族、地区、城市化程度和州进行分层。

结果：1999年至2020年间，记录了36 607例高钾血症相关SCD死亡。全国AAMR翻倍以上，从每10万人0.65增至1.32。1999年至2009年死亡率稳定（APC -1.09%，p = 0.0566），但2010年至2020年显著上升（APC +5.02%，p < 0.0001）。男性、黑人和南部及中西部居民的AAMR最高且增长最陡峭。农村地区死亡率始终高于城市地区。尽管大多数死亡发生在老年人中，但过去十年中年轻成人（25-44岁）的死亡率显著增加。内华达州、罗德岛州和加利福尼亚州的州级死亡率最高。

结论：高钾血症相关SCD死亡率大幅上升，在性别、种族、地理和年龄方面存在显著差异。这些趋势强调需要改进钾监测、风险分层和公平的医疗保健可及性，以减少可预防的死亡。

title: Persistent Supraventricular Tachycardia Following Central Venous Catheter Insertion: When Withdrawal of the Mechanical Stimulus Is Not Enough
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias are a recognised complication of central venous catheterisation and are usually attributed to mechanical irritation of the endocardium by the guidewire or catheter tip. These arrhythmias typically resolve following withdrawal of the mechanical stimulus. We report a 42-year-old man with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and diabetic ketoacidosis who developed an abrupt regular narrow-complex tachycardia at approximately 217 beats/min immediately following advancement of a right internal jugular central venous catheter. The arrhythmia was associated with transient hypotension and dizziness and persisted despite removal of both the guidewire and catheter. This case illustrates that catheter manipulation may trigger a sustained supraventricular tachycardia that persists after removal of the mechanical stimulus, particularly in a patient with structural heart disease and metabolic and electrolyte abnormalities. Persistent tachyarrhythmia following catheter withdrawal should prompt assessment of haemodynamic stability and guideline-directed arrhythmia management rather than an assumption of spontaneous resolution.

AI.tldr: 42岁射血分数降低心衰合并糖尿病酮症酸中毒患者，右颈内静脉置管后即刻出现约217次/分的窄QRS心动过速，撤除导丝与导管后仍持续，需药物处理而非等待自行终止。
AI.motivation: 中心静脉置管相关心律失常通常被认为是导丝或导管尖端机械刺激心内膜所致，撤除机械刺激后多可自行终止；但撤除刺激后仍持续的心动过速在结构性心脏病及代谢/电解质紊乱患者中的处理策略尚缺乏明确描述，本病例旨在提示这一临床陷阱。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为42岁男性，既往射血分数降低的心力衰竭，本次因糖尿病酮症酸中毒入院，经右颈内静脉置入中心静脉导管。观察指标为导管推进后即刻出现的心律失常特征、撤除导丝与导管后的转归及血流动力学变化；摘要未报告具体用药、电生理检查或统计方法。
AI.result: 导管推进后即刻出现突发规则的窄QRS心动过速，频率约217次/分，伴一过性低血压与头晕；在撤除导丝和导管后心动过速仍持续存在。摘要未报告具体心率转归时间、用药种类与剂量、复律结果及随访数据。
AI.conclusion: 导管操作可诱发持续性室上性心动过速，且在撤除机械刺激后不一定自行终止，尤其在结构性心脏病合并代谢及电解质异常的患者中。导管撤除后心动过速持续时，应评估血流动力学稳定性并按指南进行心律失常处理，而非假定其会自行恢复。局限性为单例报告，缺乏对照与长期随访，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 心律失常是中心静脉置管术公认的并发症，通常归因于导丝或导管尖端对心内膜的机械性刺激。这些心律失常通常在撤除机械性刺激后缓解。我们报告一例42岁男性，患有射血分数降低的心力衰竭和糖尿病酮症酸中毒，在右颈内静脉中心静脉导管推进后立即出现突发规则的窄QRS波心动过速，心率约217次/分。该心律失常伴有短暂性低血压和头晕，并且在撤除导丝和导管后仍持续存在。本病例表明，导管操作可能触发持续性室上性心动过速，且在撤除机械性刺激后仍持续存在，尤其是在患有结构性心脏病以及代谢和电解质异常的患者中。导管撤除后持续存在的快速性心律失常应促使评估血流动力学稳定性并按照指南进行心律失常管理，而不是假设其会自行缓解。

title: Potassium-Increasing Regimens in Patients at High Risk of Ventricular Arrhythmias: A Prespecified Observational Analysis of the Randomized POTCAST Trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: The POTCAST trial (n=1,200) showed that targeting high-normal plasma potassium levels reduced ventricular arrhythmias in patients with Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators (ICDs). We compared changes in plasma potassium and described outcomes across the three regimens used to increase plasma potassium.

METHODS: We studied 600 control participants and 572 intervention participants who completed potassium up-titration in POTCAST. Participants in the intervention arm were categorized according to treatment after plasma-potassium up-titration into: a) mineralocorticoid-receptor antagonists (MRAs) monotherapy, b) potassium-supplement monotherapy, or c) combination-therapy with both. The primary endpoint was a composite of sustained ventricular arrhythmia, appropriate ICD-therapy, hospitalization for arrhythmia or heart-failure or all-cause mortality. Safety outcomes included death and electrolyte/renal disturbances.

RESULTS: After six months, plasma potassium increased from 4.12 to 4.27 mmol/L (p=0.004) with MRA, from 3.99 to 4.24 mmol/L (p<0.001) with potassium-supplements, and from 3.98 to 4.34 mmol/L (p<0.001) with combination-therapy. The primary endpoint occurred in 29% (n=175) of controls, 22% (n=16) in the MRA group, 21% (n=31) in the potassium-supplements group and in 22% (n=72) in the combination-therapy group (p=0.8 between regimens). Hypokalemia occurred in 13% of controls and in 3%, 9%, and 5% of participants receiving MRA, potassium-supplements and combination-therapy, respectively. Hyperkalemia occurred in 0.2% of controls and in 0%, 3%, and 4% of participants receiving MRA, potassium-supplements, and combination-therapy (p>0.1 between regimens).

CONCLUSIONS: Treatment with MRA, potassium-supplements or both increased potassium levels. All regimens were associated with numerically lower endpoint rates than controls. We detected no statistically significant differences in endpoints or safety between regimens.

AI.tldr: 在POTCAST试验中，MRA、补钾或联合治疗均能提升血钾，且主要终点发生率均低于对照组，但三种方案间无显著差异。
AI.motivation: POTCAST试验显示靶向高正常血钾可减少ICD患者室性心律失常，但不同升钾方案（MRA、补钾、联合）对血钾及结局的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 预设观察性分析，纳入POTCAST中600例对照和572例完成升钾治疗的干预患者，干预组按方案分为MRA单药、补钾单药和联合治疗。主要终点为持续性室性心律失常、恰当ICD治疗、心律失常或心衰住院或全因死亡的复合终点；安全性终点包括死亡和电解质/肾功能紊乱。
AI.result: 6个月后血钾分别从4.12升至4.27 mmol/L（MRA，p=0.004）、3.99升至4.24 mmol/L（补钾，p<0.001）、3.98升至4.34 mmol/L（联合，p<0.001）。主要终点发生率：对照组29%（n=175），MRA组22%（n=16），补钾组21%（n=31），联合组22%（n=72），组间p=0.8。低钾血症发生率对照组13%，MRA组3%、补钾组9%、联合组5%；高钾血症对照组0.2%，MRA组0%、补钾组3%、联合组4%（组间p>0.1）。
AI.conclusion: 三种升钾方案均有效提升血钾，且主要终点发生率数值上低于对照组，但方案间无统计学差异。临床可根据患者情况选择升钾策略，但需注意高钾风险，尤其联合治疗时。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：POTCAST试验（n=1,200）显示，以高正常血浆钾水平为目标可减少植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）患者的室性心律失常。我们比较了血浆钾的变化，并描述了用于提高血浆钾的三种方案的结果。

方法：我们研究了POTCAST中完成钾上调的600名对照参与者和572名干预参与者。干预组的参与者根据血浆钾上调后的治疗分为：a）盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRAs）单药治疗，b）钾补充剂单药治疗，或c）两者联合治疗。主要终点是持续性室性心律失常、适当的ICD治疗、因心律失常或心力衰竭住院或全因死亡率的复合终点。安全性结局包括死亡和电解质/肾脏紊乱。

结果：六个月后，MRA组血浆钾从4.12升至4.27 mmol/L（p=0.004），钾补充剂组从3.99升至4.24 mmol/L（p<0.001），联合治疗组从3.98升至4.34 mmol/L（p<0.001）。主要终点发生在29%（n=175）的对照组、22%（n=16）的MRA组、21%（n=31）的钾补充剂组和22%（n=72）的联合治疗组（方案间p=0.8）。低钾血症发生在13%的对照组和3%、9%和5%的接受MRA、钾补充剂和联合治疗的参与者中。高钾血症发生在0.2%的对照组和0%、3%和4%的接受MRA、钾补充剂和联合治疗的参与者中（方案间p>0.1）。

结论：使用MRA、钾补充剂或两者治疗均提高了钾水平。所有方案均与数值上低于对照组的终点率相关。我们未检测到方案间在终点或安全性方面有统计学显著差异。

title: The prevalence of Brugada syndrome in patients presenting to an emergency room in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Brugada syndrome (BrS) is a rare inherited arrhythmia associated with an increased risk of sudden cardiac death. Significant variation in the prevalence of BrS across different countries has been well documented. However, no study has examined the prevalence of BrS in Saudi Arabia. Therefore, our aim was to assess the prevalence of BrS in patients presenting to an emergency department (ED) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

METHODS: This retrospective study included consecutive adult patients who presented to the ED at King Khalid University Hospital (KKUH) and underwent an electrocardiogram (ECG). Demographic and clinical variables were collected from the records, and ECGs were examined for the presence of a Brugada pattern (BrP). BrS was diagnosed when a type 1 BrP was observed with no secondary causes, and BrP was diagnosed when a non-type 1 pattern was observed. A prespecified sensitivity analysis was conducted, excluding patients whose presentation was potentially compatible with BrS (syncope, presyncope, cardiac arrest, and palpitations).

RESULTS: We included 1,000 patients. Men constituted 498 patients (49.8%). The majority were Saudi nationals (830, 85.6%) and the overall median age was 46 years (IQR: 30-65 years). The majority of the patients were afebrile at presentation (915, 93%) and a small number of patients took Brugada-inducing medications (27, 2.7%). The prevalence of BrS was 2/1,000 (0.002; 95% CI: 0.0002-0.007) and the prevalence of BrP was 26/1,000 (0.026; 95% CI: 0.0179-0.0390). Among the patients with BrP, 11 exhibited a type 2 pattern (42.3%) and 15 exhibited a type 3 pattern (57.7%). The sensitivity analysis revealed a prevalence of BrS of 2/912 (0.002; 95% CI: 0.0-0.0061) and a prevalence of BrP of 26/912 (0.028; 95% CI: 0.0178-0.0402).

CONCLUSION: This is the first Saudi Arabian study on BrS prevalence, suggesting a high prevalence and a notable proportion of non-type 1 Brugada electrocardiogram (ECG) patterns.

AI.tldr: 沙特利雅得急诊1000例患者中Brugada综合征患病率为0.2%，Brugada心电图模式患病率为2.6%，提示该地区患病率较高。
AI.motivation: Brugada综合征是罕见的遗传性心律失常，与心源性猝死风险增加相关，不同国家患病率差异显著，但此前尚无沙特阿拉伯的相关研究，因此本研究旨在评估利雅得急诊患者中Brugada综合征的患病率。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入连续就诊于沙特利雅得King Khalid大学医院急诊科并接受心电图检查的成年患者，共1000例。从病历中收集人口学和临床变量，检查心电图是否存在Brugada模式（BrP）。Brugada综合征（BrS）定义为观察到1型BrP且无继发原因；BrP定义为观察到非1型模式。预设敏感性分析排除就诊表现可能与BrS相关（晕厥、先兆晕厥、心脏骤停和心悸）的患者。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个沙特阿拉伯关于BrS患病率的研究，提示患病率较高且非1型Brugada心电图模式占相当比例。研究结果对当地急诊心电图筛查和BrS识别具有临床意义，但为单中心回顾性研究，样本量有限，结论需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：Brugada综合征（BrS）是一种罕见的遗传性心律失常，与心源性猝死风险增加相关。不同国家间BrS患病率的显著差异已被充分记录。然而，尚无研究探讨沙特阿拉伯的BrS患病率。因此，我们的目的是评估沙特阿拉伯利雅得急诊科（ED）就诊患者中BrS的患病率。

方法：这项回顾性研究纳入了连续就诊于King Khalid大学医院（KKUH）急诊科并接受心电图（ECG）检查的成年患者。从记录中收集人口学和临床变量，并检查ECG是否存在Brugada波型（BrP）。当观察到1型BrP且无继发原因时诊断为BrS，当观察到非1型波型时诊断为BrP。进行了预先设定的敏感性分析，排除了就诊表现可能与BrS相容的患者（晕厥、先兆晕厥、心脏骤停和心悸）。

结果：我们纳入了1,000例患者。男性498例（49.8%）。大多数为沙特国民（830例，85.6%），总体中位年龄为46岁（IQR：30-65岁）。大多数患者就诊时无发热（915例，93%），少数患者服用了Brugada诱发药物（27例，2.7%）。BrS的患病率为2/1,000（0.002；95% CI：0.0002-0.007），BrP的患病率为26/1,000（0.026；95% CI：0.0179-0.0390）。在BrP患者中，11例表现为2型波型（42.3%），15例表现为3型波型（57.7%）。敏感性分析显示BrS的患病率为2/912（0.002；95% CI：0.0-0.0061），BrP的患病率为26/912（0.028；95% CI：0.0178-0.0402）。

结论：这是沙特阿拉伯首项关于BrS患病率的研究，提示患病率高且非1型Brugada心电图（ECG）波型比例显著。

title: Performance and Limitations of Multipolar Electrogram Mapping in Scar-Related Ventricular Tachycardia.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Multipolar electrogram is designed to improve near-field (NF) signal clarity by subtracting far-field (FF) components using adjacent electrodes.

OBJECTIVE: To assess the performance of multipolar electrogram mapping in identifying critical activation pathways and substrates in ventricular tachycardia (VT).

METHODS: Scar-related VT maps created using the CARTO™3 system and Optrell™ catheter were analyzed. Bipolar VT activation maps were created using wavefront algorithm (annotating unipolar maximum -dV/dt), while substrate maps employed late annotation mapping (LAM). Bipolar maps were converted into multipolar maps offline using the CARTOREPLAY TM module. Electrograms with both NF and FF components-including local abnormal ventricular activities (LAVA), late potentials (LP), and diastolic signals-were compared between bipolar and multipolar maps. Auto-annotation accuracy was evaluated.

RESULTS: A total of 3,636 electrograms from 53 maps (45 patients, age 64±9 years, 87% male, 57% ischemic) were analyzed. Multipolar signals showed higher NF/FF amplitude ratio than bipolar signals (1.50 [0.61-3.08] vs. 1.19 [0.52-2.60], p<0.0001). Multipolar activation mapping more accurately identified diastolic potentials than bipolar wavefront mapping (76% vs. 46%, p<0.0001). However, multipolar substrate mapping was less sensitive in detecting LAVA/LP than bipolar LAM (80% vs. 92%, p<0.0001). Of 30 maps with LPs, 87% had LPs missed by the multipolar algorithm but captured by LAM. Smaller NF / larger FF amplitudes and perimeter electrodes predicted multipolar annotation errors.

CONCLUSIONS: Multipolar activation mapping enhances diastolic potential detection but reduces sensitivity for VT substrate identification compared to bipolar LAM. These findings inform optimal electrogram annotation approaches for VT activation and substrate mapping.

AI.tldr: 多极电图标测在瘢痕相关室速中能提高舒张期电位识别率（76% vs 46%），但检测LAVA/晚电位的敏感性低于双极LAM（80% vs 92%）。
AI.motivation: 多极电图通过相邻电极相减远场成分以提高近场信号清晰度，但其在室速关键传导通路和基质识别中的性能尚不明确，既往缺乏与双极标测的系统比较。
AI.method: 回顾性分析53幅瘢痕相关室速标测图（45例患者，年龄64±9岁，87%男性，57%缺血性），使用CARTO™3系统和Optrell™导管。双极激动图采用波前算法（标注单极最大-dV/dt），基质图采用晚标注标测（LAM），离线转换为多极图。比较双极与多极图中含近场和远场成分的电图（LAVA、晚电位、舒张期信号），并评估自动标注准确性。
AI.result: 共分析3,636个电图。多极信号近场/远场振幅比高于双极（1.50 [0.61-3.08] vs 1.19 [0.52-2.60]，p<0.0001）。多极激动图识别舒张期电位优于双极波前图（76% vs 46%，p<0.0001）。但多极基质图检测LAVA/晚电位的敏感性低于双极LAM（80% vs 92%，p<0.0001）。30幅含晚电位的图中，87%的晚电位被多极算法遗漏但被LAM捕获。较小的近场/较大的远场振幅及周边电极预测多极标注错误。
AI.conclusion: 多极激动标测可增强舒张期电位检测，但相比双极LAM降低了室速基质识别敏感性。这些发现提示应根据标测目的选择电图标注策略，并注意多极标测在基质识别中的局限性。

summary_zh:
背景：多极电图旨在通过使用相邻电极减去远场（FF）成分来改善近场（NF）信号的清晰度。

目的：评估多极电图标测在识别室性心动过速（VT）关键激动通路和基质方面的性能。

方法：分析使用CARTO™3系统和Optrell™导管创建的瘢痕相关VT标测图。双极VT激动图使用波前算法（标注单极最大-dV/dt）创建，而基质图采用晚标注标测（LAM）。双极图通过CARTOREPLAY TM模块离线转换为多极图。比较双极和多极图中同时具有NF和FF成分的电图——包括局部异常心室活动（LAVA）、晚电位（LP）和舒张期信号。评估自动标注准确性。

结果：共分析来自53张标测图（45例患者，年龄64±9岁，87%男性，57%缺血性）的3,636个电图。多极信号显示比双极信号更高的NF/FF振幅比（1.50 [0.61-3.08] vs. 1.19 [0.52-2.60]，p<0.0001）。多极激动标测比双极波前标测更准确地识别舒张期电位（76% vs. 46%，p<0.0001）。然而，多极基质标测在检测LAVA/LP方面不如双极LAM敏感（80% vs. 92%，p<0.0001）。在30张有LP的标测图中，87%的LP被多极算法遗漏但被LAM捕获。较小的NF/较大的FF振幅和周边电极预测多极标注错误。

结论：与双极LAM相比，多极激动标测增强了舒张期电位检测，但降低了VT基质识别的敏感性。这些发现为VT激动和基质标测的最佳电图标注方法提供了信息。

title: Feasibility and Acute Hemodynamic Outcomes of S3 Functional Mapping During Scar-Related Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation.
Multimodality Cardiovascular Imaging in the Evaluation of Cardiac Sarcoidosis.
summary: Cardiac sarcoidosis (CS) is a granulomatous disease associated with increased cardiovascular risk, including symptomatic high-grade atrioventricular block, ventricular arrhythmia, heart failure, and sudden cardiac death. Diagnosis can be challenging and requires a high index of suspicion. Although endomyocardial biopsy demonstrating noncaseating granulomas can diagnose CS with high specificity, sampling error leads to low sensitivity. CS is typically diagnosed using a combination of clinical criteria and advanced cardiac imaging, such as cardiac magnetic resonance and positron emission tomography, which can detect myocardial inflammation and fibrosis seen in CS. Recent advances in cardiac magnetic resonance and positron emission tomography have not only substantially improved the diagnosis of CS, but have also improved prognostic assessment, monitoring of treatment response, and guidance of other clinical decision-making, such as immunosuppressive and device therapy. Advanced cardiac imaging has been incorporated into recent international guidelines on inflammatory heart disease, and holds great promise to reshape contemporary clinical care for patients with CS.

AI.tldr: 多模态心脏影像（CMR与PET）可提高心脏结节病的诊断、预后评估及治疗决策指导，但摘要未报告具体研究数据。
AI.motivation: 心脏结节病可导致高级别房室传导阻滞、室性心律失常、心衰和心源性猝死，诊断困难；心内膜心肌活检特异性高但采样误差致敏感性低，临床亟需无创影像手段来识别心肌炎症与纤维化，并指导免疫抑制和器械治疗。
AI.method: 本文为综述性文章，系统阐述多模态心血管影像（心脏磁共振和正电子发射断层扫描）在心脏结节病评估中的应用；摘要未报告具体研究类型、样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值；仅定性指出CMR和PET的进展显著改善了心脏结节病的诊断、预后评估、治疗反应监测，并有助于免疫抑制和器械治疗等临床决策，相关影像技术已被纳入近期国际炎症性心脏病指南。
AI.conclusion: 多模态心脏影像有望重塑心脏结节病的临床管理，支持其在诊断、危险分层和治疗决策中的整合应用；但摘要未提供原始研究数据，具体诊断效能和预后价值需参考全文及后续研究。

summary_zh: 心脏结节病（CS）是一种肉芽肿性疾病，与心血管风险增加相关，包括有症状的高度房室传导阻滞、室性心律失常、心力衰竭和心源性猝死。诊断可能具有挑战性，需要高度怀疑。尽管心内膜心肌活检显示非干酪样肉芽肿可以高特异性诊断CS，但采样误差导致敏感性低。CS通常通过临床标准与先进心脏影像学（如心脏磁共振和正电子发射断层扫描）相结合来诊断，这些影像学可以检测CS中所见的心肌炎症和纤维化。心脏磁共振和正电子发射断层扫描的最新进展不仅显著改善了CS的诊断，还改善了预后评估、治疗反应监测以及其他临床决策的指导，例如免疫抑制和器械治疗。先进的心脏影像学已被纳入近期关于炎症性心脏病的国际指南，并有望重塑CS患者的当代临床护理。

title: Association of Poor Adherence to Guideline-Directed Medical Treatment With Adverse Events Including Fatal Arrhythmia in Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction: A Nationwide Cohort Analysis
summary: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Poor adherence to guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) correlates with increased risks of mortality and hospitalization. Whether it is associated with life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias (VA) remains unclear. We assessed GDMT adherence levels and clinical outcomes in patients with HFrEF. METHODS: Using the National Health Insurance Service database, patients who underwent implantable cardioverter-defibrillator or cardiac resynchronization therapy with a defibrillator implantation between 2008 to 2020 for primary prevention were included. Those with sustained ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation/flutter, or aborted sudden cardiac death were excluded. Adherence to renin-angiotensin system blockers (RASB), beta blockers (BB), and mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRA) was assessed using the weighted proportion of days covered method. The primary outcome was a composite of all-cause mortality and life-threatening VA. RESULTS: Among 3,780 patients, prescription rates were 87.5% for RASB, 89.7% for BB, and 74.2% for MRA. Poor adherence was associated with an increased risk of the primary outcome (hazard ratio [HR], 1.54; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.31-1.82) and all-cause mortality (HR, 1.83; 95% CI, 1.52-2.20) compared with optimal adherence. These associations were more pronounced in ischemic heart failure (HF). Although crude VA event rates were numerically higher with lower adherence, these associations were insignificant after covariate adjustment, regardless of HF etiology. CONCLUSIONS: Lower GDMT adherence was independently associated with increased mortality despite device therapy, particularly in ischemic HF. Although its relationship with arrhythmic outcomes was unclear, sustained adherence remains important and supports targeted interventions to enhance treatment continuity.

AI.tldr: 在植入ICD或CRT-D进行一级预防的HFrEF患者中，GDMT依从性差与全因死亡和致命性室性心律失常复合终点风险增加独立相关，尤其在缺血性心衰中更显著。
AI.motivation: GDMT依从性差与HFrEF患者死亡和住院风险增加相关，但其与致命性室性心律失常（VA）的关系尚不明确，本研究旨在评估GDMT依从性与临床结局的关系。
AI.method: 基于韩国国民健康保险服务数据库的全国性队列研究，纳入2008-2020年因一级预防植入ICD或CRT-D的HFrEF患者，排除有持续性室速、室颤/扑动或心脏骤停复苏史者。使用加权药物持有比例法评估RASB、BB和MRA的依从性。主要终点为全因死亡和致命性VA的复合终点。
AI.result: 共纳入3,780例患者，RASB、BB和MRA的处方率分别为87.5%、89.7%和74.2%。与最佳依从性相比，依从性差与主要终点风险增加相关（HR 1.54；95%CI 1.31-1.82），全因死亡风险增加（HR 1.83；95%CI 1.52-2.20）。这些关联在缺血性心衰中更显著。VA事件粗率随依从性降低而数值上升高，但校正协变量后无统计学意义，无论心衰病因如何。
AI.conclusion: GDMT依从性差与器械治疗后死亡率增加独立相关，尤其在缺血性心衰中。尽管与心律失常结局的关系不明确，但持续依从性仍很重要，支持针对性干预以提高治疗连续性。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）患者对指南导向药物治疗（GDMT）的依从性差与死亡和住院风险增加相关。其是否与危及生命的室性心律失常（VA）相关尚不清楚。我们评估了HFrEF患者的GDMT依从性水平和临床结局。

方法：利用国民健康保险服务数据库，纳入2008年至2020年间因一级预防接受植入式心律转复除颤器或心脏再同步治疗除颤器植入的患者。排除有持续性室性心动过速、心室颤动/扑动或心脏性猝死生还的患者。使用加权覆盖天数比例法评估对肾素-血管紧张素系统阻滞剂（RASB）、β受体阻滞剂（BB）和盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRA）的依从性。主要结局是全因死亡和危及生命的VA的复合终点。

结果：在3,780例患者中，RASB处方率为87.5%，BB为89.7%，MRA为74.2%。与最佳依从性相比，依从性差与主要结局风险增加相关（风险比[HR]，1.54；95%置信区间[CI]，1.31-1.82）和全因死亡风险增加相关（HR，1.83；95% CI，1.52-2.20）。这些关联在缺血性心力衰竭（HF）中更为明显。尽管粗VA事件率在依从性较低时数值上较高，但在协变量调整后，无论HF病因如何，这些关联均不显著。

结论：尽管接受了器械治疗，较低的GDMT依从性仍与死亡率增加独立相关，尤其是在缺血性HF中。尽管其与心律失常结局的关系尚不明确，但持续依从仍然重要，并支持采取针对性干预措施以增强治疗连续性。

title: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Machine Learning Approach for Ventricular Fibrillation Detection Using Heart Rate Variability Features
summary: In this work, we developed a hybrid quantum-classical pipeline for VF detection using two public PhysioNet databases: the MIT-BIH Malignant Ventricular Arrhythmia Database (VFDB) and the MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database (NSRDB). An 8-qubit ZZ-type feature map, simulated classically, was applied to eight scaled HRV features, and X-basis expectation values yielded 15 quantum features, giving a 23-dimensional hybrid vector. A classical RBF-kernel support vector machine (SVM) using the eight HRV features was compared with a hybrid SVM using the combined set, under 5-fold Stratified Group K-Fold cross-validation with record-wise separation and training-only preprocessing. The classical SVM achieved accuracy of 93.16%, sensitivity of 93.93%, specificity of 93.42%, and ROC-AUC of 0.984; the hybrid SVM achieved 93.54%, 95.11%, 93.42%, and 0.986
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.tldr: 混合量子-经典SVM在室颤检测中较经典SVM敏感度提升至95.11%，但准确率与特异度无显著改善。
AI.motivation: 室颤（VF）的自动检测依赖心率变异性（HRV）特征，但经典机器学习模型敏感度有限；量子计算特征映射可能提升高维模式识别能力，既往缺乏在公共数据库上的验证。
AI.method: 研究采用MIT-BIH恶性室性心律失常数据库（VFDB）和正常窦性心律数据库（NSRDB）的公共数据，构建混合量子-经典流程：对8个缩放后的HRV特征应用8量子比特ZZ型特征映射（经典模拟），取X基期望值得到15个量子特征，与8个HRV特征拼接为23维混合向量。比较经典RBF核SVM（仅8个HRV特征）与混合SVM（23维向量），采用5折分层分组K折交叉验证（按记录分离，预处理仅在训练集进行）。主要终点为准确率、敏感度、特异度和ROC-AUC。
AI.result: 经典SVM准确率93.16%、敏感度93.93%、特异度93.42%、ROC-AUC 0.984；混合SVM对应为93.54%、95.11%、93.42%、0.986。摘要未报告置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 混合量子-经典SVM在保持特异度与AUC相当的情况下，敏感度较经典SVM提高约1.2个百分点，提示量子特征映射可能有助于减少室颤漏检；但准确率提升有限，且为经典模拟的回顾性分析，临床转化价值需进一步前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 在本研究中，我们使用两个公开的PhysioNet数据库：MIT-BIH恶性室性心律失常数据库（VFDB）和MIT-BIH正常窦性心律数据库（NSRDB），开发了一种用于VF检测的混合量子-经典流程。一个8量子比特的ZZ型特征映射（经典模拟）被应用于八个缩放后的HRV特征，X基期望值产生了15个量子特征，从而形成一个23维的混合向量。使用八个HRV特征的经典RBF核支持向量机（SVM）与使用组合集的混合SVM进行了比较，采用5折分层组K折交叉验证，按记录分离且仅在训练集上进行预处理。经典SVM达到了93.16%的准确率、93.93%的灵敏度、93.42%的特异性和0.984的ROC-AUC；混合SVM达到了93.54%、95.11%、93.42%和0.986。

title: Sign concordance of the Lean RECD tick and Level-3 excess3 on pre-VF Holter recordings does not extend to the alarm time
summary: Background. A published analysis of ten Holter recordings that end in spontaneous ventricular fibrillation (VF), from the Sudden Cardiac Death Holter Database (SDDB), contrasted a basal window with an approach window for systemic tau (τs) and for the Level-3 series excess3. The Lean RECD tick ΔT = g(τs)|τs|, built on the gate g of Module CT, had not been compared with excess3 on these recordings. Methods. The analysis used the ten recordings, windows and anchors of the published analysis, W = 101 beats, stride 5, Bandt-Pompe patterns of order 3 with delay 1, and gate parameter kn = 0. For each record, the sign of ΔA, the approach-minus-basal mean of ΔT, was compared with the sign of ΔB = Δexcess3, the zero sets of g and excess3 were checked, and the frozen abs-z alarm detector was applied to both series after a reproduction control. Results. A reproduction control matched the published detector results. The sign of ΔA matched the sign of ΔB in 8/10 records, and records 32 and 45 did not match. The alarm of ΔT matched the alarm of excess3 in 6/10 records. In none of the six double alarms did the lead times agree within one stride-5 step, and the largest difference was −5.15 h in record 51. Conclusion. In these ten SDDB Holter recordings, the sign of ΔA for the Lean tick matches the sign of Δexcess3 in 8/10 records, while the abs-z alarm does not match (6/10) and the lead time does not match in any double alarm. AI.tldr: 在10份以室颤终止的Holter记录中，Lean RECD指标ΔT的变化方向与excess3在8/10记录中一致，但报警时间一致性仅6/10且提前时间均不吻合。
AI.motivation: 室颤前是否存在可检测的动力学前兆尚不明确。既往分析在SDDB的10份室颤Holter中比较了系统τs和Level-3 excess3，但基于Module CT门控g构建的Lean RECD指标ΔT尚未与excess3在这些记录上进行比较。
AI.method: 回顾性分析10份SDDB中以自发性室颤终止的Holter记录，沿用已发表分析的窗口和锚点，窗宽W=101搏动，步长5，Bandt-Pompe模式阶数3、延迟1，门控参数kn=0。对每份记录比较ΔA（ΔT的approach减basal均值）与ΔB（Δexcess3）的符号，检查g和excess3的零集，并在复现控制后对两个序列应用冻结的abs-z报警检测器。
AI.result: 复现控制与已发表检测器结果一致。ΔA与ΔB符号在8/10记录中匹配，记录32和45不匹配。ΔT与excess3的报警在6/10记录中匹配。在6次双重报警中，提前时间均未在1个步长5内一致，最大差异为记录51的−5.15小时。
AI.conclusion: 在10份SDDB室颤Holter记录中，Lean RECD指标ΔT的变化方向与excess3在8/10记录中一致，但abs-z报警一致性仅6/10，且双重报警的提前时间均不吻合。提示两个指标在趋势上部分相关，但报警时间特性不同，不能互相替代用于室颤预警。

summary_zh: 背景：一项已发表的分析纳入了来自心脏性猝死 Holter 数据库（SDDB）的 10 份以自发性心室颤动（VF）终止的 Holter 记录，该分析对比了系统性 tau（τs）和 Level-3 序列 excess3 的基线窗口与接近窗口。基于 Module CT 的门控 g 构建的 Lean RECD tick ΔT = g(τs)|τs|，尚未在这些记录上与 excess3 进行比较。方法：分析使用了已发表分析中的 10 份记录、窗口和锚点，W = 101 个心搏，步长 5，阶数为 3、延迟为 1 的 Bandt-Pompe 模式，以及门控参数 kn = 0。对于每份记录，将 ΔA（ΔT 的接近窗口减基线窗口均值）的符号与 ΔB = Δexcess3 的符号进行比较，检查 g 和 excess3 的零集，并在进行复现控制后，将冻结的 abs-z 报警检测器应用于两个序列。结果：复现控制与已发表的检测器结果一致。ΔA 的符号与 ΔB 的符号在 8/10 份记录中一致，记录 32 和 45 不一致。ΔT 的报警与 excess3 的报警在 6/10 份记录中一致。在六次双重报警中，没有任何一次的前置时间在步长 5 的一个步长内一致，最大差异为记录 51 中的 −5.15 小时。结论：在这 10 份 SDDB Holter 记录中，Lean tick 的 ΔA 符号与 Δexcess3 的符号在 8/10 份记录中一致，而 abs-z 报警不一致（6/10），且在任何双重报警中前置时间均不一致。通讯作者：joel.padilla2@upr.edu。ORCID：https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5797-6931。

title: Seizure Like Activity During Permanent Pacemaker Implantation: A Case of Suspected Venous Air Embolism With Acute Hypoxia
summary: Venous air embolism is a rare complication of pacemaker implantation. A 78 year old man developed sudden generalized stiffness, seizure-like activity, and severe hypoxia (oxygen saturation 70%) during lead manipulation without hypotension or arrhythmia. Prompt recognition, high-flow oxygen, and temporary procedural interruption led to complete recovery without neurological sequelae.

AI.tldr: 78岁男性永久起搏器植入术中发生疑似静脉空气栓塞，表现为癫痫样活动和严重低氧血症，经高流量吸氧及暂停操作后完全恢复。
AI.motivation: 静脉空气栓塞是起搏器植入术的罕见并发症，但可能危及生命。临床医生需提高对其非典型表现（如癫痫样活动）的识别能力，以避免延误处理。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。患者为78岁男性，在永久起搏器植入术中导线操作时突发全身僵硬、癫痫样活动和严重低氧血症（血氧饱和度70%），无低血压和心律失常。干预为高流量吸氧和暂停手术操作。
AI.result: 患者经高流量吸氧和暂停操作后完全恢复，无神经系统后遗症。摘要未报告其他定量数据。
AI.conclusion: 疑似静脉空气栓塞可表现为癫痫样活动和严重低氧血症，及时识别并给予高流量吸氧、暂停操作可避免不良后果。临床医生在起搏器植入术中应警惕此并发症，但本报告为单例，结论推广受限。

summary_zh: 静脉空气栓塞是起搏器植入术的一种罕见并发症。一名78岁男性在导线操作过程中突发全身僵硬、癫痫样活动及严重低氧血症（血氧饱和度70%），无低血压或心律失常。及时识别、高流量吸氧及暂时中断手术操作使患者完全康复，未遗留神经系统后遗症。

title: Case Report: Double-click on the ventricle: ventricular safety pacing triggered by right atrial lead dislodgement in a patient after right atrial tumor resection.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial lead dislodgment is not uncommon after permanent pacemaker implantation, especially in patients with atrial anatomic abnormity. Unique electrocardiography manifestation might give clues for promptly diagnosis. In patients with reconstructed right atrium, optimal pacing strategies and lead stability remain challenging.

CASE PRESENTATION: A 44-year-old woman developed symptomatic sinus node dysfunction after right atrial tumor resection and reconstruction. A dual-chamber pacemaker was implanted, resulting in symptom resolution. At routine follow-up, electrocardiography showed ventricle was intermittently captured by one initial pacing artifact which was immediately followed by another pacing artifact at a fixed interval of 110-ms, consistent with ventricular safety pacing. Device interrogation revealed normal ventricular lead parameters but loss of atrial capture. Imaging confirmed atrial lead dislodgement into the right ventricle. The atrial lead was subsequently extracted and the device was reprogrammed to VVI mode. After 3 months follow-up, the patient remained asymptomatic and was with normal cardiac function.

CONCLUSION: This case highlights the importance of diagnostic role of electrocardiography to detect lead dislodgement. In patents with surgically altered right atrium, individualized pacing strategies, such as single-chamber ventricular pacing, may be appropriate. Novel atrial pacing lead with fix helix or leadless pacing might do some help to reduce the risk of dislodgement.

AI.tldr: 44岁女性右心房肿瘤切除重建后植入双腔起搏器，随访发现心房导线脱位至右心室，心电图表现为心室安全起搏，重新程控为VVI模式后无症状。
AI.motivation: 永久起搏器植入后心房导线脱位并不少见，尤其在心房解剖异常患者中；右心房重建术后最佳起搏策略和导线稳定性仍具挑战性，心电图独特表现可能为及时诊断提供线索。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为44岁女性，右心房肿瘤切除重建后出现症状性窦房结功能障碍，植入双腔起搏器。随访时进行心电图和起搏器程控检查，并通过影像学确认导线位置。干预为拔除心房导线并重新程控为VVI模式，随访3个月。
AI.result: 常规随访心电图显示心室被第一个起搏信号间歇性夺获，紧接着在固定110 ms间期出现第二个起搏信号，符合心室安全起搏。起搏器程控显示心室导线参数正常但心房失夺获，影像学证实心房导线脱位至右心室。拔除心房导线并程控为VVI模式后，3个月随访患者无症状，心功能正常。
AI.conclusion: 本病例强调心电图在检测导线脱位中的诊断价值；对于外科改变右心房的患者，个体化起搏策略如单腔心室起搏可能合适，新型固定螺旋心房导线或无导线起搏可能有助于降低脱位风险。

summary_zh:
背景：永久起搏器植入术后心房导线脱位并不少见，尤其是在心房解剖结构异常的患者中。独特的心电图表现可能为及时诊断提供线索。在右心房重建的患者中，最佳起搏策略和导线稳定性仍具有挑战性。

病例介绍：一名44岁女性在右心房肿瘤切除和重建后出现症状性窦房结功能障碍。植入双腔起搏器后症状缓解。在常规随访中，心电图显示心室被一个初始起搏伪影间歇性夺获，该伪影后立即跟随另一个起搏伪影，固定间隔为110毫秒，符合心室安全起搏。设备检查显示心室导线参数正常，但心房夺获丧失。影像学证实心房导线脱位进入右心室。随后拔除心房导线，并将设备重新编程为VVI模式。随访3个月后，患者保持无症状，心脏功能正常。

结论：本病例强调了心电图在检测导线脱位中的诊断作用的重要性。在右心房手术改变的患者中，个体化起搏策略，如单腔心室起搏，可能是合适的。新型固定螺旋心房起搏导线或无导线起搏可能有助于降低脱位风险。

title: Consensus-Recommended Follow-Up Mediates Cardiovascular Outcomes Disparities Between Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator and Pacemaker Recipients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Consensus-recommended follow-up after cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) implantation improves outcomes, yet whether it mediates cardiovascular disparities between device types remains unknown.

METHODS: We prospectively studied 6806 patients undergoing CIED implantation across a multi-hospital system (2019-2023; median follow-up 3.5 years), categorized as implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) (n = 2757) or permanent pacemaker (PPM) (n = 4049). Causal mediation analysis decomposed the effect of device type on major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and device extraction into direct and follow-up mediated components, adjusting for demographics and comorbidities.

RESULTS: ICD recipients had significantly lower consensus-recommended follow-up rates than PPM recipients (65.3% vs. 79.2%; adjusted OR 0.46, 95% CI 0.40-0.52, p < 0.001) and substantially higher MACE risk (HR 1.89, 95% CI 1.66-2.25, p < 0.001), of which 53.5% was mediated by follow-up adherence. Device extraction rates were lower in ICD recipients (HR 0.30, 95% CI 0.24-0.38), with only 7.9% mediated by follow-up adherence.

CONCLUSIONS: More than half of the excess cardiovascular risk in ICD recipients was statistically mediated by suboptimal follow-up adherence-a potentially modifiable pathway. These findings identify follow-up adherence as a potentially important pathway and support further prospective investigation of strategies to improve monitoring and clinical outcomes in high-risk CIED populations.

AI.tldr: 在ICD与起搏器受者中，ICD患者共识推荐的随访依从性更低，其超额MACE风险有53.5%由随访依从性介导。
AI.motivation: 共识推荐的CIED术后随访可改善预后，但不同器械类型间的心血管结局差异是否由随访依从性介导尚不明确，本研究旨在探讨随访依从性在ICD与PPM受者心血管结局差异中的中介作用。
AI.method: 前瞻性多中心队列研究，纳入2019-2023年多医院系统内6806例CIED植入患者，分为ICD组（n=2757）和PPM组（n=4049），中位随访3.5年。采用因果中介分析，在调整人口学特征和合并症后，将器械类型对MACE和器械拔除的影响分解为直接效应和随访依从性介导的间接效应。
AI.result: ICD组共识推荐随访率显著低于PPM组（65.3% vs 79.2%；调整OR 0.46，95%CI 0.40-0.52，P<0.001）。ICD组MACE风险显著更高（HR 1.89，95%CI 1.66-2.25，P<0.001），其中53.5%由随访依从性介导。ICD组器械拔除率更低（HR 0.30，95%CI 0.24-0.38），仅7.9%由随访依从性介导。
AI.conclusion: ICD受者超过一半的超额心血管风险由随访依从性不佳介导，提示改善随访依从性可能是可干预的路径，支持进一步前瞻性研究优化高危CIED患者的监测与临床结局。

summary_zh:
背景：共识推荐的植入后随访可改善心脏植入式电子设备（CIED）植入后的结局，但随访是否介导了不同设备类型之间的心血管差异仍不清楚。

方法：我们前瞻性研究了在多医院系统内接受CIED植入的6806例患者（2019-2023年；中位随访3.5年），分为植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）组（n = 2757）或永久起搏器（PPM）组（n = 4049）。采用因果中介分析将设备类型对主要不良心血管事件（MACE）和设备拔除的影响分解为直接效应和随访介导的效应，并校正人口学特征和合并症。

结果：ICD接受者的共识推荐随访率显著低于PPM接受者（65.3% vs. 79.2%；校正OR 0.46，95% CI 0.40-0.52，p < 0.001），且MACE风险显著更高（HR 1.89，95% CI 1.66-2.25，p < 0.001），其中53.5%由随访依从性介导。ICD接受者的设备拔除率较低（HR 0.30，95% CI 0.24-0.38），仅7.9%由随访依从性介导。

结论：ICD接受者中超过一半的额外心血管风险在统计学上由次优的随访依从性介导——这是一个可能可改变的路径。这些发现将随访依从性确定为可能重要的路径，并支持进一步前瞻性研究改善高风险CIED人群监测和临床结局的策略。

title: Deletion of the sodium leak channel NALCN in dopamine neurons alters D2R-mediated signalling and psychostimulant responsiveness.
summary: Midbrain dopamine (DA)-neurons are slow pacemakers that continuously fire action potentials, maintaining basal extracellular DA levels in target regions. The sodium leak channel NALCN has been identified as a key contributor in the pacemaker control of these neurons. However, the consequences of a disrupted DA pacemaker activity remain largely unexplored. By generating mice lacking NALCN selectively in midbrain DA-neurons, we investigated the impact of this deletion on the activity of ventral tegmental area DA-neurons, D2R-mediated signalling, reactivity to cues predicting threat and psychostimulant responsiveness in both males and females. Selective deletion of NALCN in midbrain DA-neurons dampens their tonic activity, without reducing the basal extracellular DA levels in the nucleus accumbens. Mice with a loss of NALCN in DA-neurons exhibit no impairments of basal motor responses, unaltered reactivity to cues predicting threat and risk assessment, while the neurochemical and behavioural responsiveness to psychostimulant drugs are enhanced and presynaptic D2R-mediated signalling at DA terminals is altered. Together, our results emphasize the important role of NALCN conductance in controlling DA pacemaker activity, D2R-mediated signalling and in modulating motor responses to psychostimulants. KEY POINTS: The sodium leak channel NALCN is an important contributor to the spontaneous pacemaker activity in dopamine neurons, but the consequences of its loss in these neurons remain largely unknown. We investigated how selective deletion of NALCN in dopamine neurons affects neuronal activity, dopamine receptor signalling and behavioural responses in male and female mice. Loss of NALCN markedly reduced the spontaneous activity of dopamine neurons, yet basal motor function, reward-related responses and reactivity to threat-predicting cues remained largely preserved. In contrast, neurochemical and behavioural responsiveness to psychostimulant drugs are enhanced, probably through an altered presynaptic D2R-mediated signalling at DA terminals. NALCN emerges as a key regulator of dopamine neuron activity, with disrupted pacemaker firing selectively enhancing psychostimulant sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 多巴胺神经元选择性敲除NALCN通道降低其起搏活动，但不影响基础多巴胺水平，而增强对精神兴奋剂的反应。
AI.motivation: 中脑多巴胺神经元是慢起搏细胞，NALCN通道是其起搏活动的关键贡献者，但NALCN缺失对多巴胺神经元活动及行为的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 研究采用条件性基因敲除小鼠，在中脑多巴胺神经元选择性敲除NALCN，评估腹侧被盖区多巴胺神经元电活动、D2R信号、威胁预测线索反应及精神兴奋剂反应，雌雄小鼠均纳入。
AI.result: NALCN缺失降低多巴胺神经元紧张性放电，但不减少伏隔核基础细胞外多巴胺水平；基础运动反应、威胁预测线索反应及风险评估未受损；精神兴奋剂的神经化学和行为反应增强，多巴胺末梢突触前D2R信号改变。
AI.conclusion: NALCN是调控多巴胺神经元起搏活动及D2R信号的关键调节因子，其缺失选择性增强精神兴奋剂敏感性，提示NALCN可能参与成瘾相关机制。

summary_zh: 中脑多巴胺（DA）神经元是缓慢的起搏细胞，持续发放动作电位，维持靶区基础细胞外DA水平。钠漏通道NALCN已被确定为这些神经元起搏控制的关键贡献者。然而，DA起搏活动被破坏的后果在很大程度上仍未被探索。通过在中脑DA神经元中选择性缺失NALCN的小鼠，我们研究了这种缺失对腹侧被盖区DA神经元活动、D2R介导的信号传导、对预测威胁线索的反应性以及雄性和雌性中精神兴奋剂反应性的影响。中脑DA神经元中选择性缺失NALCN会减弱其紧张性活动，而不降低伏隔核中的基础细胞外DA水平。DA神经元中NALCN缺失的小鼠没有表现出基础运动反应的损害，对预测威胁线索和风险评估的反应性未改变，而对精神兴奋剂药物的神经化学和行为反应性增强，并且DA末梢突触前D2R介导的信号传导发生改变。总之，我们的结果强调了NALCN电导在控制DA起搏活动、D2R介导的信号传导以及调节对精神兴奋剂的运动反应中的重要作用。关键点：钠漏通道NALCN是多巴胺神经元自发起搏活动的重要贡献者，但其在这些神经元中缺失的后果在很大程度上仍未知。我们研究了多巴胺神经元中选择性缺失NALCN如何影响雄性和雌性小鼠的神经元活动、多巴胺受体信号传导和行为反应。NALCN缺失显著降低了多巴胺神经元的自发活动，但基础运动功能、奖赏相关反应和对威胁预测线索的反应性在很大程度上得以保留。相反，对精神兴奋剂药物的神经化学和行为反应性增强，可能是通过DA末梢突触前D2R介导的信号传导改变所致。NALCN成为多巴胺神经元活动的关键调节因子，起搏放电的破坏选择性增强了精神兴奋剂敏感性。

title: Safety of bioelectrical impedance analysis in patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices: A systematic review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Bioelectrical impedance analysis is widely used in clinical settings to assess body composition, contributes to the management of various health conditions. However, for patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices, such as pacemakers and implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, concerns about electromagnetic interference have led to longstanding recommendations against using bioelectrical impedance analysis. In this systematic review, we aimed to assess the available evidence regarding the safety of cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) during bioelectrical impedance analysis procedures.

METHODS: Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched PubMed, IEEE Xplore, Embase, and CINAHL for studies reporting on bioelectrical impedance analysis safety in patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices. Inclusion criteria focused on human studies reporting CIED function outcomes during BIA measurements. Data on BIA frequencies, types of CIEDs and BIA, and observed electromagnetic interference effects were extracted. The quality and bias of the studies were assessed using the Oxford Levels of Evidence and ROBINS-I tools.

RESULTS: Out of 2003 records screened, 8 studies were included, encompassing 866 BIA measurements across frequencies ranging from 5 to 500 kHz. No studies reported electromagnetic interference or adverse events affecting CIED functionality.

CONCLUSION: No evidence of electromagnetic interference or adverse effects on CIED function was identified in the available studies evaluating BIA in patients with CIEDs. These findings support reconsideration of clinical recommendations that discourage BIA use in this population.

AI.tldr: 系统综述纳入8项研究、866次生物电阻抗分析测量，未发现对心脏植入式电子设备功能产生电磁干扰或不良事件。
AI.motivation: 生物电阻抗分析广泛用于体成分评估，但传统上因担忧电磁干扰而不推荐用于心脏植入式电子设备患者，这一禁忌缺乏系统评价证据。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA指南的系统综述，检索PubMed、IEEE Xplore、Embase和CINAHL，纳入报告心脏植入式电子设备患者接受生物电阻抗分析时设备功能结局的人体研究，提取分析频率、设备类型及电磁干扰效应，采用牛津证据等级和ROBINS-I工具评估质量与偏倚。
AI.result: 共筛选2003条记录，最终纳入8项研究，涵盖866次生物电阻抗分析测量，频率范围5-500 kHz；无研究报告电磁干扰或影响心脏植入式电子设备功能的不良事件。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据未发现生物电阻抗分析对心脏植入式电子设备功能产生电磁干扰或不良影响，支持重新审视禁止该人群使用生物电阻抗分析的临床推荐；但纳入研究数量有限，证据等级和偏倚风险摘要未报告，需更高质量研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：生物电阻抗分析在临床环境中广泛用于评估身体成分，有助于多种健康状况的管理。然而，对于植入心脏电子设备的患者，如起搏器和植入式心律转复除颤器，对电磁干扰的担忧导致了长期以来反对使用生物电阻抗分析的建议。在本系统综述中，我们旨在评估生物电阻抗分析过程中植入心脏电子设备（CIEDs）安全性的现有证据。

方法：遵循PRISMA指南，我们检索了PubMed、IEEE Xplore、Embase和CINAHL中报告植入心脏电子设备患者生物电阻抗分析安全性的研究。纳入标准侧重于报告BIA测量期间CIED功能结局的人体研究。提取了BIA频率、CIEDs和BIA类型以及观察到的电磁干扰效应的数据。使用牛津证据水平和ROBINS-I工具评估研究的质量和偏倚。

结果：在筛选的2003条记录中，纳入8项研究，涵盖866次BIA测量，频率范围为5至500 kHz。没有研究报告影响CIED功能的电磁干扰或不良事件。

结论：在评估CIEDs患者BIA的现有研究中，未发现电磁干扰或对CIED功能不良影响的证据。这些发现支持重新考虑不鼓励在该人群中使用BIA的临床建议。

title: Device-Sparing Posteroseptal Trans-Tricuspid Lead Implantation After Tricuspid TEER: A Three-Case Device Rounds Report.
summary: Transvenous right ventricular lead implantation after tricuspid transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (T-TEER) may be challenging because of potential interaction with implanted repair devices, grasped leaflets, or the repaired coaptation zone. We describe three patients requiring transvenous pacemaker or implantable cardioverter-defibrillator implantation after T-TEER with TriClip or PASCAL systems. In each case, the posterior-most T-TEER device was used as a fluoroscopic landmark to guide lead passage inferior and posterior to the device toward an unobstructed posteroseptal residual orifice. Pacemaker leads were delivered using catheter-and-wire crossing followed by advancement of a long slittable sheath, whereas the defibrillator lead required direct shaping and fluoroscopic manipulation because of sheathlead incompatibility. Implantation was successful in all three patients. During 612 months of follow-up, tricuspid regurgitation remained mild or trace, mean transtricuspid gradients ranged from 1.8 to 2.1 mmHg, and no echocardiographic leadleaflet or leaddevice interaction or lead-related complications were observed. This fluoroscopy-guided, device-sparing strategy may represent a practical option when transvenous right ventricular lead implantation is clinically necessary after T-TEER.

AI.tldr: 三例T-TEER术后患者采用后间隔残余孔道成功植入右室导线，随访6-12个月三尖瓣反流轻至微量，无导线-瓣叶或装置交互。
AI.motivation: T-TEER术后因植入装置、夹合瓣叶及修复后对合区可能阻碍经静脉右室导线植入，临床缺乏规避装置交互的植入策略。
AI.method: 设备病例报告，纳入3例T-TEER（TriClip或PASCAL系统）后需植入起搏器或ICD的患者。以最靠后的T-TEER装置为透视标志，引导导线经装置下后方进入后间隔残余孔道。起搏导线采用导管-导丝跨越后长可撕鞘推进；除颤导线因鞘-导线不兼容需直接塑形和透视操作。随访6-12个月，评估三尖瓣反流程度、跨三尖瓣平均压差及导线-瓣叶/装置交互和导线相关并发症。
AI.result: 3例均成功植入。随访6-12个月，三尖瓣反流保持轻至微量，跨三尖瓣平均压差1.8-2.1 mmHg，超声未见导线-瓣叶或导线-装置交互，无导线相关并发症。
AI.conclusion: T-TEER术后临床需要经静脉右室导线植入时，透视引导下装置规避的后间隔入路是可行选择。但样本量小、随访有限，需更大规模研究验证长期安全性和有效性。

summary_zh: 经导管三尖瓣缘对缘修复（T-TEER）后经静脉植入右心室导线可能具有挑战性，因为可能与植入的修复装置、夹合的瓣叶或修复后的对合区发生相互作用。我们描述了三位在T-TEER（使用TriClip或PASCAL系统）后需要经静脉植入起搏器或植入式心律转复除颤器的患者。在每一例中，最靠后的T-TEER装置被用作透视标志，以引导导线从装置的下方和后方通过，朝向一个通畅的后间隔残余孔口。起搏器导线通过导管和导丝交叉后推进长可撕开鞘管递送，而除颤导线由于鞘管与导线不兼容，需要直接塑形和透视操作。所有三位患者植入均成功。在6-12个月的随访期间，三尖瓣反流保持轻度或微量，平均经三尖瓣跨瓣压差范围为1.8至2.1 mmHg，未观察到超声心动图上的导线-瓣叶或导线-装置相互作用或导线相关并发症。这种透视引导、保留装置的策略可能在T-TEER后临床需要经静脉右心室导线植入时代表一种实用的选择。

title: Risk stratification in early non-ischaemic cardiomyopathy: the interplay of genetics and cardiac imaging
summary: Preventing sudden cardiac death (SCD) in early non-ischaemic cardiomyopathy (NICM) remains a major clinical challenge. Traditional risk stratification centred on left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) poorly captures arrhythmic risk, particularly in early dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) and non-dilated left ventricular cardiomyopathy (NDLVC). Increasing recognition of fibrosis-based and genotype-specific arrhythmogenic substrates has prompted a shift towards multimodal risk assessment strategies integrating imaging, electrocardiographic, and genetic data. This review examines contemporary approaches to risk stratification in early NICM, with particular emphasis on the role of cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging and late gadolinium enhancement (LGE). The expanding role of genotype-specific phenotyping is also explored, including high-risk arrhythmogenic variants and the integration of genotype with imaging phenotype as a promising route to improved prediction. Collectively, these advances support a transition from population-based LVEF thresholds towards more personalised and biologically informed strategies for prevention of SCD in early NICM.

AI.tldr: 综述指出，早期非缺血性心肌病仅凭LVEF难以评估心律失常风险，整合CMR-LGE与基因型分型可推动更个性化的猝死预防策略。
AI.motivation: 早期非缺血性心肌病（NICM）的猝死预防是临床难题；以LVEF为中心的传统分层对早期扩张型心肌病（DCM）及非扩张型左室心肌病（NDLVC）的心律失常风险识别不足，而纤维化及基因型特异性致心律失常基质的认识不断加深，亟需多模态评估策略。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，聚焦早期NICM风险分层，重点讨论心血管磁共振（CMR）及晚期钆增强（LGE）的作用，并探讨基因型特异性表型分析（包括高危致心律失常变异）及基因型与影像表型整合的预测价值。摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入文献数量及定量合并分析。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值；定性结论为：基于纤维化和基因型的致心律失常基质识别可弥补LVEF阈值的不足，基因型与影像表型的整合是改善风险预测的有前景途径。
AI.conclusion: 早期NICM的风险分层正从基于人群的LVEF阈值转向整合影像、心电与遗传信息的个性化、生物学驱动策略，可能影响ICD一级预防决策；但本文为综述，所提整合路径尚缺乏前瞻性验证，摘要未报告相关结局数据。

summary_zh: 预防早期非缺血性心肌病（NICM）中的心脏性猝死（SCD）仍然是一项重大临床挑战。以左心室射血分数（LVEF）为中心的传统风险分层难以充分捕捉心律失常风险，尤其是在早期扩张型心肌病（DCM）和非扩张型左心室心肌病（NDLVC）中。对基于纤维化和基因型特异性致心律失常基质的认识日益增加，促使风险评走向整合影像、心电图和遗传数据的多模态风险评估策略。本综述探讨了早期NICM风险分层的当代方法，特别强调心血管磁共振（CMR）成像和晚期钆增强（LGE）的作用。还探讨了基因型特异性表型分析的扩展作用，包括高风险致心律失常变异以及将基因型与影像表型相结合作为改善预测的有前景途径。总体而言，这些进展支持从基于人群的LVEF阈值向更个性化和生物学信息的策略转变，以预防早期NICM中的SCD。

title: Sex-related phenotypic differences in myotonic dystrophy types 1 and 2: a nationwide registry study from Serbia
summary: Background Myotonic dystrophies (DM) are autosomal dominant, multisystem disorders with variable clinical expressions. DM1 and DM2 share overlapping features, such as myotonia and muscle weakness, but differ in age at onset, severity, progression and multisystem features. Emerging evidence suggests that biological sex influences disease manifestations, progression, and outcomes.Objective To assess sex-specific differences among patients with genetically confirmed DM1 and DM2.Patients and methods This cross-sectional study included 587 adult patients (391 DM1, 196 DM2) from the Serbian Registry for Myotonic Dystrophies. Comprehensive assessments included neuromuscular examination, electrophysiological testing, systemic evaluation (cardiac, respiratory, endocrine, skeletal, and ophthalmologic), laboratory analysis, and functional status. Muscle strength was measured using a modified Medical Research Council score. Statistical analyses compared male and female patients within each DM type. Given the exploratory nature of the study, no adjustment for multiple comparisons was applied.Results In DM1, the male-to-female ratio was 1.1:1. Males exhibited more severe neuromuscular involvement, including less strength in distal upper limb and proximal lower limb, longer myotonia duration, higher prevalence of dysarthria, dysphagia, polyneuropathy, skeletal deformities, baldness, and infertility, as well as more common impairment on ECG. In DM2, females predominated (ratio 1.5:1) and showed more pronounced weakness in proximal lower limb, reduced respiratory capacity, and more common cataracts. DM2 males had longer myotonia, higher prevalence of polyneuropathy, baldness, infertility, hyperglycemia, and more frequent pacemaker implantation.Conclusions Sex is associated with distinct phenotypic profiles in DM1 and DM2. Greater neuromuscular burden was seen in DM1 males and DM2 females. On the other hand, male patients generally exhibit more cardiologic and endocrinological/metabolic burden in both DM1 and DM2. Incorporating sex as a variable in clinical evaluation, risk stratification, and therapeutic planning may be essential for personalized management of DM patients in future.

AI.tldr: 塞尔维亚全国注册研究显示，强直性肌营养不良1型和2型存在性别相关表型差异：DM1男性神经肌肉受累更重，DM2女性近端下肢无力和呼吸功能下降更明显，而男性在兩型中心脏和代谢负担更重。
AI.motivation: 强直性肌营养不良（DM）为常染色体显性多系统疾病，DM1与DM2临床表型重叠但病程和严重度不同；既往证据提示生物性别可能影响疾病表现、进展和结局，但缺乏基于全国注册的大样本性别特异性表型分析。
AI.method: 横断面研究，纳入塞尔维亚强直性肌营养不良注册库中587例基因确诊成人患者（DM1 391例，DM2 196例）。评估包括神经肌肉检查、电生理检测、多系统评估（心脏、呼吸、内分泌、骨骼、眼科）、实验室分析和功能状态；肌力采用改良MRC评分。统计比较各DM类型内男女性别差异；因研究为探索性，未进行多重比较校正。
AI.result: DM1男女比1.1:1，男性远端上肢和近端下肢肌力更差、肌强直持续时间更长，构音障碍、吞咽困难、多发性神经病、骨骼畸形、秃发和不育更常见，心电图异常更普遍。DM2女性占优（男女比1:1.5），近端下肢无力、呼吸容量下降和白内障更明显；DM2男性肌强直持续时间更长，多发性神经病、秃发、不育、高血糖和起搏器植入更常见。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 性别与DM1和DM2不同表型谱相关：DM1男性神经肌肉负担更重，DM2女性神经肌肉和呼吸受累更突出，而男性在兩型中心脏和内分泌/代谢负担更重。建议将性别纳入临床评估、风险分层和治疗规划以实现个体化管理；但本研究为横断面探索性分析，未校正多重比较，结果需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：强直性肌营养不良（DM）是常染色体显性遗传的多系统疾病，临床表现多样。DM1和DM2具有重叠特征，如肌强直和肌无力，但在发病年龄、严重程度、进展和多系统特征方面存在差异。新出现的证据表明，生物学性别影响疾病表现、进展和结局。

目的：评估经基因确诊的DM1和DM2患者中性别特异性差异。

患者和方法：这项横断面研究纳入了来自塞尔维亚强直性肌营养不良登记处的587例成年患者（391例DM1，196例DM2）。综合评估包括神经肌肉检查、电生理测试、系统评估（心脏、呼吸、内分泌、骨骼和眼科）、实验室分析和功能状态。肌力采用改良医学研究委员会评分测量。统计分析比较了每种DM类型内男性和女性患者。鉴于研究的探索性性质，未进行多重比较校正。

结果：在DM1中，男女比例为1.1:1。男性表现出更严重的神经肌肉受累，包括上肢远端和下肢近端肌力较低、肌强直持续时间更长、构音障碍、吞咽困难、多神经病、骨骼畸形、秃发和不育的患病率更高，以及心电图异常更常见。在DM2中，女性占优势（比例1.5:1），并表现出更明显的下肢近端无力、呼吸能力下降和白内障更常见。DM2男性肌强直持续时间更长，多神经病、秃发、不育、高血糖的患病率更高，且起搏器植入更频繁。

结论：性别与DM1和DM2中不同的表型特征相关。DM1男性和DM2女性中观察到更大的神经肌肉负担。另一方面，男性患者在DM1和DM2中通常表现出更多的心脏病学和内分泌/代谢负担。将性别作为临床评估、风险分层和治疗计划中的变量，对于未来DM患者的个性化管理可能至关重要。

title: Impact of aging on catecholaminergic ventricular arrhythmia and cardiac transcriptome of cardiac calsequestrin null mice
summary: Catecholamine-induced polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is associated typically with mutations in Ryanodine Receptor type 2 ( RYR2 ) and cardiac Calsequestrin ( CASQ2 ) genes. RyR2 and CASQ2 along with membrane proteins, junctin and triadin, constitute the Ca2+ release unit in the junctional sarcoplasmic reticulum in mammalian cardiomyocytes. Mouse models lacking Casq2 gene phenocopy CPVT and have been used to study CPVT pathophysiology and to identify novel therapies. Here, we analyze roles of normal aging for the development of cardiac dysfunctions of Casq2 -null mice. We show that aging intensifies the disease phenotype. Age-dependent changes in triadin but not in RyR2 or junctin correlate with a more severe CPVT phenotype. We also examine transcriptomes at 1 month and 2 years of age. We identify 583 genes whose expression is dependent on Casq2 genotype with enrichment for genes associated with calcium handling and transport, sarcomere structures, extracellular matrix, and natriuretic peptide signaling. Age-stratified analyses identified 76 genes that were dysregulated only in aged mice and 22 genes that were dysregulated only in young animals.
journal: Journal of Molecular and Cellular Cardiology Plus

AI.tldr: 衰老加重Casq2缺失小鼠的CPVT表型，triadin年龄依赖性变化与表型严重度相关，转录组分析揭示583个基因表达受基因型影响。
AI.motivation: CPVT通常与RYR2和CASQ2基因突变相关，Casq2缺失小鼠可模拟CPVT，用于研究病理生理和寻找新疗法，但正常衰老对Casq2缺失小鼠心脏功能障碍发展的作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 研究类型为动物实验，使用Casq2缺失小鼠模型，分析衰老对心脏功能障碍的影响，检测triadin、RyR2和junctin的年龄依赖性变化，并在1月龄和2年龄时进行转录组分析，识别基因型依赖的基因表达变化。
AI.result: 衰老加重疾病表型；triadin的年龄依赖性变化与更严重的CPVT表型相关，而RyR2或junctin无此关联；转录组分析识别583个基因表达依赖Casq2基因型，富集于钙处理与转运、肌节结构、细胞外基质和利钠肽信号通路；年龄分层分析发现76个基因仅在老年小鼠中失调，22个基因仅在年轻动物中失调。
AI.conclusion: 衰老可加重Casq2缺失小鼠的CPVT表型，triadin可能参与年龄相关表型恶化，转录组变化为理解CPVT年龄依赖性机制提供线索，但研究限于小鼠模型，临床转化需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 儿茶酚胺诱导的多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）通常与Ryanodine受体2型（RYR2）和心脏Calsequestrin（CASQ2）基因的突变相关。RyR2和CASQ2与膜蛋白junctin和triadin一起，构成哺乳动物心肌细胞连接肌浆网中的Ca2+释放单元。缺乏Casq2基因的小鼠模型可表型模拟CPVT，并已被用于研究CPVT的病理生理学和识别新疗法。在此，我们分析正常衰老对Casq2缺失小鼠心脏功能障碍发展的作用。我们显示衰老加剧了疾病表型。triadin而非RyR2或junctin的年龄依赖性变化与更严重的CPVT表型相关。我们还检查了1个月和2岁时的转录组。我们识别了583个基因，其表达依赖于Casq2基因型，富集于与钙处理和转运、肌节结构、细胞外基质和利钠肽信号传导相关的基因。年龄分层分析识别了76个仅在老年小鼠中失调的基因和22个仅在年轻动物中失调的基因。

title: Risk Factors Predicting Atrial High-Rate Episodes in Patients Without Prior Atrial Fibrillation Undergoing Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device Implantation Based on Biomarkers and Genetic Study
Optimized LSTM-Based Method for Arrhythmia Detection from ECG Signals Using Crow Search Algorithm}
summary: Accurate detection of cardiac arrhythmias from electrocardiogram (ECG) signals is crucial for the early diagnosis and effective management of cardiovascular disorders. However, the nonstationary, complex, and highly variable nature of ECG signals often limits the performance of conventional classification methods. This study proposes an intelligent arrhythmia detection framework that integrates advanced signal preprocessing, hybrid feature extraction, and an optimized Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network. In the preprocessing stage, a Butterworth filter is applied to suppress low-frequency noise, while wavelet transformation is used to remove high-frequency interference and enhance the quality of the ECG signals. A comprehensive feature set is then constructed by combining temporal, statistical, and frequency-domain information extracted mainly from the third and fourth levels of wavelet decomposition. To improve classification performance, the hyperparameters of the LSTM network are optimized using the Crow Search Algorithm (CSA), enabling the model to capture complex temporal dependencies more effectively. The proposed framework is evaluated through extensive simulations using confusion matrices, receiver operating characteristic curves, and standard performance measures, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The model achieves an outstanding classification accuracy of 99.8\%, indicating excellent robustness, reliability, and practical applicability. The results demonstrate that the integration of effective denoising, multidomain feature extraction, and CSA-optimized LSTM learning provides a powerful and efficient solution for automated arrhythmia detection. This framework has significant potential to support intelligent cardiac monitoring systems, improve clinical decision-making, and enhance the quality of patient care.

Tafamidis: is it truly a game changer for transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy?
summary: Transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CM) is an increasingly recognized condition caused by the misfolding of transthyretin (TTR) protein, leading to amyloid deposits in various tissues and organs. In 2019, tafamidis was the first FDA-approved disease-modifying therapy to address an unmet need for patients with ATTR-CM, stabilizing TTR proteins and preventing dissociation. Tafamidis has been shown to reduce all-cause mortality and slow decline in functional capacity and quality of life and is generally considered a safe treatment because of its minimal major drug interactions. However, tafamidis has several well-recognized limitations, including high cost, reduced effectiveness in advanced disease stages, limited ability to address established amyloid burden, and limited evidence for advanced polyneuropathy. As new therapies and advancements emerge, further research is needed to compare their relative effectiveness. In this review, we explore the development of tafamidis, pivotal clinical trial results, clinical applications, safety considerations, and future therapeutic directions for ATTR-CM.

summary_zh: 转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变性（ATTR-CM）是一种日益被认识的疾病，由转甲状腺素蛋白（TTR）错误折叠引起，导致淀粉样物质沉积于多种组织和器官。2019年，tafamidis成为首个FDA批准的疾病修饰疗法，满足了ATTR-CM患者未满足的需求，其稳定TTR蛋白并防止解离。Tafamidis已被证明可降低全因死亡率，减缓功能能力和生活质量的下降，并且因其主要药物相互作用极少而通常被认为是一种安全的治疗。然而，tafamidis具有几个公认的局限性，包括高成本、在疾病晚期阶段有效性降低、解决已形成淀粉样负荷的能力有限，以及针对晚期多神经病的证据有限。随着新疗法的出现和进展，需要进一步研究以比较其相对有效性。在本综述中，我们探讨了tafamidis的发展、关键临床试验结果、临床应用、安全性考虑以及ATTR-CM的未来治疗方向。
